c0c975c1513edefdbdbc8ae033e72d4a12f2c89f.open_work: Part 2 generates a huge ensemble initialized daily in summer 2023 and characterizes extremes; tail statistics remain to be established more generally.
c0c975c1513edefdbdbc8ae033e72d4a12f2c89f.issues: Skill still somewhat below IFS on some metrics; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; extreme verification limited by sample size.

53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.goal: Emulates precipitation from an expensive 2.2 km convection-permitting regional climate model at much lower cost.
53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.architecture: CPMGEM: conditional diffusion model downscaling 60 km GCM-scale inputs to 8.8 km daily precipitation, stochastic sampling.
53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.data: UKCP Local simulations over England and Wales, 1980-2080, high-emissions scenario.
53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.result: Matches CPM spatial structure and intensity distribution, shows skill for extremes with return periods up to about 100 years, and transfers from perfect-model to GCM inputs.
53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.open_work: Applying to large GCM ensembles and other GCMs/scenarios to sample uncertainty, and correcting the climate change magnitude error.
53e99d9fada4b269e5555cbb6cd22df7189a14e7.issues: Exhibits error in the magnitude of 21st-century change; daily means only; single region and single emission scenario.

42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.goal: Tests whether equation discovery can learn interpretable closed-form subgrid-scale closures from high-fidelity data, and why such closures fail online.
42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.architecture: Sparse-regression equation discovery with expansive term libraries applied to filtered DNS fluxes.
42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.data: Filtered direct numerical simulations of 2D turbulence and Rayleigh-Benard convection with Gaussian, box and other filters.
42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.result: Robustly recovers the nonlinear gradient model (leading Taylor-series term), with offline flux correlations above 0.95, but LES with these closures is unstable due to no inter-scale energy transfer (2D) and poor backscatter (RBC).
42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.open_work: Physics-informed libraries, loss functions and metrics to discover accurate, stable closures.
42f0ea216f6ad8050e42272a8d4b0d1ece78dde3.issues: Idealized flows; SGS 'truth' depends on filtering and is non-unique; offline accuracy does not guarantee online stability.

d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.goal: Produces state-dependent probabilistic forecasts of the Madden-Julian oscillation and explains their sources of predictability.
d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.architecture: Deep CNN predicting mean and standard deviation of MJO indices, with Monte Carlo dropout for model uncertainty and interpretability analysis.
d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.data: Reanalysis and satellite fields of tropical atmospheric variables with RMM-type MJO indices as targets.
d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.result: Skillful probabilistic MJO forecasts whose uncertainty varies with instantaneous predictability; stronger initial MJO linked to more uncertainty, and Walker Circulation state affects predictability.
d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.open_work: Comparing with and combining with dynamical subseasonal ensembles, and testing robustness of the interpretations.
d243cdc68c58e76a2077148a07254ff8f47c0a2b.issues: Limited observational record for training; Gaussian uncertainty assumption; skill relative to operational models not established in the abstract.

19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.goal: Builds a fast surrogate of the expensive neXtSIM elasto-brittle sea-ice model for Arctic sea-ice thickness.
19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.architecture: U-Net with partial convolutions handling the land-sea mask, predicting thickness at 12 h lead and iterated autoregressively, with atmospheric forcing as input.
19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.data: neXtSIM Arctic-wide simulations at about 10 km resolution plus atmospheric forcings.
19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.result: Beats persistence from 12 h to about 1 year with up to 50% lower error; gain over daily climatology extends beyond 6 months.
19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.open_work: Emulating additional sea-ice variables, reducing smoothing, and integrating with data assimilation or coupled systems.
19b32769e45aa1c1b46c4619d03a6baf41213430.issues: Iteration diffuses fine-scale structures (e.g. leads); trained on model output only, so inherits neXtSIM biases.

bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.goal: Provides a dataset for ML post-processing of ensemble weather forecasts, which otherwise requires costly simulations to obtain.
bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.architecture: Dataset and benchmark task (48 h prediction correction) with baseline post-processing models, including extreme event evaluation.
bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.data: Ten ECMWF ensemble members (reforecasts), 1998-2017, 11 pressure levels plus surface at 0.5 degree, lead times 0, 24, 48 h, twice weekly.
bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.result: Baselines improve 48 h forecasts of three key variables and are evaluated for extreme events.
bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.open_work: More members, lead times and variables, and stronger architectures for ensemble post-processing.
bbd4efb6e38aad57827d09b0cb93a39a989e170e.issues: Only 10 members and twice-weekly initializations; limited lead times; targets are ERA5 rather than observations.

74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.goal: Tests whether the ACE ML climate emulator generalizes to a different atmospheric model, with focus on precipitation fidelity.
74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.architecture: ACE (SFNO-based autoregressive emulator) applied without modification; also fine-tuning from a pretrained network.
74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.data: E3SMv2 atmosphere (EAMv2) simulations at about 1 degree grid spacing forced by repeating annual cycle SSTs.
74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.result: Stable 10-year runs with small climate biases; faithful spatiotemporal precipitation structure; pretrained ACE adapts with 10 times fewer training steps and can interpolate between models.
74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.open_work: Extending to time-varying forcing and coupled ocean, and studying multi-model training.
74a597bb024072d0e6d453150c81910674a82674.issues: Climatological SST forcing only, so no climate change response; emulates a model and inherits its biases.

637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.goal: Proof of concept for deep learning subgrid-scale parametrisation of sea-ice dynamics with brittle rheology.
637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.architecture: U-Net correcting all model variables of a low-resolution sea-ice model toward high-resolution simulations, applied online every 10 minutes.
637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.data: Twin experiments with a regional Maxwell elasto-brittle dynamics-only model in a 40 km x 200 km wind-forced domain.
637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.result: Reduces forecast errors by over 75% at about 10 minute lead; online hybrid improves forecasts up to an hour.
637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.open_work: Extending to realistic, longer (hourly to daily) forecasts and to models including thermodynamics.
637fe4b6e69f8bd193eab23f20c767700af29025.issues: Idealized, small domain and dynamics-only model; improvements last only about an hour; long-term stability untested.

70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.goal: Detects forced climate change signals earlier by combining multiple variables and seasons with explainable neural networks.
70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.architecture: Artificial neural networks predicting the year from single- and multi-variable maps, interpreted with layer-wise relevance propagation.
70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.data: Forced climate model simulations from multiple CMIP models (e.g. temperature and precipitation maps across seasons).
70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.result: Combined fields allow earlier detection than single fields; LRP reveals multivariate indicator patterns that vary over time and between models.
70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.open_work: Using indicator patterns to investigate inter-model differences and applying to observations.
70906b97919a95677c9cdc04ef6ae933b504160d.issues: Trained on model output; detection with observations not demonstrated in the abstract; LRP attribution can be ambiguous.

704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.goal: Improves a coarse global climate model with ML corrections learned from a storm-resolving model across a full annual cycle.
704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.architecture: ML models learning state-dependent nudging tendencies of temperature and humidity and surface radiative fluxes, added to the coarse model.
704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.data: Year-long GFDL X-SHiELD 3 km GSRM simulation; 200 km FV3GFS coarse model.
704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.result: Corrected runs are stable for multiple years; time-mean pattern errors drop by 6-26% for land surface temperature and 9-25% for land precipitation versus no-ML.
704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.open_work: Reducing the new climate and circulation biases, and generalization to warmer climates.
704f5fff52b031368b1a430de4e83f278f5e144a.issues: ML-corrected runs develop other biases of comparable amplitude to baseline; only one year of training data.

e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.goal: Combines physical interpretability of energy balance models with flexibility of data-driven emulators for surface temperature projections.
e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.architecture: FaIRGP: Gaussian process emulator constrained by FaIR energy balance model response equations, Bayesian with tractable uncertainty.
e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.data: ESM output (ScenarioMIP-type scenarios) for global mean and spatial surface temperature, with emissions/forcing inputs.
e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.result: Skillful emulation of global mean and spatial temperature across future scenarios, outperforming EBMs; yields estimates of TOA radiative forcing.
e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.open_work: Applications to detection and attribution and precipitation emulation.
e90191132f18112775d43f1ce7a4de672a60b7dc.issues: Temperature-only; linear energy balance structure may limit nonlinear responses; GP scalability.

6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.goal: Builds a probabilistic, stable emulator of a global climate model that produces accurate climate ensembles, addressing deterministic emulators' biases and lack of ensembles.
6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.architecture: Spherical DYffusion: dynamics-informed diffusion (DYffusion) combined with a spherical Fourier neural operator backbone.
6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.data: Coarse (about 1 degree) FV3GFS simulations with climatological SST forcing, as used for ACE.
6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.result: Produces stable multi-year 6-hourly ensemble simulations and substantially reduces climate biases relative to baselines (reported as more than 50%), approaching the reference model's internal variability.
6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.open_work: Extending to time-varying forcing, coupled ocean and finer resolution.
6060c964c7ea37498ff81c08cd4bd2ff06f70049.issues: Abstract unavailable; climatological SST forcing only; emulator inherits FV3GFS biases.

774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.goal: Tests whether NN interpretation methods reliably recover known geophysical structure, using the MJO as test case.
774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.architecture: Neural network classifying MJO phase, interpreted with backward optimization and layerwise relevance propagation.
774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.data: Observed/reanalysis tropical atmospheric fields (e.g. OLR and winds) with MJO phase labels.
774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.result: NN identifies MJO phase twice as accurately as linear regression; interpretations recover known spatial structure and suggest extended seasons should shift one month later.
774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.open_work: Applying interpretable NNs to test other geoscientific hypotheses.
774d9430fcf007c51afff8d9bb3d74fcf0d659bc.issues: Interpretation reliability shown for one well-known phenomenon; methods may behave differently where truth is unknown.

b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.goal: Produces fast probabilistic ensemble weather forecasts with ML, both global and limited-area.
b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.architecture: Graph-EFM: latent variable model on a hierarchical graph neural network, sampling ensemble members via latent noise.
b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.data: ERA5 global (about 1.5 degree) and MEPS limited-area Nordic forecasts.
b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.result: Generates ensembles efficiently with good calibration and spread-skill, competitive CRPS versus deterministic and other ML baselines.
b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.open_work: Higher resolution, longer lead times, and comparison with operational ensembles.
b44474e8930d5d32fe8073465992e1540650c17d.issues: Abstract unavailable; coarse global resolution; ensemble members may be smooth.

2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.goal: Learn solution operators of parametric PDEs (mappings between function spaces) so a whole family of PDE instances can be solved quickly, instead of one instance at a time.
2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.architecture: Fourier Neural Operator: stacked layers that parameterize the integral kernel in Fourier space (FFT, learned weights on truncated low modes, inverse FFT) plus a pointwise linear path and nonlinearity.
2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.data: Numerically generated solutions of 1D Burgers' equation, 2D Darcy flow and 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes (vorticity form, including turbulent regime) at varying resolutions.
2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.result: State-of-the-art accuracy among neural PDE surrogates on all benchmarks and up to three orders of magnitude faster than traditional solvers; discretization-invariant, enabling zero-shot super-resolution.
2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.open_work: Extending to irregular geometries, non-periodic boundaries and real geophysical systems; long autoregressive rollouts; it became the basis of FourCastNet-style weather emulators.
2f7dc1ee85e9f6a97810c66016e09ffeed684f03.issues: Truncated Fourier modes limit representation of fine-scale features; FFT assumes regular periodic grids; tested on idealized PDE data with a single fixed setting, not on observations.

b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.goal: Perspective arguing how deep learning can advance Earth system science beyond classical machine learning, while retaining physical process understanding.
b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.architecture: Review/perspective (not a new model): surveys deep learning for spatiotemporal Earth data and advocates hybrid modelling that couples physics-based models with data-driven components.
b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.data: No new data; discusses Earth observation, reanalysis and model output as the data streams relevant to deep learning applications.
b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.result: Identifies key challenges for deep learning in geoscience (interpretability, physical consistency, complex and uncertain data, limited labels, computational demands) and proposes hybrid physics-ML modelling as the way forward.
b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.open_work: Development of physically consistent, interpretable hybrid models, e.g. learned parameterizations and emulators embedded in process models.
b2114228411d367cfa6ca091008291f250a2c490.issues: Programmatic perspective without quantitative evaluation; abstract not available in the record, so the summary relies on knowledge of the paper.

1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.goal: Produce high-quality, 1 km daily surface PM2.5 maps over China to support air-pollution monitoring at urban scale, where satellite and ground data alone are insufficient.
1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.architecture: Enhanced space-time extremely randomized trees (STET), a tree ensemble augmented with spatiotemporal information and auxiliary predictors.
1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.data: MODIS MAIAC 1 km AOD plus meteorological, topographic, land-use and emission data, with ground-station PM2.5 as targets; daily maps for 2018 over mainland China (ChinaHighPM2.5).
1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.result: Out-of-sample (out-of-station) cross-validation R2 of 0.89 (0.88), RMSE 10.33 (10.93) ug/m3, MAE 6.69 (7.15) ug/m3; outperforms most previous models and supports historical estimation (monthly R2 0.80).
1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.open_work: Extending the dataset to longer periods and other pollutants, and improving estimates where AOD retrievals are missing.
1bd153e9d6a2982e2c2e46e67bd3a17f00b16e6b.issues: Depends on AOD availability (cloud and snow gaps); only one year evaluated in detail; cross-validation at stations may overstate skill in sparsely monitored regions.

e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.goal: Reduce error accumulation in ML weather models so that skill at 15-day lead times matches the ECMWF ensemble mean.
e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.architecture: Cascade of three pretrained U-Transformer (Swin Transformer V2-based) models specialized for 0-5, 5-10 and 10-15 day lead times; ensemble from perturbed initial conditions and model parameters.
e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.data: ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis, 39 years, 0.25 degree, 6-hourly; evaluated against ERA5 and ECMWF HRES and ensemble forecasts.
e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.result: Comparable to the ECMWF ensemble mean over 15 days; extends skillful lead time over HRES from 9.25 to 10.5 days for Z500 and from 10 to 14.5 days for T2M; ensemble spread is promising.
e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.open_work: Better calibrated ensembles, initialization from operational analyses rather than reanalysis, and extension to subseasonal ranges (later FuXi-S2S).
e795f62df9ccac2a39e126f95404e5364d55193c.issues: Smoothing of forecasts at long leads typical of MSE-trained models; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; ensemble perturbations are ad hoc rather than flow-dependent.

1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.goal: Adapt Transformers efficiently to high-dimensional spatiotemporal Earth system forecasting, where full attention is prohibitively expensive.
1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.architecture: Earthformer: hierarchical encoder-decoder space-time Transformer built on Cuboid Attention (local self-attention within decomposed cuboids) connected through global vectors.
1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.data: Synthetic MovingMNIST and a new chaotic N-body MNIST for design ablations; real benchmarks SEVIR (radar precipitation nowcasting) and ICAR-ENSO (Nino3.4 forecasting).
1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.result: Achieves state-of-the-art scores on SEVIR precipitation nowcasting and ENSO forecasting relative to ConvLSTM, U-Net and other baselines.
1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting to avoid blurring (later addressed by PreDiff), incorporation of physical constraints and scaling to global, multi-variable data.
1a35db70975ab084ee714673c7f1dd5603ab2839.issues: Deterministic MSE training produces blurry nowcasts and underestimates intense precipitation; evaluated only on fixed benchmark datasets.

9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.goal: Remove the influence of meteorological variability on air-quality time series so that PM10 trends reflect emission and chemistry changes.
9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.architecture: Random forest regression of daily PM10 on meteorological, synoptic, boundary-layer-height and time variables; normalised trends tested with the Theil-Sen estimator; partial dependence plots for interpretation.
9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.data: Daily PM10 at 31 Swiss monitoring sites, 1997-2016, with surface meteorology, synoptic classes and boundary layer height.
9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.result: Significant normalised PM10 decreases between -0.09 and -1.16 ug/m3/yr, largest at urban traffic sites (mean -0.77 ug/m3/yr); two high-PM10 regimes identified: poor dispersion and photochemical secondary production.
9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.open_work: Application to other pollutants and regions, and quantification of uncertainty in normalised trends.
9a567afa0ebc33fea70206502ccca5ec544da568.issues: Normalisation assumes the RF captures all meteorological effects; covariate shift over decades and correlated predictors can bias trends; single-country scope.

cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.goal: Examine whether deep learning models trained on atmospheric data could compete with physics-based global weather and climate models, and what design choices this entails.
cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.architecture: Discussion paper with a toy neural-network model for global weather prediction on a coarse grid, used to explore design choices (global vs local networks, inputs, time stepping).
cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.data: Reanalysis data at coarse resolution for a few variables such as Z500 (ERA-Interim, per knowledge of the paper).
cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.result: The toy model shows some short-range skill above persistence but is not competitive with operational NWP; key challenges include data volume, conservation, stability and representing the full system.
cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.open_work: Building larger, more complete networks with proper treatment of the sphere and conservation, and hybrid ML-physics systems.
cce1dd9da8c579a031359ba526aa4a3336314d84.issues: Very simple toy model at coarse resolution; results are qualitative and predate modern large ML weather models.

294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.goal: Improve data-driven global weather prediction with CNNs so forecasts are stable and skilful, as a fast tool for large ensembles.
294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.architecture: Deep U-Net-style CNN operating on a cubed-sphere grid with volume-conservative remapping and face-aware padding, trained with a loss over multiple steps of the prediction sequence.
294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.data: Reanalysis (ERA5, coarse resolution) for a few basic atmospheric variables, with prescribed top-of-atmosphere solar forcing.
294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.result: Indefinitely stable forecasts with realistic patterns at multi-week leads and a realistic seasonal cycle; beats persistence, climatology and a coarse NWP model but is worse than high-resolution operational NWP.
294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.open_work: Adding variables (e.g. precipitation), higher resolution and ensemble generation for sub-seasonal forecasting (pursued in Weyn et al. 2021).
294f64f1890376795003e217ee339708d5347b1d.issues: Limited variable set and coarse resolution; not competitive with operational NWP at medium range; deterministic and smooth.

f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.goal: Replace human-designed parameterizations with a neural network that predicts subgrid heating and moistening and remains stable in prognostic use.
f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.architecture: Feed-forward neural network unified physics parameterization predicting apparent heat and moisture sources, trained by minimizing error over multiple time steps rather than a single step.
f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.data: Near-global aqua-planet cloud-resolving simulation at 4 km (NG-Aqua) coarse-grained to 160 km grid boxes.
f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.result: Multi-step training yields a numerically stable scheme; in prognostic single-column tests it reproduces NG-Aqua fluctuations and equilibrium better than the Community Atmosphere Model.
f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.open_work: Coupling to a full 3D GCM and testing stability and climate drift in online simulations.
f77df5994b19924319d12b8214916c652cf69ad4.issues: Only single-column prognostic tests; idealized aqua-planet with fixed SST; generalization to other climates and real geography untested.

bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.goal: Map the recent literature on machine learning in numerical weather prediction and climate analysis to identify dominant topics and future directions.
bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.architecture: Bibliometric review of the 500 most relevant articles since 2018 (Google Scholar) with topic extraction and critical discussion.
bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.data: Database of 500 article abstracts, analysed for topics, variables, methods and countries.
bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.result: Most common topics: renewable energy forecasting and atmospheric processes in NWP; parameterizations, extremes and climate change in climate research; leading methods are deep learning, RF, ANN, SVM and XGBoost; China and the USA lead.
bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.open_work: Authors expect ML to become a key component of future weather forecasting.
bf174d75e6a3ba436238627526906a03b45b6366.issues: Search-engine-based selection may be biased; abstract-level topic analysis is shallow; predates the 2022-2023 surge of global ML weather models.

e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.goal: Emulate a hidden chaotic dynamical model and predict its future states when only sparse, noisy observations are available.
e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.architecture: Iterative hybrid of data assimilation (ensemble Kalman filter) and a neural network surrogate: DA produces complete analyses that train the NN, which then serves as the model for the next DA cycle.
e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.data: Synthetic observations from the 40-variable Lorenz 96 model with varying noise and observation density.
e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.result: Method converges and yields forecast skill up to about two Lyapunov times, recovers positive Lyapunov exponents and the power spectrum; skill degrades smoothly with noise but drops abruptly if less than half the domain is observed.
e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.open_work: Scaling to higher-dimensional, more realistic dynamics and merging DA and ML more tightly.
e7f47ab5956a1053b81487b17171e31f3be2aba6.issues: Low-dimensional toy system; sensitivity to observation coverage; computational cost of iteration in large systems not addressed.

cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.goal: Systematically assess the added value of CNNs for continental-scale statistical downscaling, including extrapolation relevant to climate change.
cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.architecture: CNN models of increasing complexity compared with linear and generalized linear benchmarks within the VALUE validation framework.
cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.data: Large-scale reanalysis predictors (ERA-Interim) and gridded observations (E-OBS) over Europe for temperature and precipitation; a warm test period as a surrogate for future climate.
cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.result: CNNs add value for temperature mainly in reproducing extremes, and outperform classical methods for precipitation in most aspects; they can be applied to whole continents without predictor selection.
cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.open_work: Application to GCM predictors for climate-change projections, e.g. within CORDEX, and further tests of extrapolation.
cb583fd62b5fc3081b0c1724f745c76ed4827612.issues: Perfect-prognosis setup with reanalysis predictors; a warm historical period is only a partial proxy for future climate; deterministic models.

522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.goal: Provide accurate seasonal forecasts of Arctic sea ice, where dynamical models struggle to beat statistical benchmarks beyond a few weeks.
522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.architecture: IceNet: an ensemble of U-Net CNNs producing probabilistic (three-class) sea ice concentration forecasts for the next 6 months, with temperature-scaling calibration.
522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.data: Pretrained on CMIP6 climate simulations, then fine-tuned on observational sea ice concentration (OSI-SAF) and ERA5 predictors; compared with ECMWF SEAS5.
522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.result: Outperforms the SEAS5 dynamical model for seasonal summer sea ice forecasts, especially for extreme ice events, extending the range of accurate forecasts.
522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.open_work: Daily or higher-resolution forecasts, operational deployment and use in conservation and risk tools.
522144237db906e2e0d930a1af97888893072608.issues: Monthly-mean ice edge-focused classification rather than full concentration; limited observational training period; ML trained partly on model simulations with their biases.

bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.goal: Develop and openly release a deep learning model for radar-based precipitation nowcasting up to one hour.
bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.architecture: RainNet: U-Net/SegNet-inspired CNN predicting precipitation at 5 min lead time, applied recursively to reach 60 min.
bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.data: Several years of DWD RADOLAN radar composites over Germany (900 km x 900 km, 1 km, 5 min); verification on 11 summer events from 2016-2017.
bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.result: Significantly outperforms persistence and the rainymotion optical-flow model up to 60 min for MAE and CSI at 0.125, 1 and 5 mm/h, but is worse for 10 and 15 mm/h thresholds.
bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.open_work: Adjusting the loss function, training for longer lead times, framing threshold exceedance as segmentation, and adding input data on precipitation dynamics.
bb3e9408827cc41d82447e34691497abf3b1a0c6.issues: Strong spatial smoothing (loss of power below 16 km) that grows with recursive application, degrading heavy-rain prediction important for early warning.

a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.goal: Derive computationally efficient and interpretable parameterizations of ocean mesoscale eddies for coarse-resolution climate models.
a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.architecture: Relevance vector machines (sparse Bayesian regression) for closed-form equation discovery with embedded conservation, compared with CNNs predicting subgrid eddy momentum forcing.
a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.data: High-resolution idealized ocean model simulations, coarse-grained to provide subgrid forcing targets.
a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.result: All parameterizations improve coarse-resolution statistics in an idealized ocean model; the CNN is more stable and more skilful, while the RVM yields interpretable closed-form equations.
a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.open_work: Extending physics-aware interpretable closures to realistic ocean models and testing across regimes.
a8d0a4391075ff92aa872ee98e636347c90569f5.issues: Idealized configuration; RVM scheme less stable online; generalization to other resolutions and global ocean untested.

d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.goal: Estimate the Atlantic Ocean CO2 sink and its seasonal to interannual variability from sparse surface pCO2 observations.
d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.architecture: Two-step neural network approach: self-organizing map clustering into biogeochemical provinces followed by feed-forward networks per province to interpolate pCO2; fluxes from a gas-exchange parameterization.
d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.data: SOCAT v1.5 surface ocean pCO2 observations, 1998-2007, with predictors such as SST, salinity, chlorophyll and mixed layer depth; independent check with time series and SOCAT v2.
d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.result: pCO2 RMSE about 10 uatm in fit and 22.8 uatm on independent data; decadal mean Atlantic uptake -0.45 +/- 0.15 Pg C/yr; strengthening South Atlantic sink (-0.14 Pg C/yr/decade) and small interannual variability (+/-0.04 Pg C/yr).
d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.open_work: Extension to the global ocean and longer periods (later SOM-FFN global products), and better constraints in data-poor regions.
d299c14cbba2be4157e86fcb267cdc961c6ac850.issues: Sparse sampling in the tropics and South Atlantic; larger independent errors than fit errors; flux uncertainty from gas-exchange parameterization and winds.

080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.goal: Use a fast deep learning weather model to build a large ensemble for subseasonal-to-seasonal (2-6 week) forecasting.
080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.architecture: DLWP: CNN on a cubed-sphere grid recursively predicting six atmospheric variables at 6 h steps; 32 models with randomized training plus initial perturbations give a 320-member ensemble.
080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 1.4 degree resolution; two-year test set; compared with the ECMWF S2S ensemble.
080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.result: 320-member six-week ensemble in three minutes on one GPU; ensemble mean beats climatology beyond two weeks (ACC above 0.6 through six days); only modestly inferior to ECMWF S2S over land at weeks 4 and 5-6, worse at shorter leads.
080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.open_work: Adding precipitation and more variables, coupling to ocean and other slow components, and better ensemble generation.
080c98d3284b60b78d15fbd2bd118623fe88c403.issues: No precipitation forecast; coarse resolution and few variables; ensemble spread mainly from model weight randomization; inferior to ECMWF at short leads.

071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.goal: Review how machine learning is used to overcome bottlenecks in tropical cyclone forecasting.
071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.architecture: Literature review covering ML for TC genesis, track, intensity, associated wind and rain extremes, storm surge, and improvement of numerical forecast models.
071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.data: No new data; synthesizes published studies using satellite, reanalysis, best-track and model data.
071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.result: ML shows promise both as pure data-driven models and in enhancing numerical models, but its potential and available multi-source data are not yet fully exploited.
071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.open_work: Exploit multi-source data more fully and improve predictability periods and stability of ML-based TC forecasts.
071c8bccde96046eed5f7ad6749a2bfa850880a0.issues: Narrative review without quantitative comparison; predates recent global ML weather models with TC track skill.

504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.goal: Reconstruct missing values in historical observational surface temperature records to reduce coverage gaps that bias climate trend estimates.
504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.architecture: Image inpainting CNN (U-Net with partial convolutions) adapted to climate fields, transfer-learning knowledge from model data to observations.
504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.data: Trained on climate model output (20th Century Reanalysis and CMIP5 historical simulations); applied to HadCRUT4 gridded temperature anomalies.
504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.result: Inpainting reconstructions outperform conventional methods such as kriging and PCA-based infilling in tests, and recover large-scale patterns in sparse periods, e.g. the 1877-78 El Nino.
504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.open_work: Applying the method to other variables and datasets and quantifying uncertainty of reconstructions.
504442eadb5b3bc7a613879949bfbbf0f761a482.issues: Reconstruction learns model-based spatial structure that may not hold in reality; uncertainty not fully quantified; abstract unavailable, so details rely on knowledge of the paper.

f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.goal: Compare ML methods for short-term prediction and long-term statistics of a multiscale chaotic system when only large-scale variables are observed.
f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.architecture: Echo state network (reservoir computing), deep feed-forward ANN and LSTM recurrent network trained on the slow variables only.
f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.data: Simulations of a three-tier multiscale Lorenz 96 system; only the slow X variables used for training and testing.
f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.result: RC-ESN substantially outperforms ANN and LSTM for short-term forecasts, tracking trajectories for several Lyapunov times; ESN and LSTM reproduce the true pdf including tails, ANN does not.
f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional weather and climate systems and use as data-driven or data-assisted surrogates.
f0a9737669dd5ecee65cbe24d038973956628635.issues: Low-dimensional toy system with perfect noise-free data; ESN scalability to large systems is an open question.

141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.goal: Predict extreme-causing circulation patterns days ahead with a fast data-driven analog approach to complement NWP early warnings.
141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.architecture: Capsule neural networks with impact-based auto-labeling of Z500 patterns (classes 0-4 by occurrence and region of surface temperature extremes), compared with CNNs and logistic regression.
141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.data: Large-ensemble fully coupled Earth system model output (CESM Large Ensemble) for North America.
141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.result: Using Z500 only, accuracies (recalls) of 69-45% (77-48%) for cold and 62-41% (73-47%) for heat waves at 1-5 days; with surface temperature added, about 80% (88%); CapsNets beat CNN and logistic regression and degrade least with less data.
141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.open_work: Testing on reanalysis and observations and combining with NWP for early warning.
141b9a4a529d017d38e7fe355192705828011156.issues: Trained and evaluated on model data only; coarse categorical targets; accuracy drops quickly with lead time.

b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.goal: Provide a primer and chronological review of machine learning applied to numerical weather and climate modelling.
b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.architecture: Review covering ML for solvers and preconditioners, parameterization emulation and replacement, and full ML prediction models, plus key ML terminology and ethical considerations.
b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.data: No new data; synthesizes literature from early publications to about 2023.
b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.result: ML applications in weather and climate modelling have become competitive with knowledge-based alternatives in the last decade; summarizes progress and methods.
b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.open_work: Discusses future directions, including hybrid models and broader use of ML in model development.
b52da9f82ebe8b6541fe91c92d9a5d2e07c96ec3.issues: Fast-moving field means coverage is quickly dated; qualitative review.

9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.goal: Produce probabilistic, sharp and physically plausible precipitation nowcasts, avoiding blurry averaging of deterministic models.
9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.architecture: PreDiff: conditional latent diffusion model (Earthformer-based denoiser in an autoencoder latent space) with a knowledge-alignment mechanism that adjusts each denoising step toward physical constraints.
9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.data: Synthetic N-body MNIST (energy conservation constraint) and SEVIR radar/satellite precipitation nowcasting dataset (anticipated intensity constraint).
9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.result: Handles uncertainty, incorporates domain knowledge and generates sharp forecasts with high operational utility compared with deterministic and other generative baselines.
9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.open_work: Additional physical constraints, faster sampling and application to other Earth system forecasting tasks.
9b3def4a30c1452b160cb97537a47c7d8341dc26.issues: Diffusion sampling is computationally costly; constraints must be specified and estimated; evaluated on limited benchmark datasets.

f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.goal: Identify what makes data-driven medium-range weather models work by building a simple, scalable transformer with careful ablations.
f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.architecture: Stormer: standard vision-transformer backbone with weather-specific variable embedding, randomized dynamics forecasting over varying intervals, and pressure-weighted loss; multiple interval combinations averaged at inference.
f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.data: ERA5 reanalysis via WeatherBench 2 (coarse resolution relative to 0.25 degree models).
f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.result: Competitive at short-to-medium range and better than existing methods beyond 7 days on WeatherBench 2, with orders of magnitude less training data and compute; accuracy scales with model size and tokens.
f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.open_work: Higher resolution training, probabilistic forecasting and further scaling.
f9bbc83553ebf8fea9e485ce31b10799d69150e1.issues: Lower resolution than leading ML models; deterministic; ensemble-of-intervals mean may smooth forecasts; evaluated against reanalysis.

195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.goal: Make diffusion models efficient and stable for probabilistic spatiotemporal forecasting with long rollouts.
195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.architecture: DYffusion: replaces Gaussian-noise diffusion with a dynamics-informed process, using a stochastic time-conditioned interpolator (forward process) and a forecaster network (reverse process).
195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.data: Sea surface temperature fields, Navier-Stokes flows and spring mesh systems.
195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.result: Competitive probabilistic forecast skill with improved computational efficiency, flexible continuous-time sampling and trade-off of accuracy for speed.
195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.open_work: Application to higher-dimensional weather and climate data and longer horizons.
195dc158fa820c70f9d9892b7f2a150ca0cfc939.issues: Benchmarks are limited in size and realism; calibration and long-term stability for climate-length rollouts not established.

4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.goal: Correct model error of an existing knowledge-based model using ML combined with data assimilation from sparse, noisy observations.
4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.architecture: Iterative DA-ML scheme: strong-constraint 4D-Var analyses alternate with deep learning of a model-error correction, giving a hybrid physics-ML surrogate.
4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.data: Synthetic experiments with a two-layer, two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic channel model, with model error introduced via perturbed parameters.
4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.result: ML learns a substantial part of the model error; hybrid models give better short- to mid-range forecasts and significantly better DA analyses than the original model.
4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.open_work: Application to operational-scale systems such as the ECMWF IFS and handling of more realistic model error.
4b9a7e63118dde2bfed7d6388e52ef5813bb080d.issues: Idealized QG model with parametric model error only; cost of iterative 4D-Var plus training at scale not addressed.

e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.goal: Learn the data assimilation correction so a dynamic model can be improved and used for prediction when observations are unavailable.
e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.architecture: Deep Data Assimilation: a recurrent neural network trained on model states and DA results learns the misfit function, which is composed with the dynamical model.
e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.data: Simulated data from a double integral mass-dot system and the Lorenz system.
e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.result: Proves the approach reduces model error at each iteration and validates it with examples and a sensitivity study.
e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.open_work: Application to real physics problems with other equations and state variables.
e4437b6896ca976aa0f622f857b4a4daa96a1d18.issues: Only low-dimensional toy systems; no comparison with realistic geophysical DA systems.

6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.goal: Improve global subseasonal forecasts (up to 42 days), where ML models had not yet surpassed conventional systems.
6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.architecture: FuXi-S2S: ML model producing probabilistic global daily-mean forecasts, with a learned perturbation component to represent forecast uncertainty.
6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.data: 72 years of daily statistics from ERA5; five upper-air variables at 13 levels and 11 surface variables; compared with the ECMWF S2S model.
6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.result: Outperforms ECMWF S2S in ensemble mean and ensemble forecasts for precipitation and OLR, and extends skillful MJO prediction from 30 to 36 days; captures MJO teleconnections.
6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.open_work: Use for discovering precursor signals and extension to seasonal timescales.
6727224b0a153a953665af558f00afa4032b2b99.issues: Trained on reanalysis; ocean and land boundary forcings not explicitly coupled; daily-mean outputs only.

4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.goal: Assess from the bottom up whether neural networks can, in principle, forecast weather and produce climate datasets, using GCMs of varying complexity as simplified reality.
4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks trained to predict model weather days ahead, run iteratively to test climate reproduction.
4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.data: Output of the simple GCMs PUMA and PLASIM at different complexity levels and training-period lengths.
4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.result: Forecast skill depends on model complexity and training length; reproducing the GCM climate including a seasonal cycle remains challenging, unlike earlier results without seasonal cycle.
4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.open_work: More complex models, longer training data and architectures that maintain stable climates with seasonal cycles.
4f69980f94d915703cacbfa26863238033905baa.issues: Idealized, coarse GCM output rather than reality; limited variables and resolution.

4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.goal: Infers full state trajectories of high-dimensional stochastic dynamical systems from noisy, incomplete observations without relying on costly sequential use of transition dynamics, as needed for ocean and atmosphere data assimilation.
4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.architecture: Score-based (diffusion) generative model of trajectories whose score is decomposed into scores over short overlapping segments; observations guide sampling only at inference, generating all states non-autoregressively.
4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.data: Simulated trajectories of toy chaotic systems; the paper's experiments use Lorenz-63 and a 2D Kolmogorov (turbulent) flow.
4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.result: Theoretical and empirical evidence shows plausible posterior trajectories under a variety of zero-shot observation operators (e.g. sparse, coarse, or nonlinear observations) without retraining.
4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.open_work: Scaling to realistic, full-dimensional geophysical systems and real observation networks, and calibration checks of posterior uncertainty.
4ee8c12311f05e5b4ae82c6f83cf067677d69e5c.issues: Demonstrated only on idealized systems with simulated data; diffusion sampling is computationally heavy and posterior calibration with approximate guidance is not guaranteed.

b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.goal: Predicts Arctic sea ice concentration (SIC) purely from past observations, testing whether deep learning can match physical and statistical forecasts.
b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.architecture: Fully data-driven deep neural network trained on historical SIC fields, with no physical inputs; compared with an autoregressive (AR) model.
b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.data: Passive microwave satellite SIC record from 1978 onward; comparison with Sea Ice Prediction Network (SIPN) contributions.
b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.result: The deep learning predictions outperform the AR model and are comparable to the SIPN ensemble of diverse approaches.
b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.open_work: Adding physical predictors (atmosphere, ocean) and extending lead time and seasonal forecasting.
b4a953239f441512edb913f0c128bf2dd1af6c6c.issues: Purely statistical with no physics; limited ability to anticipate anomalous years; quantitative skill details and lead times not reported in the abstract.

8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.goal: Tests whether machine learning can serve as a global atmospheric forecast model designed for massively parallel supercomputers.
8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.architecture: Reservoir computing (echo state networks) applied in parallel over local horizontal patches of the globe, each reservoir predicting its local region with overlap from neighbors.
8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.data: ERA5 reanalysis interpolated to the low-resolution grid and variables of the SPEEDY model; compared with SPEEDY at identical resolution and state variables.
8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.result: Hourly 20-day forecasts stay realistic; the model beats climatology and persistence for the first three days in the midlatitudes but not the tropics, and does best versus SPEEDY for variables dominated by parameterized processes.
8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.open_work: Higher resolution, longer stable integration for climate use, and hybrid coupling with physics models (pursued in later work).
8f5aeaf5200401f93a645be4df379cd61b98663c.issues: Low resolution; skill horizon only about three days and poor in the tropics; benchmark is a simple intermediate-complexity model rather than operational NWP.

09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.goal: Explores whether machine learning can estimate and correct systematic model error in operational NWP, building on weak-constraint 4D-Var model-error estimation.
09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.architecture: Artificial neural networks trained to predict model error (as estimated from analysis increments / weak-constraint 4D-Var) from the model state, then used within the weak-constraint 4D-Var framework.
09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.data: ECMWF IFS operational configuration: analysis and forecast fields and associated model-error estimates.
09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.result: ANNs reproduce the main results of weak-constraint 4D-Var model-error estimation and could extend model-error correction from the stratosphere to the whole atmospheric column.
09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.open_work: Full integration of ML model-error terms in operational DA cycles, and broader integration of ML within DA and forecasting rather than purely data-driven forecasting.
09a333515122d913a768320ab768af0363d0d1c2.issues: Partly a perspective; corrections target systematic errors learned from the system's own analyses; flow-dependent random errors and tropospheric observability remain challenging.

579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.goal: Reconstructs high-dimensional chaotic dynamics from partial, noisy observations over long time series by combining data assimilation (DA) and machine learning.
579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.architecture: Bayesian framework unifying DA and ML via expectation-maximization and coordinate descent, jointly estimating the surrogate model, state trajectory and model-error statistics; approximate implementations discussed.
579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.data: Synthetic observations from two low-order chaotic models with distinct identifiability properties.
579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.result: The approach successfully recovers dynamics, states and error statistics in both test models.
579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.open_work: Scaling to realistic geophysical models and observation systems, and handling unresolved scales.
579f1824fec2ca5206bed5bafe6f17cf4c0ec7be.issues: Tested only on low-order models with synthetic data; computational cost and identifiability in high dimensions remain open.

942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.goal: Provides labeled data and a deep learning method for precise detection of tropical cyclones (TCs) and atmospheric rivers (ARs), since heuristic detection algorithms disagree strongly.
942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.architecture: ClimateNet: community-sourced, expert-labeled segmentation dataset plus a semantic segmentation CNN (DeepLabv3+-style) for pixel-level TC/AR/background classification.
942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.data: High-resolution CAM5.1 climate model output for a recent historical period (labeled), applied to historical and climate-change scenario CAM5.1 simulations.
942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.result: The trained model accurately segments TCs and ARs and enables event-conditioned statistics, e.g. regional distributions of extreme precipitation attributed to TCs or ARs.
942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.open_work: Extending to more event types and to observations and reanalysis via transfer learning; growing the labeled dataset.
942de27e7294a8e14d9449a68112a1bc4000e2ee.issues: Labels are subjective and limited in number; trained on a single model's simulations, so transfer to other models or reanalysis is untested here.

f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.goal: Addresses instability and poor generalization of data-driven subgrid-scale (SGS) models for large-eddy simulation (LES) in online use.
f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.architecture: Deep fully convolutional neural networks predicting SGS forcing from resolved fields, with transfer learning to new flows.
f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.data: DNS of 2D decaying turbulence, filtered and coarse-grained; transfer to flows with 16x higher Reynolds number.
f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.result: With enough training samples the LES-CNN is stable and accurate a posteriori; instabilities trace to poor capture of backscatter with small training sets; retraining on about 1% new data enables accurate LES at 16x higher Re.
f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.open_work: Extension to 3D, forced, and geophysical (e.g. rotating, stratified) turbulence and to more complex flows.
f3ecb56df19db23f63bbabeb8ef65312870cce77.issues: Idealized 2D decaying turbulence; requires large training sets for stability; generalization still needs some data from the target flow.

d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.goal: Tests replacing the costly gas-phase chemistry integrator of an atmospheric chemistry transport model with a machine-learning surrogate.
d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.architecture: Random forest regression per transported species, predicting post-integrator concentration (change for long-lived, absolute for short-lived species), with chemical families (NOx).
d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.data: One month (July 2013) of GEOS-Chem v10 output of chemical and physical state.
d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.result: Online ozone errors grow slowly: after 5 days NMB 4.2%, RMSE 35%, R2 0.9; after 30 days 13%, 67%, 0.75. Polluted regions are within 10%, but some species (inorganic bromine, short-lived nitrogen) have very large errors.
d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.open_work: Optimizing speed and implementation, improving error accumulation in remote regions, and operational air quality applications.
d09dec44df425332aa9e4c9073c9aebe57408c86.issues: Proof-of-concept is 1.8x slower than the numerical integrator; one month of training data; errors accumulate in remote areas and for several species; no mass conservation guarantees.

0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.goal: Develops a stochastic, data-driven parameterization of mesoscale ocean eddy momentum forcing for coarse climate models.
0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.architecture: CNN predicting mean and standard deviation of a Gaussian distribution of subgrid momentum forcing from coarse surface velocities, trained with a negative log-likelihood loss.
0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.data: Coarse-grained surface velocities from selected subdomains of the high-resolution CM2.6 coupled climate model; tests on global ocean and increased-CO2 climate.
0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.result: Offline, the parameterization generalizes to the global ocean and to higher CO2 without retraining; implemented in an idealized eddy-permitting shallow water model it is stable and improves some flow statistics.
0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.open_work: Implementation in full ocean general circulation models and multi-layer settings; better spatial/temporal correlation of the stochastic noise.
0b99855af8f93a6e0c06c1982dc1a0acc012531d.issues: Surface-only training data; online test only in an idealized shallow water model; Gaussian, spatially uncorrelated noise assumption.

6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.goal: Reduces systematic biases in a coarse weather/climate model by learning corrective tendencies from a hindcast nudged toward observational analysis.
6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.architecture: Random forest predicting nudging tendencies of temperature, humidity and horizontal winds from the column model state, coupled online to FV3GFS at each timestep.
6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.data: Coarse-resolution (about 200 km) FV3GFS hindcast nudged toward an observational (GFS) analysis.
6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.result: Year-long coupled runs are stable; short-term forecast errors in 500 hPa height, surface pressure and near-surface temperature drop significantly and annual-mean precipitation RMSE falls about 20%.
6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.open_work: Better ML models (e.g. neural networks), reference data from storm-resolving simulations, and fixing drifts in the upper atmosphere.
6d2eb065d7e9a57ab17d3d14ff63a09063c5d35c.issues: Nudging tendencies predicted with only moderate skill; some biases unchanged or worsened (e.g. upper-atmospheric temperature); targets inherit analysis errors.

4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.goal: Tackles instabilities and biases of offline-trained neural network parameterizations once coupled to Earth system models.
4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.architecture: Coupled online learning: a pretrained NN parameterization runs alongside a high-resolution simulation kept in sync by nudging, so the NN learns from tendencies at the states it produces.
4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.data: Lorenz 96 two-scale model; algorithms also described for 3D cloud-resolving models and superparameterization.
4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.result: In Lorenz 96, coupled learning recovers the true parameterization; detailed implementation algorithms for realistic models are presented.
4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.open_work: Implementing coupled learning in actual cloud-resolving or superparameterized climate models; challenges left open are discussed.
4a75dbcf67f2fc60e2fb49b52a7f406151f0e20e.issues: Demonstrated only in a toy model; running high-resolution models in parallel is expensive; nudging may affect the learned tendencies.

3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.goal: Improves fast 24 h tropical cyclone track forecasts with deep learning as a complement to dynamical and statistical models.
3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.architecture: Fused neural network combining past trajectory data with reanalysis wind and pressure 3D fields in a storm-centered moving frame, predicting latitude/longitude displacement.
3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.data: Over 3,000 storms from both hemispheres since 1979 at 6 h frequency, with aligned reanalysis fields.
3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.result: The fused network outperforms single-input variants and is competitive/complementary with current forecast models, producing forecasts in seconds.
3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.open_work: Longer lead times, intensity forecasting, and use of operational analyses/forecast fields as inputs.
3c55eb89ccfe143a1d1fb7cf37143ffbf5c29d81.issues: Only 24 h lead time; reanalysis inputs are not available in real time; specific error numbers not reported in the abstract.

4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.goal: Quantifies the meteorological contribution to surface ozone increases in China during 2015–2019.
4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.architecture: Random forest regression and ridge regression (with local and nonlocal meteorological predictors), compared with multiple linear and stepwise regression.
4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.data: Surface ozone observations across China, April–October 2015–2019, with meteorological predictor variables (reanalysis).
4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.result: RFR achieves R2 0.5–0.6 versus 0.4–0.5 for linear methods; nonlocal predictors raise RR R2 in southern China from 0.47 to 0.6; hot, dry, sunny conditions and surface solar radiation dominate; nearly half of 2015–2019 ozone trends may be meteorology-driven.
4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.open_work: Applying the framework under climate change and extremes (heatwaves) and separating emission versus meteorology effects more robustly.
4e84f862760397264df48b4f90c485b431d6721a.issues: Statistical attribution with modest R2; meteorology and emissions may covary; short five-year record.

7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.goal: Provides 1-month-ahead Arctic sea ice concentration (SIC) prediction for applications like shipping and fisheries.
7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.architecture: Convolutional neural network with eight predictors, compared to a random forest model and a trend-based persistence model.
7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.data: Satellite passive microwave SIC and reanalysis meteorological and oceanographic variables; hindcast validation.
7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.result: CNN achieves MAE 2.28%, ACC 0.98, RMSE 5.76% versus RF RMSE 6.61% and persistence 10.54%; 2007 and 2012 extreme declines predicted with RMSE below 5%; past SIC is the most important predictor.
7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.open_work: Longer lead times and seasonal forecasting; better skill in the marginal ice zone.
7f76c15554df3f6c12f8c37ba0ff13cf06737dff.issues: Only 1-month lead, where persistence-type information dominates; high ACC partly reflects the seasonal cycle; reanalysis inputs limit real-time use.

5f2b5dbfdd9d2df6e5e4bf022b30345ba822cd5d.goal: Reviews and argues for the transformative role of AI in weather forecasting, climate monitoring and decadal prediction.
5f2b5dbfdd9d2df6e5e4bf022b30345ba822cd5d.architecture: Review/perspective of AI techniques applied across weather forecasting, climate monitoring and decadal prediction; no new model.
5f2b5dbfdd9d2df6e5e4bf022b30345ba822cd5d.result: AI can reduce development effort, use computing more efficiently and improve forecast quality; argues for training scientists combining atmospheric and AI expertise.
5f2b5dbfdd9d2df6e5e4bf022b30345ba822cd5d.open_work: Integration of AI as a cornerstone of observation and modelling systems; workforce training.
5f2b5dbfdd9d2df6e5e4bf022b30345ba822cd5d.issues: Perspective piece with optimistic framing; no new quantitative evaluation.

5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.goal: Tests whether anthropogenic climate change is already detectable in daily precipitation variability despite large natural fluctuations.
5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.architecture: CNN trained to predict annual global mean surface air temperature from daily precipitation fields, analyzed with an explainable AI framework.
5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.data: Ensemble of present-day and future climate model simulations for training; applied to observed daily precipitation records.
5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.result: Observed daily precipitation predicts planetary warming and departs clearly from natural variability since the mid-2010s; sub-10-day variability over the tropical eastern Pacific and midlatitude storm tracks is most sensitive.
5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.open_work: Regional attribution of extremes and testing robustness across observational datasets and models.
5bbf223f789afb6489c897e3c75a127acc839ae4.issues: Relies on climate models to represent forced and natural precipitation variability correctly; observational dataset uncertainties; detection is indirect via temperature prediction.

0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.goal: Builds a cheap emulator of a regional climate model (RCM) to enlarge high-resolution downscaled ensembles for uncertainty exploration.
0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.architecture: Hybrid downscaling: a neural network (U-Net-type) learns the RCM's downscaling function from large-scale predictors to daily near-surface temperature at 12 km.
0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.data: RCM simulations (CNRM-ALADIN over a European domain driven by a GCM) for historical and future climate.
0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.result: The emulator reproduces spatial structure and daily variability of the RCM well; training on future climate is key; training takes about 2 h on GPU and prediction under a minute.
0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.open_work: Better reproduction of temperature extremes and climate change intensity; extension to other regions, GCMs, RCMs and variables.
0f154545deb52db9c73243af2572e8d9650f144c.issues: Underestimates some extremes and climate change signal; single RCM/variable; emulates the RCM, so inherits its biases.

4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.goal: Corrects a coarse-grid global model toward a global storm-resolving model to reduce biases in regional precipitation and temperature.
4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.architecture: ML (neural nets and random forests) of nudging tendencies of temperature, humidity and optionally winds from column state; also learns downwelling radiative surface fluxes.
4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.data: FV3GFS at 200 km nudged to a 40-day X-SHiELD 3 km reference simulation with the same historical SSTs.
4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.result: Best setup corrects temperature and humidity only; 850 hPa temperature forecasts gain 18 h of skill at 3–7 day leads and time-mean precipitation patterns improve 30%; neural nets slightly beat random forests.
4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.open_work: Longer training sets, multiple climates, and stable inclusion of wind corrections.
4563684b1aca30bc8ceda72f02f33122670e43ec.issues: Only 40 days of reference data; wind corrections degrade time-mean upper tropospheric fields; generalization to other climates is untested.

aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.goal: Generates large ensembles of spatially resolved land temperature at negligible cost to emulate Earth system model (ESM) runs for uncertainty propagation.
aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.architecture: MESMER: modular statistical emulator with global mean temperature, local temperature response, and local residual variability modules (not deep learning).
aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.data: Yearly land temperature 1870–2100 from 40 CMIP5 models; single-model initial-condition ensembles for validation.
aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.result: Training on one ESM run suffices to mimic initial-condition ensembles at grid-point to regional scales; a superensemble of 40 CMIP5 emulators is built and suggests investing in multi-model rather than large single-model ensembles.
aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.open_work: Extension to other variables (e.g. precipitation), sub-annual timescales, ocean, and CMIP6.
aea35da72b7da3b2f91955529be0fa3537e8d132.issues: Yearly land temperature only; separate calibration per ESM; statistical assumptions on residual variability may miss nonlinear changes.

67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.goal: Combines accuracy of detailed bin warm-rain microphysics with the cost of a bulk scheme in a GCM by using neural network emulation.
67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.architecture: Two-stage neural networks: a classifier identifies where autoconversion and accretion tendencies are nonzero (and sign), then a regressor predicts magnitudes.
67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.data: Output from CAM6 running the bin (TAU) microphysics for warm rain; perfect-model experiments.
67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.result: Bin microphysics improves rain onset and light-rain frequency and changes cloud feedback; the emulators recover the bin-model solution in almost all respects at the control simulation's cost (bin scheme alone is 400% slower).
67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.open_work: Applying to other microphysical processes and ice; guarding against extrapolation under climate change.
67cb4a5f70c7ac67dbd7a43b643502c46dbdeba0.issues: Risks of overfitting, extrapolation and linearization; emulates a model, not observations; tested in perfect-model setting.

a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.goal: Systematically benchmarks online performance and generalization of ML ocean subgrid parameterizations.
a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.architecture: Framework comparing physical and NN-based parameterizations; also proposes equation discovery combining linear regression and genetic programming with spatial derivatives.
a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.data: Idealized two-layer quasi-geostrophic model (pyqg) in eddy and jet configurations, with various filtering and coarse-graining operators.
a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.result: Filter/coarse-graining choice is critical; physics-constrained NNs are stable online but generalize poorly to new regimes; equation discovery matches NNs in-domain and generalizes better.
a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.open_work: Testing in more realistic ocean models and regimes; community use of released code and data for new parameterizations.
a68369415bb6949768ed39eac7c585b09a21e536.issues: Idealized QG setting; limited regimes; results may not carry over to primitive-equation models.

a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.goal: Identifies subseasonal forecasts of opportunity for North Atlantic midlatitude circulation via tropical-extratropical teleconnections.
a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.architecture: Artificial neural network classifier using tropical inputs, with prediction confidence to select opportunities and layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) for explanation.
a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.data: Tropical input fields and North Atlantic (40°N, 325°E) circulation target at 22-day lead; the dataset source is not reported in the abstract.
a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.result: Higher-confidence predictions are more accurate; LRP highlights tropical hot spots matching known teleconnection source regions and suggests a new pattern.
a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.open_work: Testing in observations/reanalysis and other regions and leads; using opportunities in operational subseasonal forecasts.
a747c317c846b2dff84d7b0358b6ea0d66e25347.issues: Classification of sign only at a single location; LRP interpretations can be method-sensitive.

b9790614aa73636c9fb53a11c00f6f11596790f9.goal: Extends ENSO warm-phase prediction skill beyond 6 months to up to 1 year.
b9790614aa73636c9fb53a11c00f6f11596790f9.architecture: Hybrid of ARIMA and an artificial neural network with attributes derived from physical knowledge and climate network topological properties.
b9790614aa73636c9fb53a11c00f6f11596790f9.result: Up to 6 months the hybrid is slightly better than the NCEP CFSv2 ensemble; 12-month lead skill is similar to shorter leads.
b9790614aa73636c9fb53a11c00f6f11596790f9.open_work: Robust evaluation over more events and assessment of the spring predictability barrier.
b9790614aa73636c9fb53a11c00f6f11596790f9.issues: Short observational record risks overfitting; limited verification sample of El Niño events; skill measures not detailed in the abstract.

1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.goal: Assesses ML emulation as an accelerator of parameterization schemes in operational weather forecasting, focusing on non-orographic gravity wave drag.
1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.architecture: Neural network emulators (various complexities) of the non-orographic gravity wave drag scheme in the ECMWF IFS.
1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.data: Training data from the IFS parameterization, including a higher-complexity version of the scheme.
1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.result: Emulators are stable and accurate up to seasonal timescales; training on the more complex scheme gives more accurate forecasts; on GPU they are 10x faster than the CPU scheme, but similar cost on CPU.
1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.open_work: Extending to other parameterizations and GPU-accelerated operational systems.
1a2082d67303cc0e42dd8f14e9b8fc1632963875.issues: No speedup on current CPU hardware due to data movement; emulates an existing scheme rather than learning new physics.

8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.goal: Learns forecast models of chaotic systems from noisy observations by combining machine learning and data assimilation.
8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.architecture: Random feature map surrogate model learned sequentially within an ensemble Kalman filter.
8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.data: Synthetic noisy observations from low-dimensional chaotic and multi-scale systems (e.g. Lorenz-63).
8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.result: The learned model has remarkably good forecast skill and low cost, yields reliable probabilistic ensembles, and can learn effective closures in multi-scale systems.
8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional systems, e.g. using localization.
8da1bd7f22177506e08d50b0be9a000105506862.issues: Low-dimensional toy systems only; random feature models may not scale to geophysical dimensions.

705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.goal: Tests whether AI weather models reproduce the rapid growth of small initial-condition errors (butterfly effect) that limits predictability.
705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.architecture: Perturbation experiments with an AI-based weather model (Pangu-Weather) compared with physics-based numerical model simulations; not a new ML method.
705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.data: Initial conditions from ECMWF analyses, with small- and analysis-uncertainty-size perturbations.
705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.result: The AI model fails to reproduce rapid initial growth of small perturbations, implying unlimited predictability; for realistic-size perturbations it largely agrees with physical models, with some deficits.
705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.open_work: Training or designing AI models that capture small-scale error growth, and caution in using them for predictability studies.
705c18f88c242defc6feae49304e7a085f15b37c.issues: Single AI model and limited case set; coarse 0.25° resolution may itself suppress small-scale growth.

2bde1fe9f0f3c9a3294d8f4018ac1d80c43a5f17.goal: Builds a scalable, calibrated probabilistic ML ensemble weather model that respects spherical geometry and keeps realistic spectra.
2bde1fe9f0f3c9a3294d8f4018ac1d80c43a5f17.architecture: Purely convolutional spherical neural network (spherical neural operator style) trained as a probabilistic ensemble generator, with model- and data-parallel training inspired by domain decomposition.
2bde1fe9f0f3c9a3294d8f4018ac1d80c43a5f17.result: Accuracy surpasses leading conventional ensembles and rivals diffusion models while 8–60x faster; well calibrated with stable spectra to 60 days; 90-day global forecast in under 20 s on one GPU.
2bde1fe9f0f3c9a3294d8f4018ac1d80c43a5f17.open_work: Operational early warning use, large ensembles, and subseasonal applications.
2bde1fe9f0f3c9a3294d8f4018ac1d80c43a5f17.issues: Preprint; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; evaluation against ERA5; subseasonal skill not quantified in the abstract.

9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.goal: Simplifies construction of tangent-linear and adjoint models for 4D-Var by using differentiable neural network emulators of parameterizations.
9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.architecture: Neural network emulator of the non-orographic gravity wave drag scheme, differentiated to obtain tangent-linear and adjoint versions.
9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.data: ECMWF IFS parameterization inputs/outputs; 4D-Var assimilation experiments.
9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.result: NN-derived tangent-linear and adjoint models pass standard consistency tests and work successfully in 4D-Var data assimilation.
9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.open_work: Applying to more complex, nonsmooth schemes (convection, clouds) and operational maintenance.
9d02a6c6516dec20b0bf8bd9e9a87b4121b17e82.issues: Demonstrated for a single, relatively smooth scheme; accuracy depends on emulator quality and smoothness of NN gradients.

3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.goal: Forecasts the occurrence of rare, long-lasting extreme heatwaves using deep learning trained on climate model output.
3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.architecture: CNN with large-class undersampling and transfer learning across intensity thresholds.
3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.data: 1,000 years of climate model output (PlaSim) of surface temperature and 500 hPa geopotential height; heatwaves over France.
3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.result: The network forecasts long-lasting extreme heatwaves at three intensity levels up to 15 days before onset.
3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.open_work: Use as a proxy for rare-event resampling, climate change studies, and eventually real-world forecasting.
3ac75686e1a51c5a16a3be119f57fdbf0b0badea.issues: Intermediate-complexity model; not tested on observations; class imbalance and limited number of extreme events.

944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.goal: Provides a large dataset to train and benchmark ML emulators of subgrid physics for hybrid physics-ML climate models.
