944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.architecture: Dataset and benchmark: input-output pairs of multi-scale model physics, with baseline ML emulators (e.g. MLP, CNN, others).
944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.data: E3SM-MMF multiscale climate model simulations (low- and high-resolution versions), billions of samples.
944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.result: Releases the largest such dataset with baseline models and metrics for offline emulation.
944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.open_work: Online (coupled) testing of emulators and stability; physical constraints.
944d40b77d55b40967edb28dffb511c07b7cc847.issues: Benchmark mainly offline; abstract truncated in input; online performance not ensured by offline scores.

abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.goal: Builds a single pretrained foundation model that can be fine-tuned cheaply for several Earth-system forecasting tasks instead of training a separate model for each.
abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.architecture: Aurora: about 1.3B-parameter 3D Swin Transformer U-Net backbone with Perceiver-based encoder and decoder that handle variable sets, levels and resolutions; pretrained, then fine-tuned per task.
abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.data: Pretraining on over a million hours of heterogeneous data (ERA5, CMIP6, operational analyses and forecasts such as IFS HRES and GFS, MERRA-2); fine-tuning on CAMS air quality, HRES-WAM ocean waves, tropical cyclone tracks and 0.1° IFS HRES weather.
abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.result: Outperforms operational systems on most targets: CAMS air quality (about 74% of targets), HRES-WAM waves (about 86%), official tropical cyclone track forecasts, and 0.1° HRES weather (about 92%), at orders of magnitude lower inference cost.
abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.open_work: Probabilistic and ensemble fine-tuning, initialization directly from observations rather than NWP analyses, and extension to more Earth-system components.
abe17b901b8644777360276cf1280c0172eaff01.issues: Deterministic forecasts; pretraining is computationally expensive; fine-tuned models still depend on operational analyses for initial conditions; fine-tuning skill varies by task and data availability.

6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.goal: Argues how integrated AI can strengthen multi-hazard early warning systems for complex climate risks, covering hazard forecasting, risk communication and decision support.
6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.architecture: Review and perspective, not a new model; discusses meteorological and geospatial foundation models, causal AI, generative methods and climate ensembles for impact-based warnings.
6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.data: No new data; draws on the literature on AI weather and Earth observation foundation models, climate ensembles and early warning practice.
6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.result: Advocates user-centric, causal and responsible AI guided by FATES principles, and proposes decadal early warning systems built on climate ensembles and generative models.
6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.open_work: Building and validating integrated impact models, causal approaches that avoid spurious predictions, and operational decadal warning systems with community feedback.
6d6db2763b8b38d9b42cd3e5a98b025fba43f3fb.issues: Perspective without quantitative evaluation; proposed systems and governance principles remain largely untested in operational settings.

4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.goal: Downscales coarse Earth system model fields to high resolution cheaply and probabilistically, without retraining for each ESM and while extrapolating to unseen climates.
4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.architecture: Generative consistency model (related to diffusion models) applied zero-shot to arbitrary ESM output, giving probabilistic downscaled fields with controllable scale adaptation.
4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.data: Observational reference data at high resolution for training; applied to Earth system model simulations including future climate states. Exact products not detailed in the abstract.
4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion models at a fraction of the computational cost, stays controllable, and generalizes to climate states unseen in training without explicit physical constraints.
4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.open_work: Extending to more variables and multivariate consistency, and testing across more ESMs, regions and extreme statistics.
4752159e0bdbb8ed44dda8c07c3bf05b3b454d1d.issues: Resolution is bounded by the observational reference; zero-shot transfer assumes the ESM-to-observation mapping is learnable without bias correction, and physical consistency is not enforced.

a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.goal: Tests whether ML weather prediction models forecast rare, high-impact extremes and compound impacts as well as operational NWP, beyond standard benchmark scores.
a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.architecture: Evaluation study comparing GraphCast (graph neural network), Pangu-Weather and FourCastNet (transformer/neural operator models) with ECMWF HRES through impact-centric case studies.
a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.data: Case studies of the 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave, the 2023 South Asian humid heatwave and the 2021 North American winter storm; forecasts verified against reanalysis or analysis fields.
a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.result: ML models match HRES locally on the Pacific Northwest heatwave but underperform when aggregated over space and time, forecast the compound winter storm substantially better, and underestimate humid-heat danger over Bangladesh.
a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.open_work: Wider case-study-driven, impact-centric verification of ML models, and adding the variables needed for health-risk metrics such as humid heat.
a56fa541e1be2053e33a1dad8d08708b7a4e0035.issues: Only three events, so conclusions are not statistically general; ML models lack key variables (humidity-related heat indices), requiring substitute variables.

94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.goal: Removes the fine-scale smoothing that MSE training causes in data-driven weather models through the double-penalty effect.
94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.architecture: Parameter-free modified spherical harmonic loss that separates decorrelation error from spectral amplitude error, used to fine-tune GraphCast, a graph neural network.
94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.data: GraphCast fine-tuned on ERA5 reanalysis; evaluated on global medium-range forecasts including tropical cyclones and surface wind extremes.
94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.result: Produces sharp deterministic forecasts, raising effective resolution from 1,250 km to 160 km, improving ensemble spread and tropical cyclone strength and surface wind extreme predictions.
94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.open_work: Applying the loss to other architectures and to training from scratch, and assessing its effect on probabilistic and longer-range forecasts.
94bf58425706ae1a5964381df2649fb893bfd91f.issues: Sharper fields may raise RMSE relative to MSE-trained models; demonstrated mainly through fine-tuning a single model.

6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.goal: Builds a single data-driven framework that provides both global and high-resolution regional weather forecasts, with better extreme event prediction and less smoothing.
6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.architecture: Graph neural network with multi-scale mesh graphs densified over the target region, adaptive message passing with dynamic gating units, and a neural nested grid method for regional boundaries.
6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.data: Reanalysis data, presumably ERA5, for global forecasts plus regional high-resolution data; exact datasets and periods are not given in the abstract.
6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.result: Performs well from global to regional scales and from short to long lead times, especially for extreme events, according to the authors.
6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.open_work: Operational regional deployment, probabilistic extensions, and tests on more regions and extreme event types.
6458c5ee2f994bea2d05c76c360f9df1add97869.issues: Abstract gives no quantitative scores or baselines; nested regional forecasts depend on global model boundary information.

cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.goal: Systematically compares ways to turn a deterministic data-driven weather model into calibrated probabilistic forecasts.
cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.architecture: Pangu-Weather (transformer) combined with initial-condition perturbation ensembles and with post-hoc statistical and machine learning uncertainty quantification methods.
cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.data: Pangu-Weather trained on ERA5 reanalysis; medium-range case study over Europe for selected variables, compared with the ECMWF ensemble.
cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.result: Pangu-Weather with uncertainty quantification methods gives probabilistic forecasts that improve on the ECMWF physics-based ensemble for lead times up to 5 days.
cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.open_work: Extending to more variables, regions and longer leads, and to multivariate and spatially coherent uncertainty.
cb892cb212f4808f4f5b823d843de6bdab168625.issues: Advantage holds only up to about 5 days; limited regional and variable scope; post-hoc methods may not give physically coherent ensembles.

6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.goal: Tests whether AI weather models learn physically meaningful dynamics by using them for initial-condition sensitivity analysis of an extreme cyclone.
6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.architecture: Backpropagation gradients of a forecast metric through an AI weather model with respect to initial fields, compared with an adjoint of a dynamical NWP model.
6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.data: Cyclone Xynthia (2010) case at 36-hour lead time; the AI model is trained on reanalysis. Specific model and data products are not named in the abstract.
6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.result: AI-model sensitivities closely resemble adjoint sensitivities, and evolved perturbations produce similar impacts, indicating physically meaningful learned spatio-temporal links.
6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.open_work: Using AI gradients for observing network design and dynamics studies at nonlinear lead times beyond 5 days.
6b0d5e3eb445526a047868c7a341b4d02c85c14d.issues: Single case study at one lead time; agreement with an adjoint does not prove physical realism in general.

e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.goal: Combines the large-scale skill of AI weather models with the fine-scale detail and full variable set of physics-based NWP.
e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.architecture: Hybrid NWP-AI system: the GEM model's temperature and horizontal winds are spectrally nudged at large scales toward GraphCast (graph neural network) forecasts.
e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.data: Global forecasts from the Canadian GEM model and GraphCast; verification against analyses in physical and spectral space and tropical cyclone tracks.
e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.result: GraphCast large scales beat GEM at longer leads; the hybrid improves GEM skill, keeps a full power spectrum and physically consistent fields, and improves tropical cyclone tracks without changing intensity.
e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.open_work: Operationalization of the hybrid system at the Canadian Meteorological Centre.
e02766d1fef06c1d4edfd127ad7cfae2285f62d6.issues: Fine scales still come from GEM so its biases remain; tropical cyclone intensity is not improved; depends on the AI model's large-scale accuracy.

47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.goal: Improves deep learning tropical cyclone track and intensity forecasts by providing an open multimodal dataset and a meteorology-informed model.
47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.architecture: Benchmark dataset (TCND) plus deep learning model TCNM with modules such as a Generator Chooser Network and Environment-Time Net, integrating meteorological knowledge.
47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.data: TCND: 70 years of multi-source tropical cyclone data across six ocean basins, combining best-track records with environmental fields. Exact source products are not detailed in the abstract.
47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.result: TCNM outperforms existing deep learning methods and official meteorological forecasts on multiple track and intensity metrics.
47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.open_work: Community use of the released dataset and model to advance data-driven tropical cyclone prediction, including rapid intensification.
47c1dbce7a81647d549a21e4fb8c227415c51037.issues: Abstract gives no numerical skill; comparison with official forecasts may depend on lead time, basin and inputs available in real time.

03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.goal: Assesses whether an ML weather model trained on reanalysis can produce skilful global seasonal forecasts.
03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.architecture: ACE2, an autoregressive ML atmosphere emulator (spherical Fourier neural operator) with 6-hourly steps, run as a lagged ensemble with persisted SST and sea-ice anomalies.
03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.data: ACE2 trained on ERA5; seasonal hindcasts initialised around 1 November for winters 1993/94 to 2015/16, compared with a leading physics-based seasonal system.
03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.result: Skilful winter NAO prediction (correlation 0.47, p = 0.02), realistic skill distribution and spread, predictability patterns like the physics model, and a signal-to-noise error.
03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.open_work: Coupling to an interactive ocean, better representing extremes beyond the training data, and studying the signal-to-noise paradox with ML models.
03f09f2ccd7542f6ed935ea2c07a61b481984a4c.issues: Persisted SST and sea-ice anomalies; limited skill for extreme seasons outside training data such as winter 2009/2010; only one start date per year.

b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.goal: Improves NOAA's ERSST reconstruction, especially low SST variability in data-sparse regions before the 1950s.
b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) interpolation replacing the empirical orthogonal teleconnection method, with the 3-month running average removed.
b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.data: In situ SST observations (ICOADS-based) used to build ERSSTv6; evaluated against validation, testing and observation datasets and compared with ERSSTv5.
b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.result: Spatial correlation with observations rises by 5% and RMSD falls by 0.03°C relative to ERSSTv5, with larger gains in the tropical Pacific and 30°S–60°S.
b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.open_work: Part II addresses the low skill against in situ observations after the 1970s; further uncertainty quantification of the reconstruction.
b9c47a5594f61d46218a64a36f67e01648f3d6b6.issues: Improvements are modest; reconstruction in sparse early periods remains uncertain and depends on training-period covariances.

a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.goal: Develops a high-resolution data-driven limited area model for surface weather forecasting, an area much less studied than global AI models.
a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.architecture: YingLong-weather, a deep learning limited area model with parallel global-local structures for multiscale features, driven by global AI model forecasts as lateral boundaries.
a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.data: Trained on high-resolution (3 km, hourly) regional analysis data over two limited areas; specific analysis product not named in the abstract.
a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.result: Beats dynamical models for surface wind speed but underperforms for surface temperature and pressure, which reach comparable skill with better lateral boundary conditions.
a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.open_work: Better lateral boundary conditions, optimal boundary width and blending of fine and coarse predictions, and expansion to more variables and regions.
a3953b81bef032d94f8572d5bddd657ecc98773a.issues: Skill depends strongly on boundary conditions; only two domains; weaker for temperature and pressure.

208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.goal: Builds a fast, stable ML emulator of the CAM6 atmosphere to generate large climate ensembles cheaply.
208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.architecture: Autoregressive deep learning emulator predicting the next atmospheric state given prescribed SST and solar forcing, with explicit conservation of dry air mass, moisture and total energy.
208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.data: CAM6 simulations with prescribed sea surface temperatures; evaluated on climatology, variability modes and out-of-distribution SST forcing.
208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.result: Stable over indefinite integrations, reproduces CAM6 climatology and ENSO, NAO and PNA with slightly muted variability, at 350 times speedup.
208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.open_work: Adding interactive land and sea ice, reducing the cold bias under new forcing, and coupling to other components.
208f8e7af710253af184007974dd04655042398d.issues: Systematic high-latitude cold bias under out-of-distribution SST, especially boreal winter; slightly muted variability; emulates CAM6 so inherits its biases.

1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.goal: Surveys deep learning and foundation models for weather prediction to organize a fast-growing field.
1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.architecture: Review organized by training paradigm: deterministic predictive learning, probabilistic generative learning, and pre-training plus fine-tuning, covering transformer, graph neural network, diffusion and other architectures.
1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.data: No new data; summarizes benchmark datasets such as ERA5 and WeatherBench and provides a curated repository of papers and code.
1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.result: Synthesizes strengths and limitations of each paradigm and offers a categorized resource of papers, open-source code and benchmarks.
1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.open_work: New tasks and models, weather data storage and management, and operational deployment of foundation models.
1b532dca0c4e950589510af7c23e033344c0de07.issues: Literature review without new experiments; coverage may date quickly in a rapidly moving field.

f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.goal: Builds a data-driven 3D global ocean model for seasonal to decadal prediction, where numerical models remain costly and limited.
f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.architecture: ORCA-DL, a deep learning three-dimensional global ocean model; the specific network family is not stated in the abstract.
f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.data: Global ocean training data from simulations and/or reanalysis; specific products and periods are not given in the abstract.
f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.result: Simulates 3D ocean structure with high physical consistency, outperforms state-of-the-art numerical models on ENSO and upper-ocean heatwaves, and stays stable at decadal scales.
f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.open_work: Skilful decadal predictions and climate projections, and coupling with atmospheric components.
f43048bca38ac1250c542551df93e6e91d30f343.issues: Decadal and projection skill is suggested rather than fully demonstrated; reliance on limited ocean observations and reanalysis for training.

9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.goal: Produces physically balanced atmospheric analyses without hand-tuned covariances by doing data assimilation in a learned latent space.
9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.architecture: Latent data assimilation: Bayesian DA performed in the latent space of an autoencoder trained on multivariate global atmospheric states.
9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.data: Multivariate global atmospheric data, likely ERA5 reanalysis, with idealized and real observations; exact products not named in the abstract.
9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.result: Latent DA yields balanced analyses and improves analysis quality and forecast skill over model-space DA, robust across latent dimensions and with autoencoders trained on imperfect forecasts.
9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.open_work: Operational-scale tests with full observing systems and coupling with ML forecast models in cycled systems.
9cfd8013a44b1d9bea90d0603a2cd566d5ec5132.issues: Autoencoder reconstruction error bounds analysis accuracy; balance is learned rather than guaranteed; comparison against traditional DA configurations may be limited.

5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.goal: Builds a fully coupled ML climate emulator of atmosphere, ocean and sea ice for fast centuries-long simulations.
5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.architecture: SamudrACE couples the ACE2 atmosphere emulator (spherical Fourier neural operator) and the Samudra 3D ocean emulator (convolutional U-Net style), exchanging fluxes like a traditional coupler.
5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.data: Trained on output of a physics-based coupled climate model (GFDL CM4); 1° resolution, 6-hourly atmosphere and 5-daily ocean, 145 2D fields.
5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.result: Highly stable over centuries with low climate biases comparable to uncoupled components, and realistic coupled variability including ENSO.
5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.open_work: Response to changing forcings such as CO2, extension to other components, and training on observations.
5729e55645513008b62ecc9071181b26e5d35799.issues: Emulates a single climate model so inherits its biases; generalization to forced climate change is not shown in the abstract.

0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.goal: Examines how internal variability affects benchmarking of deep learning climate emulators on ClimateBench.
0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.architecture: Comparison of deep learning emulators, including the ClimaX transformer foundation model, with linear pattern scaling regression.
0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.data: ClimateBench (NorESM2 scenario runs) and a new benchmark with 50-member ensemble means from MPI-ESM1.2-LR.
0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.result: Linear pattern scaling beats ClimaX on 3 of 4 variables; deep learning overfits internal variability; with ensemble-mean targets, deep learning wins on precipitation but not temperature.
0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.open_work: Benchmarks that account for internal variability with large ensembles, and emulators that represent variability rather than only means.
0bcd751ec4642ded553e5a734e6c7e512311d8e6.issues: Results limited to a few models and variables; emulators target annual regional means, not extremes or daily variability.

b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.goal: Tests whether AI weather models can forecast unprecedented record-breaking heat, cold and wind extremes.
b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.architecture: Evaluation study comparing ECMWF HRES with GraphCast (graph neural network), Pangu-Weather (transformer) and FuXi, including operational versions.
b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.data: Record-breaking events identified in recent years; forecasts verified against reanalysis or analysis. Exact periods are not given in the abstract.
b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.result: HRES consistently outperforms AI models for record heat, cold and wind at nearly all leads; AI models underestimate record frequency and intensity, with errors growing with record exceedance.
b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.open_work: Rigorous verification on extremes and model development for extrapolation beyond the training range.
b7c6f4e7050c343f9584688959313f2633b9632f.issues: Limited to deterministic models in the abstract; record events are by definition rare, so samples are limited.

d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.goal: Improves forecasting of tropical cyclone rapid intensification, which is rare and poorly predicted.
d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.architecture: Deep learning model using contrastive learning, handling sample imbalance and incorporating TC structural features from multimodal inputs.
d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.data: Satellite, atmospheric and oceanic data; tested on 1,149 TC periods in the Northwest Pacific, 2020–2021.
d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.result: 92.3% accuracy for rapid intensification and false alarm rate of 8.9%, three times lower than prior best deep learning methods.
d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.open_work: Testing in other basins and in real-time operational settings, and extending to intensity magnitude prediction.
d79efd4c01e0c0ba27593453f588f23d74943427.issues: Evaluated on two seasons in one basin; operational input latency not discussed in the abstract.

ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.goal: Makes AI weather prediction models obey global conservation of mass, moisture and energy for physical consistency.
ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.architecture: Modular physics-based conservation schemes applied during training and inference, demonstrated in FuXi, a transformer-based weather model adapted to 1° grid.
ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 1° grid spacing for training and verification.
ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.result: Forecasts obey conservation laws, skill improves for upper-air and surface variables especially at longer leads, and precipitation improves strongly via reduced drizzle bias.
ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.open_work: Implementing other physics-based schemes and integrating more atmospheric domain knowledge into AI models.
ce64bb0741b9a4538ca7b023e510306c7959c874.issues: Global-integral constraints only, not local conservation; demonstrated at coarse resolution on one architecture.

99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.goal: Calibrates the GISS ModelE3 atmosphere's physics parameters with observations to produce radiatively balanced, observationally constrained configurations.
99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.architecture: Neural network (MLP-type) surrogate of ModelE3 trained on a perturbed parameter ensemble, used in MCMC Bayesian inference to produce a calibrated physics ensemble.
99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.data: Perturbed parameter ensemble over 45 parameters and 36 outputs; global satellite products of clouds, environment and radiation with explicit treatment of product discrepancies.
99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.result: Improves shallow cumulus and Amazon rainfall without degrading radiation; product discrepancies strongly affect calibration; two configurations were used for CMIP6 submissions.
99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.open_work: Revisiting how parameter importance is judged in PPEs and extending calibration to coupled models.
99a3bd5a6cbe97284f32171e0442ea30031da590.issues: Surrogate accuracy and choice of observational targets bound calibration; parameters deemed unimportant in PPE screening were needed, complicating dimension reduction.

e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.goal: Develops efficient, physically reasonable initial perturbations for ensemble tropical cyclone track forecasts with AI weather models.
e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.architecture: Physics-constrained perturbation generator based on self-evolution dynamics of an AI weather model, conditioned on amplitude and spatial structure.
e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.data: AI weather model trained on reanalysis; tropical cyclone track cases compared with ECMWF ensemble forecasts. Specific model and cases not named in the abstract.
e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.result: AI ensemble track forecasts beat ECMWF on deterministic and probabilistic metrics; 2000-member ensembles further improve probability and extreme track scenarios.
e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.open_work: Applying the scheme to intensity and other high-impact weather and to other AI models.
e0ad98475403fcf10dd8dd1d2614b383cdbbfbec.issues: Focus on track only; perturbation dynamics are learned rather than fully physical; AI models still struggle with TC intensity.

292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.goal: Improves seasonal Arctic sea ice prediction across the spring predictability barrier.
292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.architecture: SICNetseason, a transformer-based deep learning model predicting sea ice concentration, using spring sea ice thickness as input.
292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.data: Sea ice concentration and thickness data; 2000–2019 test and 2020–2023 generalization tests, compared with ECMWF SEAS5 and persistence.
292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.result: Detrended ACC of September extent improves by 7.7% and 10.61% over SEAS5 for May and April starts, and over 41% and 36% versus persistence.
292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.open_work: Better sea ice thickness observations and extension to other seasons and Antarctic.
292c9626b8afa0d8485bc92a8c4300cb6353dc0e.issues: Relies on sea ice thickness products of limited quality; short test period; skill on extremes not detailed.

aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.goal: Builds a neural global ocean forecasting system matching physics-based systems at lower cost.
aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.architecture: GLONET, a neural network combining neural operators and networks to capture local-global interactions in a scalable framework.
aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.data: Trained on GLORYS12 reanalysis; benchmarked against Mercator's GLO12 1/12° system and another GLORYS12-trained neural system.
aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.result: Promising preliminary performance for temperature, sea surface height, salinity and currents, with tailored validation metrics beyond point-wise errors.
aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.open_work: Fuller evaluation, operational use via EDITO, and coupling to data assimilation.
aeebd50f30ecbdbd11fe7568ec41704af95cd4bb.issues: Preliminary evaluation; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; relies on GLORYS initial states.

beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.goal: Studies design choices for kilometer-scale ML limited area weather models in realistic forecasting settings.
beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.architecture: Graph neural network limited area model with rectangular and triangular mesh graphs, flexible boundary forcing and multi-step rollout training.
beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.data: Danish and Swiss km-scale domains with boundaries from reanalysis or operational forecasts; verified against gridded analyses and in situ stations, including storm Ciara 2020.
beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.result: Both models skilful across many variables; the Swiss model beats the NWP baseline for key surface variables at much lower cost.
beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.open_work: Probabilistic extensions, operational deployment and further design exploration.
beb1ee1b4f85185acbc4865a27df57784fff1227.issues: Deterministic forecasts; performance varies with domain and boundary choices; limited case studies.

b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.goal: Improves subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasting by encoding spherical geometry rather than treating weather fields as planar images.
b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.architecture: CirT, a transformer with latitude-based circular patches as tokens and Fourier transform in self-attention for spatial periodicity.
b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.data: ERA5 reanalysis for training and evaluation.
b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.result: Significantly improves over Pangu-Weather, GraphCast and ECMWF S2S systems; ablations confirm the design choices.
b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.open_work: Probabilistic S2S forecasts and extending to more variables and coupled inputs.
b9333dee582aa3bb294bcfcd6e645c0babb1a99e.issues: Deterministic predictions; S2S skill metrics and baselines not detailed in the abstract.

8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.goal: Identifies which training choices matter most for transformer-based data-driven weather prediction.
8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.architecture: Minimally modified SwinV2 transformer with systematic ablations of loss functions, model size, depth, patch size and multi-step training.
8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.data: ERA5 reanalysis; compared against ECMWF IFS deterministic forecasts.
8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.result: Off-the-shelf architecture and moderate compute beat IFS on deterministic MSE; ablations give practical guidance and scaling insights.
8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting, larger-scale scaling studies and metrics beyond RMSE and ACC.
8abc0c34f3febec302eccf2012f83fe6cde1ab06.issues: Deterministic MSE-trained models smooth fine scales; results tied to ERA5 resolution.

d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.goal: Unifies data assimilation, weather prediction and climate simulation in one generative ML framework that avoids long-rollout error accumulation.
d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.architecture: GAP, a deep generative model learning the distribution of atmospheric states under observational, predictive and forcing constraints.
d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.data: Reanalysis atmospheric data and observations; specific products not named in the abstract.
d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.result: Competitive with state-of-the-art ensemble assimilation, probabilistic weather forecasts and seasonal prediction; stable millennial simulations reproducing daily to decadal variability.
d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.open_work: Coupling with ocean components and operational assimilation with real observing systems.
d3b94e398c99e583c97022f653031c4437c273c5.issues: Details of observations and benchmarks not given in the abstract; climate response to forcing not demonstrated.

cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.goal: Assesses whether machine learning emulators can augment costly high-resolution regional climate simulations to produce local climate change information quickly and cheaply for climate services.
cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.architecture: Review and perspective that explores the skill of ML-based regional climate model emulators across a range of architectures and proposes validation methods for them.
cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.data: Regional and km-scale climate simulation ensembles from coordinated international initiatives; the specific simulations and domains are not reported in the abstract.
cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.result: ML emulation shows promise to augment regional-to-local climate projections within 5-10 years, but issues remain with extremes, multivariate coherence, climate memory and transfer to out-of-sample global models.
cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.open_work: Integrate climate expertise into emulator development, run the highest-resolution and most complex simulations affordable for training, and sample the full range of conditions including high-end scenarios.
cd7afdbeccf626a331c3e57904e98b0c860764de.issues: Perspective paper with few quantitative results in the abstract; emulator readiness depends on unresolved extremes, multivariate consistency and out-of-sample GCM generalization.

40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.goal: Infers the current and past global atmospheric state from observations, a prerequisite for accurate forecasts, using a single probabilistic generative model.
40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.architecture: Appa: a 565M-parameter latent diffusion model performing score-based data assimilation, conditioned on arbitrary observations without retraining.
40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.data: ERA5 at 0.25 degree resolution and 1-hour intervals for training; assimilation experiments with various observation inputs.
40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.result: A single model handles reanalysis, filtering and forecasting, producing physically consistent global trajectories from diverse inputs.
40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.open_work: Develop latent score-based data assimilation into a foundation for operational global atmospheric modeling systems, including tests with real observing networks.
40b030e634eec59dbd2d65c0a2aa7c141479222d.issues: Trained on ERA5 so it inherits reanalysis biases; quantitative skill against operational assimilation systems is not reported in the abstract.

61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.goal: Builds skillful probabilistic medium-range weather forecasts at reduced computational cost by leveraging existing deterministic ML weather models.
61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.architecture: ArchesWeatherGen: a flow matching generative model, a variant of diffusion models, that maps deterministic transformer-based ArchesWeather forecasts to the distribution of ERA5 states.
61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.data: ERA5 reanalysis for training (about 1.5 degree resolution in the ArchesWeather family); evaluation on WeatherBench headline variables against IFS ENS and NeuralGCM.
61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.result: Surpasses IFS ENS and NeuralGCM on all WeatherBench headline variables except NeuralGCM geopotential, with low training and inference cost.
61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.open_work: Extend the approach to higher resolution and more variables, and broaden access to generative ML forecasting research.
61332a313b2f4bf561e10fec92e89c57224a4ae7.issues: Trained and verified on ERA5, so it inherits reanalysis biases; coarse resolution limits representation of local extremes.

cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.goal: Emulates expensive regional climate models by learning the full conditional distribution of high-resolution RCM fields given coarse GCM output.
cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.architecture: EnScale: a two-step generative model trained with the energy score (a proper scoring rule), first correcting large-scale GCM mismatch then super-resolving with sparse local stochastic layers; EnScale-t adds temporal consistency.
cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.data: Multiple pairs of GCM and corresponding RCM simulations over Central Europe; variables are temperature, precipitation, solar radiation and wind.
cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.result: Competitive with state-of-the-art ML downscaling across calibration, spatial and temporal structure, extremes and multivariate dependence, at about one order of magnitude lower computational cost.
cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.open_work: Test transfer to other regions and GCM-RCM combinations, and use the evaluation framework as a common benchmark for RCM emulators.
cdaf3328386c0e6eb402262f0c185abf203f0b6e.issues: Restricted to Central Europe and to the GCM-RCM pairs seen in training; extrapolation to unseen GCMs and future climates is not demonstrated in the abstract.

fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.goal: Provides a computationally efficient data-driven emulator of the convection-allowing HRRR model for regional weather forecasting over CONUS.
fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.architecture: ResHRRR: a ResNet-style convolutional neural network with squeeze-and-excitation blocks and FiLM, with probabilistic forecasts via a DDIM diffusion model; an alternative graph neural network (GraphHRRR) is also built.
fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.data: HRRR analyses over the full CONUS domain, with future GFS forecast states as inputs; verification of composite reflectivity against HRRR analyses.
fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.result: With 3-10 member ensembles, ResHRRR beats HRRR at the 20 dBZ threshold and is competitive at 30 dBZ, with better storm placement, lower frequency bias and sharper spectra than deterministic baselines.
fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.open_work: Improve skill at moderate and high reflectivity thresholds and longer leads, and move toward operational data-driven regional ensemble prediction.
fba5988cb6b6c3c9fdbad3b6e4d1c429970a55e0.issues: Depends on GFS inputs at long leads, trained and verified on HRRR analyses, and lags HRRR at higher reflectivity thresholds; greedy rollout can accumulate error.

431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.goal: Develops probabilistic limited-area weather forecasting with ML, an area less explored than global ML models, to capture forecast uncertainty regionally.
431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.architecture: Diffusion-LAM: a conditional diffusion model that generates forecasts inside a limited area conditioned on boundary data from surrounding regions.
431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.data: MEPS limited-area dataset (MetCoOp Ensemble Prediction System over the Nordic region).
431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.result: Delivers accurate probabilistic limited-area forecasts on MEPS; detailed scores are not reported in the abstract.
431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.open_work: Extend to larger domains, longer leads and operational boundary forcing, and compare with operational limited-area ensembles.
431600ec711d9fc40c5f2dcc6f5d5aaf4b14f81d.issues: Evaluated only on one dataset and relies on known boundary data; diffusion sampling is computationally costlier than deterministic models.

6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.goal: Argues that trust in AI climate models should be built not only through post hoc explainable AI but also via lessons from physics-based dynamical climate model development.
6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.architecture: Review and perspective proposing instrumental, statistical and component-level understanding as a framework for evaluating trust in dynamical and AI models; non-ML conceptual method.
6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.data: No new data; draws on the history of climate model intercomparison projects and examples from the AI climate science literature.
6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.result: Post hoc XAI mainly adds statistical understanding; component-level understanding, as achieved through intercomparison projects, requires AI models with interpretable components.
6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.open_work: Build AI climate models with interpretable, modular components amenable to component-level diagnosis and intercomparison.
6f14afd65b3a498b2b723f5f8de2a41bedbd8e6c.issues: Conceptual paper without quantitative tests; cited successes in component-level understanding of AI models remain limited.

6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.goal: Obtains accurate high-resolution surface meteorological states at arbitrary locations by downscaling reanalysis with guidance from satellite and station observations.
6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.architecture: SGD: a conditional diffusion model with attention-based fusion of satellite observations, zero-shot guided sampling with optimizable convolutional kernels for the upscaling operator, and patch-based sampling for arbitrary resolution.
6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.data: ERA5 reanalysis for pre-training conditioned on GridSat satellite observations; weather station observations used as sampling guidance.
6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.result: Achieves accurate downscaling of meteorological states to 6.25 km resolution; specific error statistics are not reported in the abstract.
6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.open_work: Extend to more variables, regions and finer resolutions, and assess performance for extremes.
6c3f43491d5c7a40b6729ef462596b89adde4957.issues: Relies on ERA5 as training target and on station availability for guidance; diffusion sampling is computationally expensive.

c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.goal: Characterizes the statistics and physics of very rare weather extremes, such as millennial heat waves, which are hard to sample with observations or costly climate models.
c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.architecture: AI+RES: couples fast AI weather forecasts with a high-fidelity physics model inside a rare-event sampling algorithm; the specific AI architecture is not reported in the abstract.
c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.data: Not reported in the abstract; uses a high-fidelity physics-based climate model together with AI weather forecasts.
c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.result: Enables study of once-per-millennium heat waves at two orders of magnitude lower computational cost than direct simulation.
c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.open_work: Apply the framework to other extremes and fields concerned with rare events, and to changing-climate scenarios.
c00de6399f1bad3d426ea781484ed757871ae611.issues: Reliability depends on the AI forecasts representing extreme dynamics well; details of models and validation are not given in the abstract.

cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.goal: Investigates whether the internal representations of a data-driven weather model are interpretable and physically consistent, toward mechanistic understanding.
cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.architecture: Mechanistic interpretability of GraphCast, a graph neural network, using sparse autoencoders on intermediate layer activations, plus feature interventions during prediction.
cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.data: GraphCast activations from forecasts initialized from ERA5-like global states; specific periods are not reported in the abstract.
cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.result: Finds interpretable features for tropical cyclones, atmospheric rivers, diurnal and seasonal cycles, precipitation patterns, geography and sea ice; editing a cyclone feature produces physically consistent hurricane changes.
cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.open_work: Extend interpretability analyses to other data-driven models and use feature interventions for scientific discovery and trust assessment.
cbfacb582ab329b02a73f804a51f2fac3e273f01.issues: Qualitative case-study evidence; features found may depend on sparse autoencoder settings, and physical consistency of interventions is assessed for few cases.

4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.goal: Learns stochastic subgrid convection, turbulence and surface radiative flux parameterizations with calibrated uncertainty for an Earth system model, beyond idealized deterministic settings.
4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.architecture: Three stochastic deep neural network (MLP) parameterizations: Monte Carlo dropout, a multi-member ensemble of networks, and a variational encoder-decoder with latent perturbations.
4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.data: Superparameterized Community Atmosphere Model (SPCAM) embedded in CESM as training data and coupled host model.
4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.result: Multi-member parameterization improves boundary-layer convection; full coupling crashes within days, but partial coupling stays stable for 5 months and improves tropical extreme precipitation over traditional convection schemes.
4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.open_work: Achieve stable fully coupled hybrid simulations and reduce thermodynamic and precipitation biases while retaining stochasticity.
4cb5094657271713381522f0dacdac4853837c72.issues: Instability when coupled online; partial coupling relies on the superparameterization and lowers efficiency; hybrid runs show thermodynamic biases.

99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.goal: Makes diffusion-based probabilistic weather forecasting cheaper, since iterative sampling makes long, high-frequency rollouts expensive.
99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.architecture: Swift: a single-step consistency model (probability flow, diffusion family) fine-tuned autoregressively with a CRPS objective, without multi-model ensembling or parameter perturbations.
99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.data: Global reanalysis training data (product and resolution not reported in the abstract); evaluation against a diffusion baseline and IFS ENS.
99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.result: Requires 39 times fewer neural function evaluations per step than diffusion baselines, matches their 6-hourly skill, is competitive with IFS ENS and stays stable for 75-day rollouts.
99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.open_work: Exploit post-training calibration and extend toward subseasonal and higher-resolution forecasting.
99dad971b8718ad342efad1d8f0c5d72fc6e8f82.issues: Skill only competitive with, not clearly exceeding, IFS ENS; resolution and evaluation details are not given in the abstract.

6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.goal: Emulates expensive km-scale global storm-resolving simulations to produce local high-resolution precipitation for climate adaptation and extreme risk assessment.
6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.architecture: Two-stage framework: ACE2S, a stochastic autoregressive global atmosphere emulator at 1 degree, followed by HiRO, a diffusion model for 32x downscaling to 3 km.
6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.data: A decade of X-SHiELD 3 km global storm-resolving model output, with paired high-resolution and coarsened (100 km) fields.
6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.result: Reproduces extreme precipitation up to the 99.99th percentile with time-mean biases below 10% almost everywhere, and generates decades of 6-hourly 3 km precipitation per day on one H100 GPU.
6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.open_work: Extend to more variables and validate against observations and other km-scale models for climate change applications.
6302b23f97abfec47c8724388372c218c96b51f5.issues: Trained on a single model's decade of output, so it inherits X-SHiELD biases; performance under future forcing is not shown in the abstract.

bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.goal: Synthesizes progress in machine learning for tropospheric ozone research since Phase 1 of the Tropospheric Ozone Assessment Report.
bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.architecture: Review covering short-term ozone forecasting, emulation of atmospheric chemistry and remote sensing-based ozone estimation with ML.
bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.data: Literature review; covers studies using atmospheric, environmental and satellite data relevant to ozone.
bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.result: ML complements existing ozone research, with the most activity in forecasting, chemistry emulation and remote sensing retrieval.
bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.open_work: Define suitable benchmarks, build robust and explainable models, address poorly observed precursors, and foster collaboration across chemistry, ML and computing.
bd2f150ad4d7afdda7bf8f1b1d3e87b131b2f56a.issues: Review without new quantitative results; field limited by sparse precursor observations and lack of benchmarks.

89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.goal: Uses the low-dimensional climatological structure of atmospheric circulation as a prior for estimating weather states from sparse observations and designing observation networks.
89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.architecture: Deep generative model learning the climatological distribution, combined with station observations for Bayesian posterior state estimation; specific generative family not stated in the abstract.
89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.data: Climate reanalysis or simulation output for training; case study of 2 m temperature spatial patterns with few station observations.
89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.result: Learned prior reproduces climatology statistics; posterior estimates are spatially coherent, adaptive to observations and uncertainty-aware, enabling ranking of observation value.
89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.open_work: Extend to multivariate, three-dimensional states and to operational observation network design.
89bc9be0ab5d51e2f41565a640f2fc46f1091de9.issues: Demonstrated only for 2 m temperature patterns; trained on reanalysis or simulations so inherits their biases.

53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.goal: Improves global aerosol forecasting, which is costlier and more uncertain than weather forecasting due to aerosol-meteorology interactions.
53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.architecture: AI-GAMFS: backbone combining a vision transformer and a U-Net with global attention and spatiotemporal encoding.
53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.data: 42 years of aerosol reanalysis (MERRA-2) for training; initialized with GEOS-FP analyses; evaluated with ground-based observations.
53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.result: Delivers 5-day, 3-hourly forecasts in 1 minute, beats CAMS and regional dust models for AOD and dust, and has lower global AOD RMSE than GEOS-FP.
53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.open_work: Use for early warning of dust storms and wildfire smoke, and extend to more species and coupled meteorology.
53a0302ffe73d5122cc358fad8d4e4f483b84660.issues: Trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases, and depends on GEOS-FP initialization; dust skill only comparable to GEOS-FP.

71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.goal: Extends ENSO prediction lead time and reduces the spring predictability barrier while providing physically interpretable insights.
71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.architecture: CTEFNet: a hybrid convolutional neural network and transformer using multiple oceanic and atmospheric predictors, with gradient-based sensitivity analysis.
71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.data: Multivariate oceanic and atmospheric predictor fields; training and evaluation datasets are not reported in the abstract.
71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.result: Extends effective ENSO forecast lead to 20 months, outperforming dynamical models and prior deep learning methods, and identifies inter-basin precursors.
71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.open_work: Further explore Pacific-Atlantic-Indian inter-basin interactions and apply the model to other climate modes.
71b8fd895ad828a9e8bc4a55ca500d56a339d3cf.issues: Long-lead skill evaluated on limited historical ENSO events; gradient-based sensitivities may not imply causality.

f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.goal: Scales diffusion-based weather and climate prediction stably to billions of parameters at high resolution.
f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.architecture: AERIS: a 1.3-80B parameter pixel-level Swin diffusion transformer, with SWiPe parallelism combining window, sequence and pipeline parallelism.
f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.data: ERA5 at 0.25 degree with 1x1 patch size; trained on the Aurora supercomputer.
f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.result: Sustains 10.21 ExaFLOPS (peak 11.21) with 95.5% weak and 81.6% strong scaling efficiency; outperforms IFS ENS and stays stable to 90 days.
f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.open_work: Exploit billion-parameter diffusion models for seasonal and climate prediction.
f48d7a891f1fa6fa7601ccaa498a04c9b9b50de9.issues: Very high computational cost; trained on ERA5 so inherits its biases; forecast evaluation details are limited in the abstract.

e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.goal: Tests whether ML weather surrogates, unstable for long rollouts, can support accurate long-term state estimation when combined with sparse noisy observations.
e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.architecture: FourCastNet (Fourier neural operator based surrogate) integrated in a variational data assimilation framework, with theoretical analysis of filtering stability.
e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.data: Partial, noisy synthetic observations from ERA5.
e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.result: Filtering estimates remain accurate over a year-long assimilation window and provide effective initial conditions for forecasts, including extreme events.
e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.open_work: Test with real observing systems and other surrogates, and compare with operational assimilation.
e01cbf88b4b2b204eee34c78d2b2fbf64a39b015.issues: Uses synthetic observations from ERA5 rather than real observations; idealized setting relative to operational DA.

af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.goal: Compares precipitation forecast performance of ECMWF's AI model AIFS with the physics-based IFS over China.
af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.architecture: Verification study comparing AIFS (machine-learned forecast model) with the IFS numerical model; no new ML model is developed.
af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.data: Precipitation observations from 2,415 stations in China and ERA5 reanalysis.
af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.result: AIFS has much lower 1-5 day RMSE, but underestimates amounts and extremes, overpredicts light rain frequency, does better for heavy rain above 25 mm in TS/ETS, while IFS wins on SEEPS.
af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.open_work: Improve AIFS representation of moisture transport and vertical velocity to better capture extremes and variability.
af3a03f6d36aaaf229a8b1a0294243f67a7a9819.issues: Regional evaluation over China only; weak simulated moisture transport and vertical velocity suggested as cause, not proven.

7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.goal: Assesses whether deep learning perfect-prognosis downscaling models can plausibly extrapolate to future emission scenarios.
7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.architecture: Intercomparison of existing deep learning downscaling models, mainly convolutional neural networks, under a common experimental framework with multiple training replicas.
7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.data: Observation-based training for minimum and maximum temperature and precipitation over Spain; applied to global climate projections. Specific datasets are not reported in the abstract.
7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.result: Identifies differences in extrapolation capability and sensitivity to training replicas across models; detailed numbers are not given in the abstract.
7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.open_work: Develop methods that extrapolate more reliably to unseen future conditions and support operational use.
7fddae691c3775971c308615a5b3b197612d9a73.issues: Limited to Spain and three variables; extrapolation cannot be fully verified against future observations.

f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.goal: Tests deep learning as an efficient alternative to conventional spectral wave models for operational ocean wave forecasting.
f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.architecture: OceanCastNet: a deep neural network forecasting significant wave height, mean wave period and mean wave direction from wind and wave fields; network family not detailed in the abstract.
f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.data: Wind and wave fields as inputs (training dataset not stated); validation with NDBC buoys and Jason-3 satellite altimetry against ECWAM.
f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.result: Better than ECWAM at 24 NDBC stations versus 10, similar accuracy against Jason-3 through 228 h, and errors within about 0.5 m during Typhoon Goni.
f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.open_work: Extend to coupled wind-wave forecasting and operational deployment.
f784303863065a67d71997fe417a7f5a60714643.issues: Depends on wind forcing quality; extreme-event evaluation is a single typhoon case.

26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.goal: Fills gaps in sparse historical climate records to reconstruct complete climate fields before the satellite era.
26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.architecture: Image inpainting deep learning network based on Fourier convolutions, trained on climate model output.
26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.data: Numerical climate model output (CMIP simulations) for training; applied to historical observational temperature records.
26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.result: Reconstructs large irregular missing areas and known strong El Nino and La Nina events, outperforming kriging and other ML methods, and generalizes to higher resolutions and unseen masks.
26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.open_work: Apply to more climate variables and longer reconstructions with uncertainty estimates.
26096c445a557185beac4d4bff2d8e9d3fd70242.issues: Trained on model output so inherits model biases; no uncertainty quantification mentioned in the abstract.

bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.goal: Evaluates the utility of AI weather prediction models for operational tropical cyclone track and intensity forecasting.
bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.architecture: Verification of four open-source AI models (FourCastNet v1, FourCastNet v2-small, GraphCast-operational, Pangu-Weather) using the NHC verification procedure.
bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.data: Northern Hemisphere tropical cyclones, May-November 2023, verified against NHC best tracks and operational models.
bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.result: Track errors comparable to the best operational models and reduce consensus track errors by up to 11%, but intensity errors exceed climatology-persistence with a strong low bias.
bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.open_work: Develop bias corrections or reformulations for accurate TC intensity forecasts.
bd53a1d2988e3cb49402b98fd121cd35b1bf8e3f.issues: Only one season; coarse AI models underestimate intensity systematically.

3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.goal: Enables stable long-term ML simulation of slow ocean dynamics for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction, where autoregressive errors accumulate.
3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.architecture: NeuralOM: a neural operator framework with progressive residual correction and a physics-guided graph neural network with adaptive message passing.
3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.data: Global ocean S2S simulation data; the specific reanalysis product is not reported in the abstract.
3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art models in accuracy and stability, with 13.3% lower RMSE than the best baseline at 60-day lead, and better extreme events.
3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.open_work: Extend to coupled ocean-atmosphere and longer climate timescales.
3338109a23d08e02774ebe53efa4d9d027c49d3b.issues: Evaluation details and data source not given in the abstract; likely trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.goal: Extends AI-NWP to rapidly evolving storm-scale phenomena, since global ERA5-trained models do not resolve thunderstorms.
a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.architecture: WoFSCast: Google's GraphCast graph neural network adapted to limited-area, storm-scale domains.
a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.data: Archived Warn-on-Forecast System (WoFS) convection-allowing ensemble forecasts at 5-min output; verified against WoFS and observed storms.
a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.result: Matches 70-80% of WoFS storms out to 2 h with only modest blurring, and similar contingency statistics and fractions skill scores to WoFS against observations.
a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.open_work: Reduce blurring, extend lead times and integrate into operational warn-on-forecast workflows.
a67ad74ac3a3257028a9450fe93ce2a5e6945f86.issues: Emulates WoFS so inherits its errors; some blurring and limited lead times up to 2 h.

3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.goal: Improves ENSO prediction by combining the strengths of deep learning and dynamical model forecasts.
3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.architecture: Convolutional neural network and 3D-Geoformer (transformer) ENSO forecasts combined with dynamical model forecasts through two combination strategies.
3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.data: Dynamical model ensemble forecasts and DL forecasts; specific datasets are not reported in the abstract.
3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.result: DL forecasts match the dynamical multi-model mean, and both combined dynamical-DL strategies significantly outperform individual DL or dynamical forecasts across lead times.
3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.open_work: Extend the combination approach to other climate forecasting problems.
3f95d3ba59169d0a6c4467525eea86b1e1201d7e.issues: Gains depend on the specific dynamical and DL members; limited historical verification sample.

c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.goal: Describes improvements to ECMWF's machine-learned forecasting model AIFS Single, now operational.
c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.architecture: AIFS: graph neural network encoder-decoder with a transformer processor, now with physical bounding layers, an updated training schedule and more variables.
c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.data: ERA5 and ECMWF operational analyses for training; verification against analyses and observations.
c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.result: Bounding layers substantially improve precipitation forecasts, new variables are skillful and upper-air headline scores improve; operational since 25 February 2025.
c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.open_work: Further expand variables and physical constraints and develop ensemble versions.
c9d81682896c64df06d81a7b74aa9cc1633d4010.issues: Deterministic single model, prone to smoothing; few quantitative details in the abstract.

fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.goal: Clarifies the drivers of skill in data-driven probabilistic medium-range forecasting by showing simple scalable designs suffice.
fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.architecture: Generic framework with a downsampled latent space and history-conditioned local projector, supporting stochastic interpolants, diffusion models and CRPS ensemble training.
fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.data: Global reanalysis data (not specified in the abstract); compared with IFS and GenCast.
fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.result: Achieves statistically significant improvements over IFS and GenCast on most variables, robust to the probabilistic estimator.
fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.open_work: Scale the general-purpose model further and test at other timescales.
fb4b8c56547e1e083ad08ef00424179dbf4309a3.issues: Training data and resolution not given in the abstract; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases.

342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.goal: Assesses whether AI weather prediction models are reliable for severe weather by comparing operational tropical cyclone forecasts from Pangu-Weather with physics-based NWP.
342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.architecture: Evaluation study of Pangu-Weather, a 3D Earth-specific transformer, run from different initial conditions and compared with ECMWF and NCEP numerical weather prediction models; no new model is trained.
342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.data: Western Pacific tropical cyclones of 2023 in an operational context, with Pangu-Weather initialized from ECMWF and NCEP analyses and verified against best-track and analysis fields.
342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.result: Pangu-Weather beats NWP for TC track and environmental fields, especially at longer leads, but underestimates intensity and produces a weakened dynamic-thermodynamic TC structure with low sensitivity to initial conditions.
342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.open_work: Develop hybrid models combining physical processes with data-driven approaches and higher-resolution initial conditions to improve AI forecasts of TC intensity and structure.
342a6c7da570eff363eb4a3712bceaf6ee408290.issues: Overly smooth forecasts and coarse-resolution initial conditions underestimate intensity; single season, single basin and essentially one AI model limit generality.

b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.goal: Bridges the resolution gap between coarse climate projections and fine-scale information needed for regional climate risk assessment, including compound extremes, without temporally paired training data.
b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.architecture: GenFocal, a probabilistic generative AI framework (diffusion-based generative model) that debiases and downscales coarse climate model output to fine-scale weather without paired simulated-observed events.
b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.data: Coarse free-running climate model projections as input and fine-scale reanalysis or observations as target; specific products and resolutions are not reported in the abstract.
b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.result: Generates statistically accurate fine-scale weather, synthesizes long-lived hazards such as heatwaves and tropical cyclones even when poorly represented in coarse projections, and samples rare high-impact events more accurately than leading methods.
b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.open_work: Extend to more regions, variables and climate models, and use the generated ensembles for adaptation and resilience planning.
b3f3432cde8da61e6fbb1c89ed2e3afb4cf58909.issues: Statistical (unpaired) training cannot be verified event by event; fidelity under future climates relies on distributional assumptions and on the quality of the reference data.

3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.goal: Tests whether an autoregressive ML climate emulator can learn the sensitivity of climate to substantially changed CO2, which prior emulators trained on present-day climate cannot.
3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.architecture: ACE2-SOM: the Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2 (a spherical Fourier neural operator emulator) coupled to a slab ocean model, trained autoregressively with CO2 as forcing.
3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.data: Output from equilibrium-climate physics-based reference simulations (atmosphere with slab ocean) at multiple CO2 levels; tested on seen and unseen CO2 concentrations, 2%/year ramps and abrupt 4xCO2.
3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.result: Reproduces equilibrium patterns of surface temperature and precipitation change for 2x, 3x and 4xCO2, warming profiles and extreme precipitation up to the 99.9999th percentile; transient runs match global trends but show stratospheric jumps.
3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.open_work: Improve generalization to non-equilibrium and diverse climate change scenarios, including energy-conserving transient behavior.
3c541938eeb24a61497707f5bcff7913e720fe6e.issues: Abrupt 4xCO2 runs transition unrealistically fast, violate global energy conservation and show unphysical radiative flux sensitivities; stratospheric fields jump in gradual-forcing runs; slab ocean only.

a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.goal: Makes diffusion-model-based atmospheric data assimilation physically consistent, since purely data-driven reconstructions can violate governing dynamics and harm downstream use.
a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.architecture: PhyDA, a physics-guided diffusion model with a physically regularized diffusion objective penalizing PDE residuals and a Virtual Reconstruction Encoder mapping sparse observations to structured latent representations.
a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.data: ERA5 reanalysis with sparse synthetic observations; details on resolution, variables and periods are not reported in the abstract.
a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.result: Achieves higher reconstruction accuracy and better physical plausibility than state-of-the-art data assimilation baselines.
a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.open_work: Apply the approach to real observing systems and operational data assimilation, and extend the set of physical constraints.
a0439e1b559ab8f9d83aff60fd18fd82dc2fa07e.issues: Evaluated on ERA5 with simulated observations rather than real observation streams; physical constraints are approximate PDE penalties, not hard guarantees.

2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.goal: Investigates whether and how AI weather models forecast gray swan extremes lying beyond their regional training data, using the unprecedented April 2024 Dubai rainfall.
2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.architecture: Analysis of graph neural network and transformer AI weather models (GraphCast, AIFS, FuXi) with fine-tuning experiments and receptive field analyses to separate extrapolation from translocation.
2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.data: Operational-style forecasts of the 2024 Dubai storm, whose rainfall was twice the regional training maximum; models trained on ERA5 reanalysis.
2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.result: GraphCast and AIFS forecast the event up to 8 days ahead, FuXi underestimates rainfall; success stems from translocation (learning from similar events elsewhere), with no evidence of extrapolation; global-tail events remain poorly forecast.
2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.open_work: Improve AI models for tails by addressing data imbalance and spectral bias, and use mechanism-level understanding to improve gray swan forecasting.
2567d3baba5a8ccdfe59f563df45e25872ff91b0.issues: Single case study; tail errors arise from both generalization error and spectral bias (optimization error), so skill for truly unprecedented global extremes is not demonstrated.

2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.goal: Provides robust, generalizable and scalable AI downscaling of weather and climate fields to hyper-resolution for regional decision making.
2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.architecture: ORBIT-2, a vision transformer foundation model using a Residual Slim ViT (Reslim) with Bayesian regularization and TILES tile-wise sequence scaling that reduces self-attention cost from quadratic to linear.
2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.data: Global climate and weather data for downscaling down to 0.9 km; evaluated on 7 km resolution benchmarks against observation data; specific datasets are not reported in the abstract.
2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.result: Scales to 10 billion parameters on 65,536 GPUs with up to 4.1 ExaFLOPS sustained and 74–98% strong scaling efficiency; reaches R2 of 0.98–0.99 against observations on 7 km benchmarks.
2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.open_work: Demonstrate generalization across variables and geographies in operational downscaling and evaluate physical consistency at hyper-resolution.
2f3087ff5bd041e30a9b2d1af31cc37ff9be3dcb.issues: Emphasis on computational scaling; R2 summarizes skill poorly for extremes and fine-scale structure; requires exascale resources.

1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.goal: Evaluates whether deep learning weather models can forecast severe convective (tornadic) environments, an application not yet explored.
1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.architecture: Evaluation of Pangu-Weather, a transformer-based deep learning weather model, against the GFS numerical weather prediction model using derived convective parameters; no new model is trained.
1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.data: One-day lead forecasts of CAPE, 0–6 km bulk wind difference and 0–3 km storm-relative helicity at tornado storm-report locations, compared with GFS forecasts.
1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.result: Pangu-Weather generally outperforms GFS for BWD6 and SRH3 at the storm grid point and hour, but underpredicts maximum values of all convective parameters in the 1–2 h before storms over surrounding points.
1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.open_work: Extend to longer lead times, other DL models and direct prediction of convective hazards.
1a5b9682392b6522e1467f2c3fa1d99b75c1a059.issues: Underprediction of convective parameter maxima reflects smoothing; limited to one-day leads and coarse model resolution that cannot resolve storm-scale processes.

5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.goal: Provides a fair way to compare single-valued output from AI and physics-based weather models, since pre-specified loss functions can favour some competitors.
5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.architecture: Non-ML statistical method: potential continuous ranked probability score (PCRPS), computed by post-processing deterministic forecasts with isotonic distributional regression and taking the mean CRPS.
5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.data: WeatherBench 2 forecasts including GraphCast, ECMWF HRES, GenCast and the operational ECMWF ensemble.
5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.result: GraphCast outperforms ECMWF HRES under PCRPS; PCRPS for HRES and GenCast aligns very well with the mean CRPS of the ECMWF ensemble and GenCast ensemble.
5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.open_work: Use PCRPS in benchmarks and other application domains where loss functions are not pre-specified.
5f930ed69b7032d445c85c073de7e3fd7ee8072a.issues: Measures potential rather than realized skill and is invariant to monotone transformations, so it ignores calibration and bias of raw output; requires enough training data for the post-processing.

dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.goal: Improves generalization of data-driven mesoscale eddy parameterizations in ocean models across grid resolutions, depths and configurations.
dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.architecture: Neural network (ANN) parameterization of mesoscale eddy fluxes with physics constraints and local dimensional scaling of inputs and outputs using grid spacing as a length scale.
dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.data: High-resolution ocean simulations coarse-grained for training; tested offline in the global ocean and online in idealized and global ocean models (MOM6-based configurations).
dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.result: Dimensional scaling enables offline generalization to unseen resolutions and depths and improves kinetic and potential energy in online idealized and global simulations relative to baselines.
dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.open_work: Apply the general dimensional-scaling algorithm to other data-driven parameterizations and further reduce global ocean biases.
dbbc06cc8e775852dba11cf7db6b6de8f764448a.issues: Impact on global ocean biases is mixed and discussed rather than uniformly positive; trained on specific simulation data, so remaining structural errors are possible.

3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.goal: Provides an open, scalable research platform for training and deploying AI weather prediction models and addresses artifacts from training data and timestep choices.
3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.architecture: CREDIT framework with WXFormer, a multiscale vision transformer using spectral normalization, intelligent padding and multi-step training; FuXi also trained for comparison.
3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.data: ERA5 on hybrid sigma-pressure (model) levels sampled at 6-hour intervals; verification against IFS HRES 10-day forecasts.
