3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.result: Both WXFormer and FuXi trained in CREDIT generally outperform IFS HRES on 10-day forecasts.
3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.open_work: Use the modular framework for community experimentation with models, datasets and training options, including probabilistic and coupled extensions.
3b831def98ef55c4f910b41af1e86f7ea7184dfc.issues: Deterministic models trained on reanalysis inherit ERA5 biases and likely smooth at long leads; comparison limited to standard global metrics.

8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.goal: Reduces the large inter-model spread in projected 21st-century ENSO SST variability by constraining projections with observed ENSO physics.
8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.architecture: Artificial neural networks (ANN, MLP-type) trained to map tropical Pacific warming patterns to ENSO SST variability response, with interpretability analysis and a model-as-truth test.
8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.data: Climate model simulations (CMIP-class) and observations; projections under a high-emission scenario.
8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.result: Reduces ENSO projection uncertainty by 54%, from a range of 0.59 °C to 0.27 °C; warming in the far-eastern and central equatorial Pacific is key to ENSO change.
8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.open_work: Integrate machine learning with observational constraints for other climate projection uncertainties.
8e5028ca1ceec6f5131cd8927cbb97cd35058a3f.issues: Relies on short observational records and on the assumption that the observed ENSO-warming-pattern relationship holds in future; constraint conditional on projected warming patterns.

4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.goal: Simplifies 4D-Var data assimilation by avoiding hand-written tangent linear and adjoint models when the forecast model supports automatic differentiation.
4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.architecture: Non-ML data assimilation method: 4D-Var approximating Gauss-Newton via backpropagation combined with a Hessian approximation, applicable to autodiff physical models or ML surrogate models.
4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.data: Idealized Lorenz-96 and quasi-geostrophic models with synthetic observations.
4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.result: The approach is efficient and in some cases more accurate than incremental 4D-Var.
4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.open_work: Integrate with operational-scale differentiable weather models and ML surrogates in next-generation forecast systems.
4b43d025345ba51dc1b8aa4bb1314e91f7a7174b.issues: Tested only on idealized low-dimensional systems; scalability and robustness with real observations and full NWP models remain undemonstrated.

b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.goal: Supports development of ML tornado detection and prediction from radar, where rare events make training dataset design critical.
b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.architecture: Benchmark dataset (TorNet) with ML baselines, including a deep learning convolutional neural network that processes raw polarimetric radar imagery, plus non-DL and operational baselines.
b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.data: Full-resolution polarimetric Level-II WSR-88D (NEXRAD) radar data sampled from 9 years of reported storm events.
b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.result: The DL baseline, without manual feature engineering, shows higher detection performance than non-DL and operational baselines; dataset, code and weights are released.
b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.open_work: Use TorNet for tornado prediction (lead time) and improved architectures, and examine robustness for operational acceptance.
b1fa074e22b7ae7e5ed3b61d5dcbf8a458cd3d41.issues: Labels depend on storm reports, which are incomplete and biased; tornadoes remain rare, and detection skill is still limited.

fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.goal: Provides skilful, high-resolution short-term sea ice forecasts for maritime users in the Arctic.
fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.architecture: Computationally lightweight deep learning model (convolutional U-Net) predicting regional ice charts from atmospheric forecasts, ice charts and passive microwave sea ice concentration.
fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.data: Operational atmospheric forecasts, ice charts and passive microwave sea ice concentration as predictors; future ice charts as targets; East Greenland and Barents seas at 1 km.
fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.result: Lower sea ice concentration contour errors at 1–3 day leads than persistence, free drift, linear trend and dynamical systems neXtSIM and Barents-2.5, across all seasons.
fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.open_work: Extend coverage, lead time and probabilistic output for operational use.
fdb031060edfcee76f4cb7169321ba128e193893.issues: Regional domain only; limited to 1–3 day leads; ice chart targets are subjective analyses; deterministic output.

e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.goal: Improves seasonal forecasting of Pan-Arctic sea ice concentration, where dynamical models are costly and deep learning struggles with seasonal variation and uncertainty.
e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.architecture: IceMamba, a state space model (Mamba) deep learning architecture integrating attention mechanisms.
e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.data: Pan-Arctic sea ice concentration data; specific products and periods are not reported in the abstract; compared with 25 dynamical, statistical and deep learning forecast models.
e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.result: Best average RMSE and anomaly correlation coefficient among all tested models and second in Integrated Ice Edge Error.
e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.open_work: Improve ice-edge skill and quantify forecast uncertainty for climate adaptation applications.
e0f42ace77932d42f5294163ce2b67387756bec2.issues: Not best on ice-edge error; uncertainty quantification and physical interpretability are not reported in the abstract.

8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.goal: Provides a standardized benchmark for deep learning sea ice type classification, since lack of one prevents consensus on the best models.
8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.architecture: Benchmark framework (IceBench) comparing pixel-based (segmentation, e.g. U-Net-style) and patch-based (CNN classifier) deep learning methods with a comprehensive set of metrics.
8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.data: AI4Arctic Sea Ice Challenge Dataset (Sentinel-1 SAR with AMSR2 passive microwave and ice charts).
8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.result: Comparative study identifies best-performing models under different conditions and studies transferability across seasons and locations, downsampling and preprocessing.
8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.open_work: Integrate further methods into the open-source framework and improve spatial and temporal transferability.
8fc8d79d3f0ac9bec3ad921550d377667de03789.issues: Limited to one dataset and its ice chart labels; transfer to other regions and sensors is uncertain.

aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.goal: Produces high-resolution probabilistic data-driven weather ensembles for a regional domain of interest within a global model.
aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.architecture: Stochastic data-driven model on a global stretched grid (graph neural network encoder-processor-decoder) trained with a CRPS loss in grid-point and spectral space.
aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.data: Global stretched grid with 2.5 km over the Nordic region and 31 km elsewhere, 6-hourly, 87 variables; evaluated against surface station observations and MEPS ensemble forecasts.
aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.result: Lower CRPS than MEPS for 2 m temperature (13%) and mean sea-level pressure (10%), smaller differences for wind and precipitation; spectral loss is needed for spatially coherent fields.
aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.open_work: Improve representation of strong winds and precipitation and extend evaluation to more extreme events.
aa121ccf21954d4693cd16c5f59a3ace3780066f.issues: Underestimates peak winds in Storm Dave; little gain for wind speed and precipitation.

82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.goal: Provides efficient sub-daily, eddy-resolving global ocean forecasts, as numerical models are costly and data-driven models typically work at daily resolution.
82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.architecture: FuXi-Ocean, a transformer-type model with context-aware feature extraction and stacked attention blocks, plus a Mixture-of-Time module that adaptively combines predictions from multiple temporal contexts.
82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.data: Global ocean data at 1/12° resolution, six-hourly, down to 1500 m; specific reanalysis products are not reported in the abstract.
82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.result: First data-driven global ocean model with six-hourly 1/12° forecasts; superior skill for temperature, salinity and currents across depths.
82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.open_work: Extend to deeper levels, coupled ocean-atmosphere forecasting and longer lead times.
82d1351e6c5161ad8bbee5a91cdd0c25941d7487.issues: Trained on ocean reanalysis, so inherits its biases; quantitative skill margins and uncertainty are not reported in the abstract.

d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.goal: Shows that frontier probabilistic AI weather forecasting does not require specialized architectures or massive compute.
d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.architecture: U-Cast: a standard U-Net backbone with deterministic MAE pre-training followed by short CRPS fine-tuning using Monte Carlo Dropout for ensemble stochasticity.
d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.data: Global data at 1.5° resolution (reanalysis); compared with GenCast and IFS ENS; specific training periods are not reported in the abstract.
d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.result: Matches or exceeds GenCast and IFS ENS probabilistic skill at 1.5°, with over 10x less training compute than CRPS-based models and 10x lower latency than diffusion; trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days, 15-day ensemble in 3 seconds.
d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.open_work: Scale to higher resolutions and broaden access to training frontier probabilistic models.
d40bfd1842fa494f171a3bed80bb950e80846eb5.issues: Evaluated at coarse 1.5° resolution; Monte Carlo Dropout may limit ensemble spread realism and extreme-event representation.

16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.goal: Delivers fast probabilistic radar precipitation nowcasting, as diffusion models are accurate but slow for time-critical use.
16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.architecture: FlowCast, a generative model using Conditional Flow Matching in a compressed latent space (autoencoder latent) for direct noise-to-data generation.
16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.data: Radar precipitation image sequences; specific datasets are not reported in the abstract.
16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.result: New state of the art in probabilistic performance, exceeding deterministic baselines; the flow matching objective is more accurate and efficient than diffusion on the same architecture with fewer sampling steps.
16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.open_work: Apply flow matching to other high-dimensional spatiotemporal forecasting tasks.
16723402c4ff3c4b02583dee1992882042f08084.issues: Datasets and lead times are not specified in the abstract; latent compression may lose small-scale extremes.

c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.goal: Estimates the top-of-atmosphere radiative response to SST patterns and uses it to evaluate whether ML climate emulators capture causal physical relationships.
c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.architecture: Green's function perturbation experiments with the Ai2 Climate Emulator (ACE2, a neural operator emulator), compared with other ACE versions and conventional climate models.
c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.data: ACE2 trained on ERA5 reanalysis (ACE2-ERA5), forced with locally perturbed SST boundary conditions; two additional ACE versions and traditional climate models for comparison.
c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.result: ACE2-ERA5 produces a sensitivity map of TOA radiative response consistent with physical understanding of feedbacks but likely underestimates the response to historical warming.
c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.open_work: Use Green's function experiments as a standard test of causal and out-of-distribution behaviour of ML emulators.
c888cd58efa35bb7eda5a18361795309f77e3075.issues: Out-of-distribution perturbations may exceed emulator training range; underestimated radiative response limits use for climate sensitivity.

149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.goal: Outlines how machine learning can address parametric and structural uncertainty in cloud microphysics schemes for weather and climate models.
149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.architecture: Review and perspective on data-driven and ML methods for cloud microphysics parameterization, including differentiable programming, ML-enhanced sampling and uncertainty decomposition.
149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.data: Discusses high-fidelity simulations (e.g. Lagrangian particle-based and bin models), observations and the need for large-scale benchmark datasets.
149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.result: Synthesizes progress and identifies aleatoric and epistemic error roles, bottom-up and top-down observational constraints and key opportunities.
149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.open_work: Build benchmark datasets, use differentiable programming and observational constraints, and improve consistency across temporal and spatial scales.
149482a081bf26a2f3b9b432635f41e9dbc83d1a.issues: Perspective paper without new quantitative results; recommendations depend on the availability of high-fidelity data and observations.

a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.goal: Produces long storm surge time series along coastlines, including at ungauged locations, for extreme value and hazard analysis.
a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.architecture: Regional long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network with dynamic atmospheric and oceanic predictors and static local features, using transfer learning.
a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.data: Storm surge observations from 31 Florida tide gauges as predictand; atmospheric and oceanic predictors; static shelf width, nearshore slope, shelter factor and tidal range; compared with a hydrodynamic hindcast.
a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.result: Static attributes increase Pearson correlation by 20% and reduce RMSE by 22% in cross-validation; outperforms a state-of-the-art hydrodynamic hindcast at most locations.
a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.open_work: Generate hindcasts and future projections to analyse trends, decadal variability and return levels.
a4e05fdfd63d51687fa1b48e975819d97261e87b.issues: Limited to Florida; tide gauge records are short and gappy; skill for the most extreme surges and at ungauged sites is less certain.

eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.goal: Unifies probabilistic weather forecasting from medium range to subseasonal-to-seasonal scales, where autoregressive models suffer error accumulation.
eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.architecture: OmniCast: a VAE encoding weather into a latent space and a masked diffusion transformer (per-token diffusion head) generating future latent token sequences jointly across space and time.
eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.data: Global reanalysis data (ERA5); evaluated on medium-range and subseasonal-to-seasonal benchmarks.
eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.result: Competitive with leading probabilistic medium-range methods while 10x to 20x faster; state of the art at S2S scales across accuracy, physics-based and probabilistic metrics; stable rollouts up to 100 years.
eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.open_work: Extend to coupled components and higher resolutions for seasonal and climate-scale forecasting.
eabcdaac8150fb1b586c86ee4111296de7abf618.issues: Latent compression may lose fine-scale detail; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; 100-year stability does not imply correct climate response to forcing.

cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.goal: Fuses gauges, satellites and model precipitation records, each with different trade-offs, into a unified, more accurate precipitation product.
cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.architecture: PRIMER, a coordinate-based diffusion model learning from arbitrary locations, trained in two stages and used for posterior sampling for bias correction, downscaling and data assimilation.
cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.data: Gridded satellite and reanalysis precipitation plus irregular rain gauge observations; also applied to operational forecasts and future scenario fields; specific products are not reported in the abstract.
cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.result: Reduces errors at most gauge sites when correcting existing datasets, downscales reanalysis, produces improved analyses with extra gauges, and generalizes without retraining to forecasts and future scenarios.
cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.open_work: Extend to more regions and variables and use the learned prior in operational data assimilation.
cc623c897e9a663c3ab4edc2218fa9fe37f2804b.issues: Depends on gauge density and quality; generalization to future climates assumes stationarity of the learned prior.

34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.goal: Enables stable long-term hybrid ML-GCM climate simulations, identifying water vapor oversaturation during condensation as a key instability source.
34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.architecture: CondensNet, a neural network architecture with a self-adaptive physical constraint correcting unphysical condensation, coupled to a GCM as PCNN-GCM (hybrid physics-ML model).
34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.data: Training data from cloud-resolving super-parameterization simulations; details are not reported in the abstract.
34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.result: Mitigates oversaturation and enables long-term stable simulations in real-world configurations including ocean and land, with accuracy maintained and lower cost than super-parameterization.
34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.open_work: Apply adaptive physical constraints to other processes and to more complex climate models.
34d58a69c3cb5ed01f4144ded75da0af931fc9cf.issues: Accuracy is judged against super-parameterization rather than observations; quantitative skill and climate change generalization are not reported in the abstract.

ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.goal: Achieves stable, transferable ML convection parameterization in a hybrid Earth system model despite distribution shift between models.
ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.architecture: Physics-informed neural network convection parameterization that predicts its own error, enabling confidence-guided mixing with a conventional convection scheme in ICON-A.
ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.data: ClimSim superparameterized data with radiative tendencies subtracted; tested in ICON-A AMIP-style simulations.
ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.result: Several hybrid configurations outperform the default convection scheme (e.g., precipitation statistics); with input noise during training both hybrid and pure-ML runs remain stable and physically consistent for at least 20 years.
ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.open_work: Tune mixing parameters against observations and reanalysis and extend transfer to other ESMs and coupled setups.
ed7e4f6c7fbda817257464d19a8fa99bbcc34cc6.issues: Proof of concept; distribution shift between ClimSim and ICON-A remains; evaluation in AMIP-style setups only.

e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.goal: Tests whether deep learning GCMs reproduce extreme heat and cold wave frequencies outside their training period.
e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.architecture: Evaluation of the hybrid NeuralGCM and the purely data-driven DLESyM deep learning models against the conventional HiRAM high-resolution model.
e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.data: All models forced with observed SST and sea ice over 1900–2020, focusing on out-of-sample 1900–1960.
e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.result: Both DL models reproduce the frequency and spatial patterns of land heatwaves and coldwaves with skill comparable to HiRAM; all perform poorly over parts of North Asia and North America in 1940–1960.
e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.open_work: Improve temperature persistence in data-driven models and test generalization to future warming.
e50c51e946e84d286b47d2b0683cbc4818dcdb9b.issues: DLESyM overestimates event frequencies due to excessive temperature autocorrelation; early-century observations are uncertain; out-of-sample period is cooler, not warmer.

46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.goal: Comprehensively evaluates machine learning weather models for tropical cyclone track, intensity and physical structure before they replace NWP.
46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.architecture: Evaluation of GraphCast (graph neural network), Pangu-Weather, Aurora and FourCastNet (transformer and neural operator models) against three NWP models and observations.
46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.data: Tropical cyclones across all tropical ocean basins; verification against observations (best track) and NWP forecasts.
46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.result: All MLWP models have mean track errors below 200 km at 96 h but underestimate maximum winds; they capture vorticity advection, low-level convergence and warm cores with weaker magnitude; Aurora performs best.
46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.open_work: Reduce intensity bias by addressing training data biases and the double penalty effect, e.g. through higher resolution or probabilistic training.
46df8b1bdcb99cd57cde60eca29ee15d8123e68c.issues: Intensity low bias linked to reanalysis training data and double penalization; weaker structure magnitudes than observed.

f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.goal: Transfers data assimilation diagnostics such as Forecast Sensitivity-based Observation Impact (FSOI) to machine-learning weather models to make the observation-driven GraphDOP model interpretable and explainable.
f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.architecture: Graph neural network (GraphDOP, ECMWF) with a sliding attention window, analysed through adjoint-style sensitivities obtained by automatic differentiation; FSOI computed via gradients of forecast error.
f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.data: Conventional in-situ and satellite observations ingested directly by GraphDOP at ECMWF; no reanalysis input. Specific periods not reported in the abstract.
f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.result: The attention window learns meteorological features and spatial relationships, e.g. storm-system movement; FSOI shows GraphDOP builds an internal Earth-system representation combining conventional and satellite observations.
f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.open_work: Using these diagnostics to guide observing-system design and model development for observation-driven ML forecasting, and comparing ML and NWP observation impacts.
f095a0aa57f367f50d0c7f30853cbe9d610077ef.issues: Mainly qualitative case-based diagnostics; gradient-based sensitivities of a neural network may be noisy and do not guarantee physical causality.

02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.goal: Tests whether atmospheric ML climate models generalize out of distribution by evaluating their equilibrium response to a uniform sea surface temperature warming benchmark.
02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.architecture: Evaluation study of existing ML atmosphere models: ACE2-ERA5 (spherical Fourier neural operator), NeuralGCM (hybrid differentiable GCM with neural network physics) and cBottle (diffusion model), against the physics-based GFDL AM4 GCM.
02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.data: Uniform SST warming experiments forcing the ML models and GFDL AM4; the ML models were trained mainly on ERA5 reanalysis.
02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.result: ML models reproduce key aspects of the AM4 response, especially precipitation, but some show notable departures in radiative responses and land warming.
02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.open_work: Improving out-of-sample generalization of ML climate models for climate-change applications, e.g. training with warmer climates or physical constraints.
02ddaa689729c3567b743f286c2673ea8e77c06e.issues: Single idealized forcing benchmark; AM4 is used as the reference, so its own biases define the target; ML models trained on present-day reanalysis struggle outside that distribution.

578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.goal: Improves seasonal sea ice prediction by embedding machine-learning sea ice bias correction online in a fully coupled climate model.
578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.architecture: Hybrid model: neural network bias-correction inference embedded in GFDL SPEAR; compares HybridCPL (trained with coupled ice-atmosphere-ocean feedbacks) and HybridIO (trained in ice-ocean configuration without feedbacks).
578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.data: GFDL SPEAR global fully coupled 1-year retrospective forecasts; training data from SPEAR data-assimilation increments (details not reported in the abstract).
578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.result: HybridCPL reduces Arctic seasonal errors and Antarctic errors for May to December targets, with more than 2x error reduction at 4–6 month leads for Antarctic winter extent; HybridIO drifts to ice-free Antarctic summers.
578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.open_work: Extending online ML corrections to other components and longer forecasts, and improving robustness of ML corrections to coupled feedbacks.
578a4c85fdbd425937d43e930cad7f711bf24b53.issues: Training without coupled feedbacks causes out-of-sample instability; gains are confined to sea ice within one model system and forecast length is one year.

351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.goal: Builds cheap generative emulators of Earth system model outputs to supply impact models with joint distributions of climate variables under alternative future scenarios.
351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.architecture: Score-based diffusion model on a spherical mesh, conditioned on forcing, running on a single mid-range GPU.
351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.data: Monthly ESM fields of near-surface temperature, precipitation, relative humidity and wind speed from three CMIP-class Earth system models in pre-industrial and forced regimes.
351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.result: Emulated distributions closely match the parent ESMs and capture key forced responses; errors are small relative to internal variability, though failures occur for variables with strong seasonal-cycle regime shifts.
351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.open_work: Extending to daily resolution, finer spatial scales and bias-aware training.
351775b71cbe9113bfb9dfa72c63870000055c06.issues: Monthly coarse output only; mismatches for variables with seasonal regime shifts; emulates ESMs, so it inherits ESM biases.

36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.goal: Explores whether hybrid ML-physics atmospheric models can deliver useful seasonal predictions of large-scale circulation and Northern Hemisphere tropical cyclone activity.
36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.architecture: NeuralGCM, a hybrid model combining a differentiable dynamical core with neural network physics, run with persisted-anomaly SST and sea ice boundary conditions.
36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.data: Seasonal hindcasts for July–November 1990–2023 verified against observed TC records; NeuralGCM was trained on ERA5 reanalysis.
36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.result: Simulates 100 days in about 8 minutes on one GPU; predicted North Atlantic and East Pacific TC frequency correlates with observations at r of about 0.7, comparable to physical GCMs, with significant skill for ACE and sub-basin tracks.
36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.open_work: Coupling to ocean models or better boundary forcing, higher resolution, and seamless weather-climate prediction of TC risk.
36bfddf3251293160a5510704e02f78583bae1f7.issues: Coarse resolution limits TC representation; simplified persisted-anomaly SST forcing; skill assessed on a modest number of seasons.

3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.goal: Overcomes the computational bottleneck of Lagrangian particle dispersion models in satellite-based inverse estimation of greenhouse gas emissions.
3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.architecture: Graph neural network emulator (GATES) of an LPDM that predicts source-receptor footprints from meteorology and surface data.
3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.data: LPDM footprints over South America for training; GOSAT methane observations for 2016 and 2018 used in a Brazil emissions inversion.
3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.result: GATES is about 1000x faster than the LPDM and yields Brazilian methane emissions consistent in space and time with the physics-driven estimate.
3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.open_work: Scaling to denser satellite datasets (e.g. TROPOMI) and other regions and gases, and operational inventory evaluation.
3064939d5f4cf8ff4c7bb085eace62074ceebf2e.issues: Emulator errors propagate into flux estimates; demonstrated over one region and two years; skill depends on the training LPDM and meteorology.

1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.goal: Constructs plausible worst-case heatwave storylines to probe the upper bounds of extreme events for climate risk assessment at low cost.
1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.architecture: Gradient-based optimization of initial conditions through the differentiable hybrid climate model NeuralGCM (dynamical core plus neural network physics).
1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.data: Case study of the 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave; compared with a 75-member ensemble. Initial-condition source not detailed in the abstract.
1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.result: Optimized trajectories produce heatwave intensity up to 3.7 °C above the most extreme of 75 ensemble members, with intensified blocking and amplified Rossby waves.
1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.open_work: Applying the method to other extremes and warmer climates, and quantifying the plausibility and likelihood of optimized storylines.
1da384be33fbc2a9ee313fa3bb567b245af1470c.issues: Single event; physical plausibility depends on NeuralGCM fidelity at extremes; optimized initial conditions may be unrealistic and the likelihood of storylines is not quantified.

4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.goal: Improves the physical consistency of deterministic ML weather predictions, which are blurred and contain artifacts under MSE training.
4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.architecture: FastNet, a graph neural network global forecast model, trained with alternative losses: modified spherical harmonic spectral loss, horizontal gradient terms, and a speed-direction wind representation.
4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.data: Global reanalysis-style gridded training data; the specific product is not reported in the abstract.
4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.result: Combined spectral and gradient losses keep MSE close to an MSE-trained model while greatly improving spectral fidelity and physical consistency; the wind representation improves wind speed and reduces directional bias.
4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.open_work: Further embedding domain knowledge through losses and moving toward operational readiness, possibly combined with probabilistic training.
4a464b52eb3188a7901397472170d982011ad739.issues: Deterministic model; spectral losses can slightly degrade RMSE alone; remaining physical inconsistencies not fully addressed.

9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.goal: Reduces the cost and subjectivity of climate model tuning by using ML emulators to calibrate free parameterization parameters of ICON-A.
9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.architecture: ML-based emulator fitted to a perturbed parameter ensemble, combined with history matching and sequential parameter selection via Sobol sensitivity indices.
9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.data: Perturbed parameter ensemble of ICON-A 2.6.4 at 80 km resolution; reference Earth observations of radiation, cloud cover, water vapour path, zonal winds and ocean wind stress.
9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.result: One iteration yields TOA net radiation within 0 to 1 W m-2 and radiation metrics and water vapour path consistent with observations; key parameters are upper-tropospheric critical relative humidity, cloud-to-rain conversion and ice sedimentation velocity.
9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.open_work: Further iterations, higher resolutions and additional tuning targets including regional metrics and coupled configurations.
9742283b17b9369b562413e34df79b7313288987.issues: Global-mean targets may hide regional errors; emulator accuracy limited by small ensemble size; tuning to observations can compensate structural errors.

2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.goal: Examines why neural climate emulators struggle to reproduce forced responses and how emulators can support causal studies such as Green's function experiments.
2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.architecture: Linear response theory analysis of a simplified multiscale dynamical system, plus a stochastic neural network reduced-order model with data-inferred multiplicative noise.
2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.data: Simplified dynamical system simulations and a real-world dataset of surface temperature fields and radiative fluxes (product not specified in the abstract).
2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.result: Reproducing perturbed statistics depends on an appropriate coarse-grained representation and parameterization of unresolved processes; the neural model largely reproduces the probability distribution and enables forced-response studies.
2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.open_work: Developing goal-specific coarse-grained stochastic emulators and using response theory to guide emulator design.
2de71df948a744ace2d8e42a269e862c983b0d3b.issues: Largely conceptual; real-world model has acknowledged limitations; findings from simplified systems may not transfer directly to full general-purpose emulators.

fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.goal: Develops a data-driven parameterization of unresolved submesoscale vertical buoyancy fluxes in the ocean mixed layer for GCMs.
fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) predicting mixed-layer vertical buoyancy flux from large-scale variables, compared with a physics-based submesoscale parameterization.
fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.data: 12 regions sampled from the global high-resolution MITgcm LLC4320 simulation, coarse-grained at several filter scales.
fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.result: The CNN shows high offline skill across regions, seasons and filter scales, though lower in winter and spring when submesoscales are most active; it depends on the large-scale strain field.
fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.open_work: Online implementation in GCMs and adding strain/frontogenesis dependence to physics-based parameterizations.
fdb39457c5ffd11b5cf31f835339dadf76c69872.issues: Offline-only evaluation; trained on a single model simulation; reduced skill in seasons of strongest submesoscale activity.

0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.goal: Seeks to predict forced long-term radiative feedbacks from internal variability by learning the pattern effect linking surface temperature patterns to TOA radiation.
0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) mapping near-surface temperature maps to global-mean TOA radiation anomalies, compared with regularized linear regression and analysed with explainable AI.
0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.data: Climate model simulations: internal variability (e.g. control runs) for training and strongly forced climate-change runs for testing, within and across models.
0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.result: Trained only on internal variability, the CNN predicts radiation under strong climate change, beats linear regression, and works across models, drawing skill from physically meaningful but smaller-scale regions.
0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.open_work: Applying to observations to constrain feedbacks and climate sensitivity, and studying the identified small-scale regions physically.
0489dcaf5ce00aebd19f75a1999bde961973f7bf.issues: Annual global-mean target; relies on climate models whose feedbacks may differ from reality; application to short observational records untested.

8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.goal: Efficiently fine-tunes GraphCast to a different operational analysis system (ECCC GDPS) with limited training data and compute.
8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.architecture: GraphCast graph neural network, 37-level 0.25° version, fine-tuned with an abbreviated curriculum and an empirically determined vertical error weighting.
8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.data: ECCC GDPS analyses July 2019–December 2021 for fine-tuning; a control fine-tuned on ERA5 for comparison.
8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.result: The GDPS-tuned model significantly outperforms both the operational GDPS forecast and unmodified GraphCast when initialized from GDPS analyses over 1–10 day leads in the troposphere.
8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.open_work: Extending to other analysis systems, longer training periods and operational deployment, and handling the stratosphere and surface variables.
8f096d9f2ba262063a1198c09cac0c441cfab8d6.issues: Short training period; verification against its own GDPS analysis; deterministic model with smoothing at longer leads.

76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.goal: Shows that an observation-driven ML model can capture coupled Earth-system interactions without explicit coupling between component models.
76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.architecture: GraphDOP, a graph neural network that embeds diverse satellite and in-situ observations into a shared latent space and forecasts directly in observation space.
76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.data: Raw satellite and in-situ observations spanning atmosphere, ocean, land and cryosphere, without reanalysis or NWP inputs; case studies of Arctic freezing, Hurricane Ian (2022) and the 2022 European heat wave.
76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.result: Case studies show GraphDOP captures rapid Arctic sea-ice freezing, mixing-induced ocean surface cooling under Hurricane Ian, and the 2022 European heat wave.
76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.open_work: Systematic quantitative evaluation of coupled processes and progress toward end-to-end data-driven Earth-system prediction.
76de047d9342202eb429639e247f2ea574b1f910.issues: Evidence is case-study based without broad statistical verification; physical consistency of implicit coupling is not guaranteed.

adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.goal: Provides skillful precipitation nowcasts globally, especially in the Global South where radar coverage is sparse.
adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.architecture: Global MetNet, an operational deep neural network nowcasting model; specific network family not detailed in the abstract.
adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.data: GPM CORRA precipitation dataset, geostationary satellite data and global NWP data; validated with ground radar and satellite data.
adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.result: Forecasts 12 h at about 0.05° and 15 min resolution, outperforms industry-standard hourly forecasts in CSI and FSS, and is deployed on Google Search for millions of users.
adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.open_work: Improving skill in data-sparse regions and integrating more sparse high-resolution satellite observations.
adc1921316f0c6e2e48a3d8eace4dbdcb77615d2.issues: Targets from GPM CORRA are sparse and imperfect; verification is limited where ground truth is scarce; probabilistic calibration details not reported.

7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.goal: Combines physics-based and machine-learned ensemble forecasts to gain the large-scale skill of ML while keeping physically governed mesoscale structure.
7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.architecture: Spectral nudging of IFS-ENS large-scale virtual temperature and vorticity toward the machine-learned AIFS-ENS ensemble (a transformer-based probabilistic model).
7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.data: ECMWF IFS-ENS and AIFS-ENS ensemble forecasts; verification period not reported in the abstract.
7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.result: Predictive skill extends by up to two days in the tropics and about half a day in the extratropics relative to IFS-ENS; tropical cyclone tracks improve without degrading intensity or spread.
7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.open_work: Operational implementation and tuning of nudging scales and variables.
7a57b924530f974ec86c81cdf34cf0b2e348fa3e.issues: Relies on running two ensemble systems; gains limited to large scales; nudging applied only to upper-air fields.

dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.goal: Analyses empirical scaling laws for data-driven weather models to guide efficient allocation of model size, data and compute.
dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.architecture: Benchmark of scaling behavior across several global weather models including Aurora (transformer) and GraphCast (graph neural network), varying parameters, data and compute.
dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.data: Global weather training datasets of varying size; specific reanalysis products not reported in the abstract.
dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.result: Aurora scales best with data (10x more data reduces validation loss up to 3.2x); GraphCast is most parameter-efficient but has poor hardware utilization; wider rather than deeper models are favoured.
dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.open_work: Building wider architectures with larger effective training datasets and testing scaling on downstream forecast skill.
dbacb0f64f005e059714b4a6e87e941cf452021e.issues: Uses validation loss rather than forecast skill metrics; limited range of model sizes and compute; conclusions may depend on the datasets used.

12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.goal: Builds an accurate and stable ML emulator of droplet-based Lagrangian cloud microphysics to bridge the gap between costly superdroplet schemes and bulk schemes.
12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.architecture: SuperdropNet, a neural network emulator trained with multi-step autoregressive prediction, physical constraints and controlled stochasticity.
12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.data: Lagrangian superdroplet simulation datasets of warm-rain microphysics (box-model setting).
12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.result: SuperdropNet predicts hydrometeor states and cloud-to-rain transition times more accurately than previous ML emulators and matches or beats bulk moment schemes in many cases.
12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.open_work: Coupling into full atmospheric models and testing online in storm-resolving simulations.
12331a847f05745873874d768868432af1f35b40.issues: Evaluated in idealized settings; online stability in a 3D model not demonstrated; limited to processes in the training simulations.

594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.goal: Discovers interpretable governing equations for atmospheric phenomena as an alternative to opaque neural weather models.
594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.architecture: Weak-form sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (WSINDy), a sparse-regression equation-discovery method (not a neural network), adapted to high-dimensional fluid data.
594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.data: Simulated atmospheric data and assimilated (reanalysis) data; specific products not reported in the abstract.
594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.result: WSINDy learns effective symbolic PDE models of atmospheric dynamics from both simulated and assimilated data.
594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.open_work: Scaling to more complex, multivariate and 3D atmospheric systems and assessing forecast skill of discovered models.
594f5b6a56b409e6c26e675d734b6f173e24d592.issues: Demonstration-focused without detailed skill comparison against ML models; library choice constrains discoverable physics.

51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.goal: Reduces the computational burden of data assimilation by performing analysis in a learned latent space directly from observations.
51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.architecture: Autoencoder learning a latent space of atmospheric states plus O2Lnet, a neural network mapping observations into the latent space, decoded to obtain the analysis (LSDA-OOA).
51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.data: WRF-FDDA analyses (and alternatively forecasts) for training; idealized and real 2 m temperature observations on 1 km grids.
51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.result: LSDA-OOA yields high-quality T2 analyses robust to observation errors, comparable to WRF-FDDA accuracy and much better when background forecasts have large errors.
51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.open_work: Part II of the series combining background information; extension to more variables and 3D fields.
51a99a0aa1bea6664ee39f4a0e1f6ac8cdf55204.issues: Only 2 m temperature tested; observation-only analysis needs sufficient observations; performance tied to WRF training data.

5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.goal: Challenges the roughly two-week intrinsic predictability limit by optimizing initial conditions for an ML weather model.
5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.architecture: Gradient-based initial-condition optimization through GraphCast (graph neural network); optimized states also tested in Pangu-Weather (transformer).
5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.data: Twice-daily forecasts through 2020 initialized from reanalysis (ERA5) and verified against it.
5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.result: Optimized initial conditions reduce 10-day error by 86% on average with skill beyond 30 days; corrections intensify the Hadley circulation; transferred to Pangu-Weather they yield 21% error reduction peaking at day 4.
5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.open_work: Whether such initial conditions can be identified in real time for operational forecasting.
5175498c4c0bdbb7110bf8b99c2d8eff3608c845.issues: Optimization uses verifying future data, so it is not a forecast; corrections partly compensate model error; results tied to GraphCast.

bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.goal: Compares generative ML methods for downscaling daily precipitation, including their ability to reproduce climate change signals of extremes.
bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.architecture: Intercomparison of generative adversarial networks (GANs), flow matching and diffusion models in multiple configurations, with higher-order ODE solvers to reduce sampling steps.
bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.data: Regional climate model (RCM) daily precipitation simulations over New Zealand for present-day and future climates.
bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.result: All methods are competitive; diffusion and flow matching give higher fidelity and better-calibrated ensembles than under-dispersive GANs; most underestimate end-of-century extreme precipitation change, which only one GAN and one flow-matching setup reproduce.
bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.open_work: Improving extrapolation of climate change signals and evaluating across comprehensive metrics.
bfcf3edc0d53b60ac464bdeb6ac619515baecb41.issues: Emulates a single RCM over one region; perfect-model framework; visual realism and standard skill do not guarantee correct change signals.

322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.goal: Builds an open Earth-system foundation model able to integrate heterogeneous gridded, satellite and station data for diverse downstream forecasting tasks.
322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.architecture: ESFM, a transformer foundation model on Aurora's 3D Swin U-Net backbone with axial attention, per-variable tokenization and adaptive layer-norm ensembles for probabilistic output.
322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.data: ERA5, CMIP6, regionally masked dense data, sparse gridded MODIS satellite data and station data.
322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.result: Competitive or superior to state-of-the-art benchmarks; predicts variables where no initial data exist and captures Super Typhoon Doksuri (2023) and 2024 sudden stratospheric warmings accurately.
322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.open_work: Fine-tuning for further downstream climate-science tasks and extensions with new variables and data sources.
322cb055f89e5aaefd382807ce5ad3ed072c0895.issues: Benchmark details and quantitative margins not given in the abstract; training heavy; reanalysis-trained components inherit their biases.

64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.goal: Infers total sea surface velocity, including ageostrophic components, from SWOT sea surface height for submesoscale studies.
64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.architecture: Machine-learning model mapping SWOT-derived fields to drifter-observed velocities; model type not specified in the abstract.
64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.data: SWOT satellite sea surface height and geostrophic velocity with drifter velocities as targets; compared with reanalysis kinetic energy.
64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.result: Errors relative to drifter velocities are reduced by about 50% versus SWOT geostrophic velocity; kinetic energy agrees better with reanalysis, especially at low latitudes.
64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.open_work: Global application to produce high-resolution SSV products and study submesoscale dynamics.
64fa68c451f15d9e3d56ff52b39a3ca93004d75b.issues: Drifters are sparse and include wind-driven components; short SWOT record; validation against reanalysis is indirect.

db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.goal: Tests online (end-to-end) learning of neural network eddy parameterizations in an idealized ocean gyre.
db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.architecture: Neural network forcing an automatically differentiable barotropic dynamical solver, trained online through the hybrid system dynamics.
db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.data: High-resolution simulations of the idealized barotropic Stommel-Munk wind-driven gyre as reference.
db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.result: A suitably trained NN yields a stable coarse model with reasonable mean state and intrinsic variability, with some generalization to modified wind forcing.
db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.open_work: Enforcing symmetries and extending online learning to more realistic baroclinic ocean models.
db291ec07c6af3e334b133f3f4ad170a551699d0.issues: Highly idealized barotropic setting; the NN parameterized model fails to respect an intrinsic symmetry of the system.

c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.goal: Extends storm nowcasting to 4 hours with more accurate prediction of storm growth and decay using satellite data.
c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.architecture: Deep diffusion model for satellite imagery nowcasting.
c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.data: Geostationary satellite observations; the specific satellite, region and period are not reported in the available text.
c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.result: Provides storm nowcasts up to 4 h ahead with more accurate and detailed growth and decay than baselines (specific metrics not given).
c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.open_work: Global application and integration into operational warning systems.
c869532c7e33c60da60b90de31f1952292204a6a.issues: Abstract text is only the significance statement; quantitative skill, region and baselines not reported here.

bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.goal: Forecasts storm-scale cloud and precipitation evolution directly from observations, bridging extrapolation nowcasting and costly mesoscale NWP.
bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.architecture: Stormscope, a family of transformer-based generative diffusion models producing ensemble forecasts.
bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.data: High-resolution multi-band geostationary satellite imagery and ground-based weather radar over the continental United States.
bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.result: Forecasts at 10 min and 6 km resolution are competitive with operational mesoscale NWP up to 6 h, leading deterministic and probabilistic metrics over 1–6 h.
bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.open_work: Extension to oceanic regions and countries without mesoscale modelling using globally available satellite data.
bf137f1ea96ba2d4ca31b352d0594ab6f50de99e.issues: Trained and evaluated over CONUS only; reliance on radar where available; skill beyond 6 h untested.

073cd1a15fcaf8d4bd355da99bf7ecf1dc149060.goal: Accelerates 4DVar data assimilation for data-driven weather prediction while keeping analyses accurate and stable.
073cd1a15fcaf8d4bd355da99bf7ecf1dc149060.architecture: 4DVarGAN: conditional generative adversarial network solving the 4DVar cost function non-iteratively, with cycle-consistent adversarial data augmentation and 4DVar-based adaptive adjustment.
073cd1a15fcaf8d4bd355da99bf7ecf1dc149060.result: 73-fold acceleration versus 4DVar with the DDWP model, lowest analysis and forecast errors among DL-based DA methods, and stable results across background qualities.
073cd1a15fcaf8d4bd355da99bf7ecf1dc149060.open_work: Extension to multivariate, 3D and real observation settings.
073cd1a15fcaf8d4bd355da99bf7ecf1dc149060.issues: Single variable (Z500) at coarse resolution; simulated observations; idealized relative to operational DA.

50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.goal: Represents the variability and uncertainty of air-sea turbulent fluxes, missing from deterministic bulk algorithms.
50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.architecture: Artificial neural networks predicting Gaussian mean and variance of fluxes, trained with negative log-likelihood; used as a stochastic parameterization.
50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.data: Eddy-covariance air-sea flux measurements; tested in a single-column forced upper-ocean model.
50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.result: NNs provide alternative mean flux estimates with uncertainty; flux algorithm choice affects SST and mixed layer depth seasonally, with largest ensemble spread during spring restratification.
50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.open_work: Testing in coupled weather and climate models and non-Gaussian flux distributions.
50eca9db1227bd590c74c779d5cc43435ed1b0df.issues: Gaussian assumption; limited eddy-covariance sampling; only single-column tests.

64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.goal: Builds a variational data assimilation system for Arctic sea-ice thickness, since the neXtSIM brittle-rheology sea-ice model has no adjoint for 4D-Var.
64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.architecture: Neural network emulator of neXtSIM sea-ice thickness (convolutional, U-Net-like) whose automatic-differentiation adjoint drives a 4D-Var system, testing two background covariance approximations.
64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.data: Arctic-wide neXtSIM mesoscale (~10 km) simulations for emulator training; twin experiments plus assimilation of real CS2SMOS satellite thickness retrievals; comparison with operational neXtSIM-F forecasts.
64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.result: Twin experiments reduce sea-ice thickness RMSE by 0.8 m on average versus the free run and improve marginal ice zone positioning; with CS2SMOS the system corrects forecast bias and matches neXtSIM-F performance.
64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.open_work: Extend to more variables (concentration, drift), assimilate higher-resolution observations, and refine background covariance modelling for emulator-based 4D-Var.
64569a752e6cfb5b64165c8af92e16584d5e2427.issues: Assimilating smooth CS2SMOS retrievals amplifies loss of small-scale information; emulator covers thickness only and inherits neXtSIM biases; the adjoint is that of the emulator, not the physical model.

87b115f42da23f28b60373f888b24ea4c4c19f97.goal: Discusses, as the title implies, how artificial intelligence can support cross-disciplinary climate change research linking physical science, impacts and mitigation.
87b115f42da23f28b60373f888b24ea4c4c19f97.architecture: Perspective or review of AI methods and their role in climate change research; no specific model is reported.
87b115f42da23f28b60373f888b24ea4c4c19f97.open_work: Likely calls for better integration of AI tools across climate disciplines and assessment communities.
87b115f42da23f28b60373f888b24ea4c4c19f97.issues: Content cannot be verified without an abstract; card is inferred from the title only.

66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.goal: Improves medium-range (3–8 day) severe weather guidance by post-processing AI weather model forecasts instead of conventional NWP output.
66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.architecture: Decoder-only transformer that treats forecast lead times as sequential tokens, compared with a dense neural network (MLP) baseline; feature attribution for interpretability.
66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.data: Pangu-Weather forecasts (including runs initialized from high-resolution analysis) and GFS forecasts as predictors, with and without convective parameters; severe weather reports as targets (source not detailed in abstract).
66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.result: Transformer post-processing significantly improves skill over dense networks; Pangu-Weather-based guidance outperforms GFS at medium range even without explicit convective parameters.
66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.open_work: Apply to other AI weather models and ensembles, add convective-scale information, and extend to longer leads or hazard-specific guidance.
66f87fb0954ac9e9514b89ff512889e8b71942b0.issues: Relies on report-based targets with known reporting biases; dependent on a single AI model's skill and initialization; region likely limited to the contiguous US.

c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.goal: Investigates online training of machine-learned ocean eddy parameterizations, where the fluid model is involved during training, versus standard offline regression.
c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.architecture: Neural network (convolutional) subgrid closure trained with a full adjoint-based online approach using a differentiable solver, and an approximately online approach that avoids requiring differentiability.
c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.data: Idealized two-layer quasi-geostrophic baroclinic turbulence simulations, coarse-grained from high-resolution reference runs.
c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.result: The full adjoint-based online approach, without additional constraints, generally yields more skillful models than the approximate online approach; effects of window size, model setup and loss design are documented.
c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.open_work: Transfer online training to realistic ocean models and Earth system models, including those without differentiable code.
c0ca8f022999b69c381f7ada19ba7b1ae9e0a57b.issues: Idealized QG setting only; full online approach requires a differentiable dynamical model, which most operational ocean models lack.

03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.goal: Provides a standardized way to verify AI and NWP weather models on high-impact hazards rather than only global-mean scores or hand-picked cases.
03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.architecture: Benchmark framework and open-source code (Extreme Weather Bench) containing curated case studies, observational data and impact-based metrics; not a forecast model.
03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.data: Standard set of high-impact event case studies spanning multiple spatial and temporal scales and hazard types, with associated observational datasets; specific products not listed in the abstract.
03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.result: Introduces EWB as a community-driven benchmark enabling like-for-like comparisons across AI and NWP models on specific high-impact phenomena.
03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.open_work: Add more phenomena, test cases and metrics together with the forecast verification community.
03c493ae9157625fc1080864de319bcb2901c4df.issues: Case-study-based evaluation has limited sample sizes per hazard; results depend on chosen cases, observations and metrics; no benchmark results are reported in the abstract.

602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.goal: Builds a fast global sea-ice emulator that conserves mass and generalizes across climates, for coupling with existing atmosphere and ocean ML emulators.
602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.architecture: Graph neural network (FloeNet) that predicts 6-hourly mass and area budget tendencies for sea ice and snow on sea ice (growth, melt, advection), ensuring mass conservation.
602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.data: Output of the GFDL SIS2 sea ice model from a reanalysis-forced ice-ocean simulation for training; tested on pre-industrial and 1% CO2 forcing runs.
602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.result: Outperforms a non-conservative model in mean state, trends and variability, with volume anomaly correlations above 0.96 (Antarctic) and 0.76 (Arctic) across forcings, and reproduces coupling fluxes.
602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.open_work: Couple FloeNet with atmosphere and ocean emulators to improve polar processes in coupled ML climate models.
602bee5aab8f0d0e2c425cfd1c6838f809d4d793.issues: Emulates a single physical model and inherits its biases; Arctic skill lower than Antarctic; tested offline with prescribed forcing rather than in a fully coupled emulator.

0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.goal: Argues that RMSE is a misspecified training loss for precipitation, which is zero-inflated, non-negative and heavy-tailed, and proposes a better likelihood-based alternative.
0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.architecture: Tweedie deviance loss (compound Poisson–Gamma, 1<p<2) applied to a diffusion model for downscaling and a ConvLSTM for nowcasting, compared with RMSE training.
0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.data: Precipitation data across temporal aggregations to estimate the Tweedie power p; downscaling case over Beijing and nowcasting case over Kolkata (specific products not given in the abstract).
0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.result: Tweedie loss improves wet-pixel MAE and 99th-percentile extreme recall (0.611 vs 0.566) in downscaling; in nowcasting MAE gains grow from 3.5% at t+1 to 8.7% at t+4.
0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.open_work: Test Tweedie losses in global data-driven weather models and other semi-continuous variables, and learn p adaptively.
0d2be391aba77257b81173620525c2bdb7ac351e.issues: Only two regional case studies; extreme recall at the 99.9th percentile is not significantly better at short leads; choice of p adds a tuning step.

5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.goal: Produces operational, high-resolution global nowcasts and week-long forecasts of ocean surface currents from incomplete satellite and in situ observations.
5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.architecture: Multi-stage, multi-arm encoder-decoder neural network (ORCAst) that first predicts sea surface height and geostrophic currents, then total surface currents.
5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.data: Trained entirely on observations: nadir and SWOT altimetry for SSH and geostrophic currents, and sparse drifter velocities for surface currents; regional training variants.
5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.result: Achieves stronger nowcast and forecast skill for ocean surface currents than various state-of-the-art methods; region-specific training further improves performance.
5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.open_work: Integrate more observation types, extend lead times and improve global generalization without regional retraining.
5340870a5d5aa021eecdf8d43683aea48aff94b3.issues: Drifter ground truth is sparse and unevenly distributed; quantitative gains and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.

ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.goal: Characterizes why AI weather models become unstable when rolled out beyond two weeks and establishes a taxonomy of failure modes.
ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.architecture: Benchmark and analysis of nine state-of-the-art AI weather models in year-long rollouts, with ablations on Vision Transformer (ViT) architectural design choices.
ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.data: Year-long autoregressive rollouts of pretrained AI weather models; training and verification data presumably ERA5 reanalysis, not specified in the abstract.
ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.result: Failures fall into blow-up, drift and loss of seasonality; stable models damp high-frequency energy and act as denoisers yet still produce distinct trajectories conditioned on initial state.
ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.open_work: Use the taxonomy and spectral diagnostics to design architectures that remain stable for subseasonal to climate time scales.
ff7502e071a4390a21c91478caed4b4fc7588384.issues: Ablations limited to ViT-style architectures; seasonality and drift diagnostics do not establish climate fidelity; models lack ocean coupling or forcing changes.

f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.goal: Tests whether a neural-network cloud and convection parameterization trained on present-day climate can run stably and accurately in a warmer climate with real geography.
f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.architecture: Deep neural network moist-physics parameterization (following Han et al. 2023, residual network style) with added inputs including convective memory, radiative variables and land fraction, coupled online in a GCM (CAM5 framework).
f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.data: Trained on present-day superparameterized CAM (SPCAM) data; evaluated in decade-long online runs with +4 K SST against SPCAM and CAM5 simulations.
f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.result: Achieves a stable decade-long +4 K simulation that captures precipitation, temperatures, vertical structure and extremes, with climate response similar to SPCAM and CAM5 and no accuracy degradation.
f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.open_work: Test under coupled ocean and transient warming scenarios, and other climate states beyond uniform SST warming.
f7835df5cb13d97791c0358910119159e89ae8e5.issues: Prescribed uniform +4 K SST is an idealized warming; removing convective memory causes instability; evaluation is against model references, not observations.

9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.goal: Addresses spectral degradation (damping, aliasing, high-frequency leakage) in ML weather forecasts that blurs small scales.
9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.architecture: Probabilistic transformer (Mosaic) with mesh-aligned block-sparse attention on native grids and ensemble generation through learned functional perturbations; 214M parameters.
9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.data: Global reanalysis at 1.5° resolution (presumably ERA5); compared against models trained at 6x finer resolution.
9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.result: Matches or beats finer-resolution models on key variables, achieves state-of-the-art among 1.5° models with well-calibrated ensembles and near-perfect spectral alignment; 24-member 10-day forecast in under 12 s on one H100.
9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.open_work: Scale to finer resolutions such as 0.25° and evaluate on extremes and longer leads.
9f6e37fb51deb274ddc30c64ae0007e5749305a4.issues: Coarse 1.5° resolution limits resolved scales; scores likely against reanalysis rather than observations.

722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.goal: Creates a single model-agnostic downscaler that turns deterministic coarse weather forecasts into probabilistic high-resolution forecasts without per-model fine-tuning.
722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.architecture: Conditional diffusion model trained on paired coarse (~25 km) inputs and high-resolution targets, applied zero-shot to forecasts from multiple upstream models.
722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.data: High-resolution (~5 km) regional reanalysis targets; downscaled forecasts from several AI and NWP systems evaluated against in situ station observations up to 90 h lead.
722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.result: Ensemble mean of downscaled forecasts consistently improves on each model's raw deterministic forecast, with larger gains in probabilistic skill (CRPS).
722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.open_work: Extend to more variables, longer leads and other regions, and combine with ensemble upstream forecasts.
722ec4246b895dfdbd285971d4f0b072182bf03f.issues: Focused on near-surface variables and one region; zero-shot transfer may degrade for upstream models with very different biases; regional reanalysis product not named in the abstract.

fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.goal: Improves out-of-distribution generalization of ML moist-physics parameterizations to warmer climates without labeled warm-climate training data or manual climate-invariant features.
fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.architecture: Autoencoder with explicit latent-space representation alignment (CERA) followed by a predictor network for process tendencies.
fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.data: Labeled control-climate data and unlabeled +4 K climate inputs from climate model simulations (specific model not stated in the abstract).
fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.result: Outperforms raw-input and physically informed baselines on moisture and energy tendencies in the +4 K climate, capturing vertical and meridional structures and precipitation intensity shifts including extremes.
fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.open_work: Apply to online hybrid simulations and other tasks such as statistical downscaling.
fa8627a919470e7288542dadfa417d049703a6bb.issues: Reduced skill remains in the boundary layer; evaluated offline only; requires unlabeled inputs from the target climate.

ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.goal: Tests whether a data-driven model trained only on observations, without NWP reanalysis or model data, can produce competitive medium-range forecasts.
ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.architecture: AIFS-based machine learning forecasting system (AIFS-DOP) for direct observation prediction; details beyond the AIFS framework (graph neural network encoder-decoder with transformer processor) not given in the abstract.
ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.data: 40-year harmonized dataset of gridded observations for training; one-year forecast period across 2021/2022 verified against observations and compared with ECMWF IFS.
ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.result: First observation-only data-driven model competitive with IFS at medium range for several key upper-air and surface headline scores when verified against observations.
ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.open_work: Extend observation coverage and variables, and close remaining gaps with IFS for all scores.
ee0627961b56aca87abf4f915ca973aec47b0829.issues: Competitive only for several headline scores; gridded observations have coverage gaps; one-year evaluation period.

37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.goal: Explores AI weather models for fast storyline-based climate attribution, using the February 2017 Oroville Dam atmospheric river as a case.
37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.architecture: Pretrained AI global weather models (GraphCast, Pangu-Weather, FourCastNet, SFNO) run with initial conditions perturbed by climate change signals; compared to a dynamical model.
37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.data: Initial conditions perturbed with pre-industrial and late-21st-century temperature change signals; dynamical model simulations as pseudo-reality; AI ensembles over 500 members.
37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.result: AI models project a 5–6% increase in integrated water vapor over Oroville versus pre-industrial, consistent with the dynamical model, but generally weaker attribution signals, especially for late-21st-century.
37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.open_work: Use explainable AI to build confidence in physical responses and enable real-time attribution.
37367d01605a0e3f64df5d61184684ed6572cfc4.issues: Reduced extrapolation skill to out-of-distribution climates; models differ in geopotential-moisture-temperature dependencies; single event studied.

6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.goal: Argues for closer collaboration between climate simulator and ML emulator communities to accelerate climate science.
6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.architecture: Perspective on machine learning emulators of Earth system models; no new model is presented.
6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.data: Not applicable; discusses simulator outputs, ML-ready benchmarks and data products in general terms.
6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.result: Proposes three priorities: co-design of simulators and emulators, shared ML-ready benchmarks emphasizing physical fidelity, and treating emulators as reliable documented software components.
6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.open_work: Build shared benchmarks, data partitions and deployment pathways for emulators in scenario exploration and uncertainty decomposition.
6c23b4109890f04b8f1b8a02bd15a0f7887c1be8.issues: Opinion piece without quantitative evaluation; practical implementation across modeling centers remains open.

337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.goal: Separates the effects of SST and CO2 forcing in ML climate emulators, which fail for AMIP +4 K or abrupt 4xCO2 because training data correlate the two.
337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.architecture: Ai2 Climate Emulator (ACE), a Spherical Fourier Neural Operator-based autoregressive emulator, with a total energy conservation constraint.
337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.data: Balanced mix of AMIP, equilibrium-climate and new random-CO2 reference simulations where SST and CO2 vary independently, from a physics-based atmospheric model (with slab-ocean coupling).
337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.result: More data-efficient model that matches previous ACE skill and also accurately emulates AMIP +4 K and slab-ocean abrupt 4xCO2 scenarios where earlier versions behaved unphysically.
337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.open_work: Add interactive ocean, land and sea ice components and expose other climate drivers such as aerosols as forcings.
337efcbd84daed08787126c31f1c008e04f96ced.issues: Simplified or prescribed ocean, land and sea ice; few forcings; trained only on physics-model output so inherits its biases relative to observations.

9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.goal: Assesses how well ML weather prediction models forecast the intensity and winds of Northern Hemisphere midlatitude cyclones.
9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.architecture: Feature-based evaluation using cyclone tracking applied to seven MLWP models and the ECMWF IFS; not a new model.
9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.data: Over 1000 Northern Hemisphere cyclones tracked from 1 October 2023 to 31 March 2024 in MLWP and IFS forecasts; verification data not detailed in the abstract.
9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.result: MLWP tracks match IFS accuracy to 10 days, but MLWP models underestimate cyclone depth by more than 5 hPa at day 10 and underpredict peak 10-m winds even at short leads, unlike IFS.
9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.open_work: Develop MLWP training or architectures that preserve extremes and sharp features such as peak winds.
9d92d165154fbf6bddbb695eadb57ae44f86a9b9.issues: Single winter season; results specific to the model versions tested; reasons for biases (e.g., smoothing from MSE training) not fully diagnosed.

0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.goal: Accelerates full atmospheric photochemistry simulation in 3D models by replacing a complex chemical solver with a stable AI scheme.
0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.architecture: Transformer-style Feature-Mapping Subspace Self-Attention (FMSSA) network forming the AIPC scheme, compared with MLP and ResNet baselines; coupled online in WRF-Chem.
0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.data: WRF-Chem simulations with the full SAPRC-99 mechanism (79 species, 229 reactions); monthly online tests in August and February.
0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.result: FMSSA cuts attention cost by 91%, reaches mean NRMSE of 3.09% for 69 species offline, and runs stably online in August with 77% faster computation than the numerical solver.
0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.open_work: Expand training data, refine the architecture and test across broader spatiotemporal regimes.
0d49de6322ddd2608c2e7300baf0e7e666fdc884.issues: Performance degrades in February for all AIPC schemes, showing poor generalization across distinct atmospheric regimes; limited temporal testing.

33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.goal: Provides a way to assess physical consistency of ML weather prediction models beyond pixel-wise error metrics such as RMSE.
33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.architecture: Evaluation framework (PhysMetrics.Weather) with conservation, spectral and dynamical metrics; open-source code, not a forecast model.
33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.data: Applied to MLWP model forecasts; specific models and datasets not listed in the abstract.
33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.result: Introduces a tool quantifying physical realism of MLWP forecasts to guide physics-informed architecture development and operational reliability assessment.
33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.open_work: Extend metrics and apply systematically across MLWP models to inform physics-informed design.
33e8948dccbae5ad8616d15f2916cdf905f67703.issues: Abstract reports no quantitative findings; physical metrics depend on reference datasets and diagnostic choices.

60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.goal: Improves poorly skilled convective rainfall forecasts over East Africa using generative ML post-processing.
