60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.architecture: Conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) combined with a neighborhood quantile mapping, producing ensembles for probabilistic forecasts.
60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.data: Hourly ECMWF IFS forecasts at 6–18 h lead times at 0.1° resolution as input; satellite-based precipitation observations (likely IMERG) as truth, including the March–May 2018 season.
60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.result: cGAN substantially improves the rainfall diurnal cycle and predictions up to the 99.9th percentile (~10 mm/h), and generalizes to the extremely wet March–May 2018 season.
60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.open_work: Improve ensemble calibration and extend to longer lead times and other tropical regions.
60176cdbe12231d40498494176d3c1002bb9f7e0.issues: Ensemble spread shows a mix of under- and over-dispersion; short lead times only; observational target has its own errors.

3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.goal: Produces a global, near-real-time, hourly precipitation dataset from 1979 to present using machine learning to merge multiple sources.
3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.architecture: Dataset paper: machine learning model stacks merge satellite and (re)analysis precipitation and temperature with static variables, followed by gauge-based correction; specific learner types not named in the abstract.
3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.data: Trained on 15,959 hourly/daily gauges; corrected with 57,666 daily and 86,000 monthly stations; evaluated on 15,958 independent gauges against ERA5, IMERG-L V7, GSMaP V8, CHIRP and others.
3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.result: MSWEP V3 baseline reaches median daily KGE 0.69, beating ERA5 (0.61), IMERG-L (0.46), GSMaP (0.38) and CHIRP (0.31); gauge correction adds 0.09 to median daily correlation.
3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.open_work: Use for monitoring, forecasting and water-risk management; continued updates with ~2-hour latency.
3b07696dec414fe435a617d6b7d24db7ff3af5b0.issues: Gauge-sparse regions remain less constrained; evaluation at gauges may not reflect grid-scale accuracy; early-period skill depends on available inputs.

830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.goal: Delivers global ocean forecasts at sub-daily, eddy-resolving resolution with deep learning, independent of NWP atmospheric forcing.
830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.architecture: Deep learning ocean forecasting model (FuXi-Ocean) that adaptively fuses forecasts across multiple temporal windows to limit autoregressive error growth; network family not specified in the abstract.
830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.data: Global 1/12° ocean data to 1500 m depth at 6-hourly steps (likely an ocean reanalysis such as GLORYS); near-surface atmospheric variables for initialization; evaluation for 2022.
830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.result: Stable 10-day forecasts despite four times more autoregressive steps than daily models, outperforming WenHai for temperature, salinity, currents, SST and sea level anomaly.
830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.open_work: Extend lead times and fully couple with AI atmospheric models.
830e07dc86147de48c53f09b075a55f2cdfef3cb.issues: Evaluated over a single year, likely against reanalysis; omits deeper ocean below 1500 m; NWP-independence limits use of atmospheric forecast information.

39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.goal: Detects clouds, including thin cirrus, in hyperspectral VSWIR imaging spectroscopy where clouds distort quantitative retrievals.
39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.architecture: Spectroscopic Transformer (SpecTf), a transformer operating on per-pixel spectra with interpretable attention.
39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.data: EMIT imaging spectrometer data with cloud labels; tested for transfer to other imaging spectrometers (details not in the abstract).
39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.result: Produces highly accurate, robust cloud masks, learns physically meaningful spectral features and generalizes between instruments.
39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.open_work: Develop instrument-agnostic models for new orbital imaging spectrometers.
39fffdb01b079e43292d73a89be62aa8124ccfd9.issues: Quantitative accuracy and comparison baselines not given in the abstract; depends on quality of cloud labels.

35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.goal: Evaluates ML radiative transfer parameterizations coupled online to ICON on GPUs, for accuracy, stability and speed.
35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.architecture: Five ML models: MLP, U-Net, bidirectional LSTM (recurrent neural network), vision transformer and random forest, coupled via the PyTorch-Fortran coupler.
35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.data: ICON aquaplanet simulations at about 80 km with ecRad as the reference radiative transfer scheme.
35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.result: BiLSTM with physics-informed normalization, heating-rate penalty and smoothing is most accurate and enables stable multi-week aquaplanet runs; cost is comparable to GPU-optimized ecRad.
35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.open_work: Test in realistic configurations with land, aerosols and longer climate runs.
35c9816c0e627725c78a2f144f7ecb4d7441d628.issues: Aquaplanet only, weeks-long runs; stability needs ad hoc smoothing and upper-level fixes; no clear speed-up over GPU-optimized physics.

a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.goal: Provides data-driven global seasonal predictions of temperature and rainfall anomalies comparable to operational products while separating skill from climate-change trends.
a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.architecture: Transformer combined with variational inference for probabilistic seasonal prediction.
a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.data: Trained on CMIP6 model output; tested against ERA5 reanalysis; benchmarked against ECMWF SEAS5.
a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.result: Temperature forecasts show skill beyond climatology and trend, outperforming SEAS5 in some ocean and land areas; precipitation skill is more limited.
a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.open_work: Improve precipitation skill and investigate shared predictability sources with dynamical systems.
a2f5231266a665259bc1a40415aafdc40da1f3de.issues: Limited precipitation skill; trained on CMIP6 so inherits model biases and domain shift to ERA5; short verification record.

d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.goal: Simulates Lagrangian drift trajectories at the sea surface more accurately than model-based and learning-based methods.
d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.architecture: DriftNet, a deep convolutional neural network inspired by the Eulerian Fokker-Planck representation, taking Eulerian surface currents and an encoded initial position.
d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.data: Two benchmarks with fully simulated ocean data and one combining operational ocean reanalysis with in situ drifters; North East Pacific and Gulf Stream regions; SSH inputs from model and observations.
d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.result: DriftNet outperforms state-of-the-art model-based and learning-based drift methods; the study also quantifies the influence of SSH inputs on drift simulation.
d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.open_work: Extend to global domains, longer trajectories and observation-only inputs.
d3fa976a0578ac5323c9f0266573bbccffde0816.issues: Two regions only; depends on quality of input current fields; quantitative gains not given in the abstract.

8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.goal: Creates interpretable ENSO forecasts while identifying regions where initial errors matter most.
8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.architecture: Optimized model-analog method in which a convolutional neural network estimates state-dependent weights for selecting analogs from a model simulation library.
8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.data: CESM2 Large Ensemble as analog library and training data; evaluation also against a reanalysis dataset at seasonal-to-annual leads.
8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.result: Significantly improves on unweighted model-analogs and matches a standalone neural network; El Niño forecasts are sensitive to winter tropical Pacific SST, La Niña to summer zonal wind stress.
8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.open_work: Apply to other phenomena such as regional temperature and precipitation.
8a6ad32b6ab3c5820985a56ee71db0498178b0fc.issues: Limited by the analog library's model biases; reanalysis verification record is short.

29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.goal: Assesses whether ML weather models have physically meaningful tangent linear and adjoint properties required for data assimilation.
29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.architecture: Evaluation of tangent linear and adjoint models of GraphCast (graph neural network) and NeuralGCM (hybrid differentiable dynamical core with neural network physics) versus the MPAS-A numerical model.
29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.data: Perturbation response experiments with GraphCast, NeuralGCM and MPAS-A; specific initial conditions not detailed in the abstract.
29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.result: ML models show unphysical adjoint sensitivities, persistent localized responses and excessive noise, unlike physically consistent MPAS-A patterns.
29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.open_work: Improve linearization properties of ML weather models before operational DA use.
29b7b1b4408e724c2813295db4084f01b08b523a.issues: Only two ML models tested; implications for DA systems are inferred rather than demonstrated in cycled assimilation.

138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.goal: Multivariate post-processing of ensemble forecasts to correct biases while restoring realistic spatial and inter-variable dependencies, which univariate calibration methods typically destroy.
138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.architecture: Dual graph neural network (dualGNN) trained with a composite loss combining the energy score and the variogram score, producing multivariate calibrated ensembles; compared with ensemble copula coupling and Schaake shuffle.
138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.data: WRF-based solar irradiance ensemble forecasts over northern Chile and ECMWF ensemble visibility forecasts over central Europe.
138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.result: The dualGNN consistently outperforms empirical copula-based methods and networks trained only on CRPS or energy score in multivariate verification metrics; adding the variogram score also improves univariate skill.
138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.open_work: Extending the approach to higher-dimensional settings, more variables and longer lead-time dependencies, and testing on other ensemble systems.
138ba4c6c7af5bfb6d76f8b52be83c361ed0ccc6.issues: Evaluated on two variables and two regional datasets only; verification relies on proper multivariate scores whose discrimination ability is known to be limited. Quantitative gains are not reported in the abstract.

1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.goal: Assess whether probabilistic AI weather forecasts are truly calibrated, especially for extremes, and provide post-processing with guaranteed statistical coverage.
1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.architecture: Online conformal prediction, a distribution-free statistical post-processing method, applied to ensemble outputs of diffusion-based GenCast, hybrid NeuralGCM and AIFS-ENS.
1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.data: Temperature and precipitation forecasts, including extremes, from GenCast, NeuralGCM and AIFS-ENS; verification data not specified in the abstract (likely ERA5).
1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.result: The AI ensembles show coverage shortfalls, particularly for extreme events; online conformal prediction restores calibrated coverage without degrading other probabilistic metrics.
1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.open_work: Applying conformal methods to multivariate and spatially coherent forecasts, more variables and operational settings.
1f9e182237c776417e4169ef725c83dd4d6bd270.issues: Conformal guarantees are marginal (on average over time), not conditional on each event; coverage intervals do not restore physically consistent ensemble members. Lead times and quantitative gains are not reported in the abstract.

b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.goal: Provide interactive tropospheric and stratospheric ozone in climate models that lack costly chemistry schemes, for climate sensitivity simulations where ozone feedbacks matter.
b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.architecture: Machine-learning ozone parameterization (mloz) that predicts daily ozone from atmospheric temperature profiles only, coupled online in climate models; network family not specified in the abstract.
b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.data: Trained on UKESM simulations with interactive chemistry; transferred online to the ICON model without chemistry.
b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.result: Stable decadal online simulations with high fidelity, including two-way ozone–QBO interactions; about 31 times faster than UKESM chemistry and under 4% of total model runtime.
b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.open_work: Adoption in CMIP-class models without interactive chemistry and evaluation under a wider range of forcing scenarios.
b2649b355bad8a37b34761b391b4bbd0046154f1.issues: Temperature-only input omits explicit dependence on ozone-depleting substances and emissions, so applicability is targeted at climate sensitivity experiments; inherits biases of the UKESM chemistry it learned from.

1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.goal: Model background-error covariances for variational data assimilation that respect physical balances in both midlatitudes and tropics, where standard balance operators are poorly suited.
1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.architecture: Neural-network autoencoder whose reduced latent space is used to estimate background-error covariances and perform variational data assimilation in latent space.
1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.data: Autoencoder trained on 40 years of ERA5 reanalysis; single-observation experiments (500 hPa geopotential, total column water vapour) and tests with synthetic and operational ensembles of data assimilations.
1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.result: Latent-space DA produces localized, flow-dependent increments consistent with geostrophic and thermal-wind balance in midlatitudes and heating-induced responses in the tropics; forecasts from these analyses evolve realistically, including a Kelvin wave.
1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.open_work: Developing ensemble-based latent-space 4D-Var and full cycling experiments with real observations.
1988d655d0597f2eef7f5b64a3f8782f9105a98a.issues: Autoencoder compression causes significant variance loss in some variables; demonstrations rely mainly on single-observation and idealized experiments.

d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.goal: Understand the effective resolution of deterministic AI weather models and how their smoothing affects comparisons with physics-based models.
d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.architecture: Theoretical analysis and evaluation of deterministic AI models (Aurora, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast) and diffusion-based GenCast against ECMWF physics-based forecasts; not a new ML model.
d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.data: Forecast output from Aurora, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, GenCast and ECMWF ensemble and deterministic forecasts.
d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.result: An ideal, perfectly trained deterministic AI model approximately follows the forecast-distribution mean over the lead times in its loss, reducing effective resolution and favouring it on mean-square error; a simple method for fairer comparison is proposed.
d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.open_work: Adoption of resolution-aware verification and training objectives that preserve small-scale variability.
d80aa4d6ef7afe61c3a385aa2602d96b7b791d23.issues: Analysis centres on deterministic MSE-trained models; quantitative effective-resolution values are not reported in the abstract.

c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.goal: Forecast multiple interacting atmospheric pollutants regionally, accounting for emissions and meteorology, faster than numerical chemical transport models.
c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.architecture: Deep learning framework (Zeeman) for multi-species atmospheric chemistry forecasting; network family not specified in the abstract.
c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.data: Not reported in the abstract; presumably trained against a regional chemical transport model with emission and meteorological inputs (PM2.5, ozone and other species).
c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.result: Rivals the numerical model in forecast skill while running 68.5 times faster.
c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.open_work: Integration with data assimilation for emission estimation and concentration forecasting.
c88d0718a39d9d2df29eb0297aa1e5fc1f5a7137.issues: Abstract gives few details on region, species, training data or evaluation; skill may be bounded by the numerical model it emulates.

2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.goal: Establish a systematic intercomparison of AI, hybrid and physics-based weather prediction models to assess physical consistency and skill across all forecast fields and conditions.
2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.architecture: Model intercomparison project (WP-MIP) supported by the WMO: a centralized database of physically based, machine-learning and hybrid global deterministic forecasts; not a new ML model.
2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.data: Global deterministic forecasts contributed by institutions on six continents, using center-specific and common initializations.
2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.result: Describes the project design; aims to develop AI-ready verification techniques and best-practice guidance for model developers and national weather centres.
2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.open_work: Extending to ensemble and other forecast types and publishing results of the distributed evaluation.
2a0a3bf17a9071d426c6faf01f5fe0ce6630fa66.issues: Project overview without results yet; first phase limited to deterministic global forecasts.

4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.goal: Solve the online instability of machine-learning physics parameterizations when coupled to a general circulation model for long simulations.
4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.architecture: Deep neural network physics package trained with experience replay and multistep training, reusing the model's own recent erroneous tendency predictions so it learns from its own errors.
4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.data: Training data from Multi-scale Modeling Framework (superparameterized) high-resolution simulations; coupled online in CAM5.
4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.result: Three 6-year online CAM5 simulations remain stable and show better precipitation, surface temperature and zonal-mean fields than standard CAM5 and a benchmark model, without extra constraints or tuning.
4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.open_work: Longer multi-decadal runs, climate-change tests and application to other GCMs and ML architectures.
4cbaa37626d5dd860a87c925235f8ed967553b1e.issues: Online runs are only 6 years long; generalization to warmer climates is untested; skill bounded by the MMF training simulations.

065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.goal: Test whether AI weather prediction models reproduce the butterfly effect, the fast upscale growth of tiny initial perturbations that sets the intrinsic predictability limit.
065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.architecture: Perturbation-growth experiments with several AI weather prediction models compared with a physics-based model at various resolutions; not a new ML model.
065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.data: Forecasts from several state-of-the-art AI models trained on analysis data (e.g. ERA5) and a conventional NWP model; specific models not named in the abstract.
065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.result: One group of AI models reproduces none of six butterfly-effect characteristics; another reproduces some, but via numerical noise, physically inconsistent and in some cases dependent on CPU versus GPU execution.
065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.open_work: Training on higher-resolution or differently designed data that resolves small-scale error growth.
065c6f9de24811b04da911b0e46e29031057210d.issues: Attributes the failure to training data limitations rather than architecture; model list and quantitative growth rates are not given in the abstract.

b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.goal: Improve tropical cyclone intensity and precipitation forecasts, which AI weather models underestimate because of reanalysis biases, while keeping their track skill.
b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.architecture: Diffusion model (FuXi-TC) conditioned on large-scale FuXi forecasts to generatively downscale fine-grained wind and precipitation fields, learning intensity from NWP simulations.
b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.data: FuXi global forecasts as conditioning; NWP simulations as high-resolution targets; evaluation on 2024 Western North Pacific TCs and zero-shot on North Atlantic hurricanes.
b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.result: Matches ECMWF deterministic TC intensity skill with better precipitation forecasts at much lower cost, generalizes zero-shot to the North Atlantic, and yields well-dispersed ensembles with FuXi ensemble input.
b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.open_work: Longer evaluation periods, other basins and coupling with ensemble systems operationally.
b3250e6b7f532dcf463c00202b6bd234c74f97ac.issues: Evaluation covers a single season; intensity skill is bounded by the NWP simulations used as targets; numbers not given in the abstract.

465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.goal: Evaluate whether a weather foundation model can be cheaply extended to physical variables unseen in pretraining, here hydrological variables.
465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.architecture: Lightweight shallow decoders trained on latent representations of the pretrained Aurora transformer foundation model, compared with full fine-tuning and a U-Net baseline.
465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.data: Aurora pretrained model with new hydrological target variables, likely from ERA5 (not detailed in the abstract).
465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.result: Decoders need 43% less training time and 53% less memory than full fine-tuning, keep autoregressive stability and beat U-Net, climatology and persistence on variables correlated with pretraining variables.
465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.open_work: Using extensibility to new variables as a quality metric for Earth-science foundation models and testing other models and domains.
465d062f9b2e71e87ff6f3ccd10fecf7c38b09a1.issues: Decoder accuracy degrades for variables weakly related to pretraining variables; exact dataset and resolution not given in the abstract.

5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.goal: Provide standardised training and evaluation protocols for ML regional climate downscaling across multiple domains, enabling intercomparison and operational readiness under CMIP7.
5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.architecture: Benchmark (CORDEX-ML-Bench) with perfect-model design evaluating 40 ML configurations: traditional ML, convolutional U-Nets, vision transformers, graph neural networks, diffusion, flow matching and generative adversarial networks.
5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.data: CORDEX-aligned regional climate model simulations driven by GCMs, downscaling daily maximum temperature and precipitation to about 10 km (20x) over the European Alps, New Zealand and Southern Africa; historical and future periods.
5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.result: Generative models outperform deterministic ones for precipitation, especially fine-scale variability and extremes; for temperature deterministic models remain competitive. Historically trained models underestimate future climate-change signals.
5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.open_work: Further benchmark phases with more regions, variables and rigorous extrapolation testing to support operational use.
5ca1bb693e6cf157f00128a3e0e68d71e25d7390.issues: Perfect-model framework does not test transfer to real observations; only two variables and three pilot regions.

96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.goal: Produce accurate global tropical cyclone intensity forecasts from neural weather models, whose 0.25° outputs smooth out TC extremes.
96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.architecture: Hierarchy of post-processing models, from linear regression and MLP to convolutional networks with spatial masking, applied to neural weather model outputs; tracking-independent.
96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.data: Pangu-Weather and FourCastNet v2 forecasts as inputs; observational best estimates of maximum wind and minimum sea-level pressure (best-track data) as targets.
96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.result: Accurate and reliable TC intensity forecasts up to five days ahead; even linear models extract information beyond initial conditions, and convolutional models show no clear advantage over MLPs.
96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.open_work: Extending to longer lead times, other neural weather models and operational deployment.
96b1494a857612043e942d737e7d23d37391aabc.issues: Quantitative skill versus operational NWP is not stated in the abstract; inherits track and structure errors from the underlying neural weather models.

186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.goal: Extend ECMWF's data-driven AIFS to jointly forecast the atmosphere and surface ocean, including waves and sea ice, to improve medium-range forecasts and enable marine applications.
186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.architecture: Extension of the AIFS (graph neural network encoder-decoder with transformer processor) that models atmosphere and surface ocean in a single component-agnostic network, with loss scaling and handling of missing values over land.
186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.data: Tailored atmospheric and marine datasets, likely ERA5 and ECMWF ocean/wave analyses (details not in the abstract).
186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.result: For nearly all marine variables, about one day gain in forecast skill at medium range compared with physics-based models; captures swell and TC cold wakes and responds physically to idealized out-of-distribution initial conditions.
186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.open_work: Developing data-driven coupled Earth system models with greater flexibility and physical fidelity.
186a432a1e59bb9368b0db3a20769e58cb628420.issues: Limited to the surface ocean; impact on atmospheric skill and exact datasets are not quantified in the abstract.

a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.goal: Resolve whether convectively coupled Kelvin waves modulate tropical cyclogenesis, which observations alone cannot settle due to limited sample size.
a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.architecture: Uses the deep-learning climate emulator ACE2 (Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2) to generate large ensembles for process analysis.
a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.data: Ten ACE2 simulations over 2001–2010 (100 years total), with ACE2 trained on reanalysis (ERA5).
a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.result: Robust Kelvin-wave modulation of tropical cyclogenesis in all basins; genesis preferentially occurs about one day after peak Kelvin-wave precipitation in the Indian Ocean and Western Pacific, via enhanced column humidity and vorticity.
a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.open_work: Applying emulator large ensembles to other weather and climate variability relationships.
a1a4021a8e36712fda4f140343bbd367a37a5e81.issues: Conclusions depend on the emulator realistically representing Kelvin waves and TC-like vortices at coarse resolution; inherits reanalysis biases.

1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.goal: Assess how deterministic AI weather models respond to initial-condition perturbations and how well the resulting ensembles forecast extreme events.
1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.architecture: Ensembles from deterministic AI models FuXi, GraphCast and SFNO (spherical Fourier neural operator) generated with Gaussian, Perlin noise, Hemispheric Centered Bred Vectors and Huge Ensembles perturbations.
1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.data: 50-member ensembles for the August 2022 Pakistan floods and China heatwave plus a global threshold-based evaluation, verified against ERA5 and compared with IFS ENS and AIFS ENS.
1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.result: Simple Gaussian and Perlin perturbations give spread and skill similar to flow-based methods; the gap to NWP ensembles and native probabilistic models narrows but remains. Model choice dominates; temperature extremes are captured better than precipitation.
1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.open_work: Improving perturbation strategies and comparing with natively probabilistic AI models for early-warning systems.
1c7e548bc5bb3187db8e8602c3d12d7f7e28d284.issues: Case studies limited to two events; verification against ERA5 which underrepresents extremes.

6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.goal: Provide reliable short-term sea ice concentration forecasts for maritime operations in the European Arctic via an operational data-driven system.
6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.architecture: Operational deep learning sea ice prediction system (MET-AICE); network family not specified in the abstract (likely a U-Net-style convolutional network).
6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.data: Trained to predict AMSR2 sea ice concentration observations at 5 km resolution; compared with TOPAZ5, Barents-2.5 km and ECMWF IFS forecasts.
6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.result: After one year of operation, 10-day forecasts have errors about 30% lower than AMSR2 persistence on average and outperform the dynamical models.
6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.open_work: Extending to other regions, variables (e.g. ice drift, thickness) and probabilistic forecasts.
6fa225bf578b05a4621f736da95772068a9f6804.issues: Targets are satellite retrievals with their own errors; evaluation covers one operational year.

527c93805ef5d697e3d946c338e94931b3f5ebf8.goal: As the title implies, addresses how AI weather prediction models should be verified in an operational context.
527c93805ef5d697e3d946c338e94931b3f5ebf8.architecture: Likely a review or perspective on verification practices for AI weather prediction; no abstract available.
527c93805ef5d697e3d946c338e94931b3f5ebf8.open_work: Presumably developing verification methods suited to AI forecasts, such as physical consistency and extremes.
527c93805ef5d697e3d946c338e94931b3f5ebf8.issues: No abstract available; content inferred from the title only.

fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.goal: Test whether weather-forecasting ML models can be adapted into stable forced atmospheric models for multi-decadal climate simulation.
fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.architecture: Deterministic ArchesWeather (transformer-based) and probabilistic flow-matching ArchesWeatherGen, extended with conditioning on monthly SST and sea ice cover as boundary conditions.
fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.data: ERA5 training and reference; AIMIP Phase 1 protocol (AMIP-like) with prescribed SST and sea ice; comparison with numerical climate models.
fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.result: Forced configurations produce stable long-term simulations with a stable annual cycle, capture drifts of many variables, and reproduce ERA5 climatology, large-scale circulation, interannual variability and distribution tails.
fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.open_work: Coupling to ocean models and testing out-of-distribution warming scenarios.
fa9c68342d6daf64cbb1dfe925ebb599cd61921c.issues: Atmosphere-only with prescribed boundary conditions; skill under unseen future climates is not established; quantitative errors not given in the abstract.

d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.goal: Predict Atlantic and Benguela Niño events, which dynamical forecasting systems predict poorly, and test tropical Atlantic predictability.
d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.architecture: Simple convolutional neural network (CNN) forecasting the event indices from ocean-state precursors.
d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.data: Not specified in the abstract; likely ocean reanalysis or model output of sea surface and subsurface fields.
d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.result: Atlantic/Benguela Niños predicted 3–4 months ahead and peak-season events up to 5 months; the model exploits known precursors such as long-wave ocean dynamics.
d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.open_work: Extending lead times, probabilistic forecasts and use for process understanding of tropical Atlantic variability.
d613e17b19ffef5fea174ec47e3d733b1d7523a9.issues: Few events in the observational record limit robust skill assessment; training data details not given in the abstract.

3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.goal: Overcome the coarse resolution of AI weather models and their reliance on analysis data by directly ingesting raw observations for higher-resolution probabilistic forecasting.
3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.architecture: WeatherNext 3, a probabilistic AI weather model that ingests geostationary satellite data and predicts satellite precipitation, tropical cyclone and station observations; specific network family not given in the abstract.
3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.data: Low-latency geostationary satellite observations, analysis data, satellite-derived precipitation estimates, tropical cyclone observations and surface station data; evaluated including unseen stations.
3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.result: New state of the art in probabilistic medium-range skill, with hourly forecasts at 0.1° for single-level variables and lower 2 m temperature and dewpoint errors at stations than competing global models.
3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.open_work: Further merging data assimilation, forecasting and post-processing into a single learned system.
3e2c2e8c73892acba83d2df0b14573c0dcde7691.issues: Still partly dependent on analysis data; quantitative scores not given in the abstract; arXiv preprint.

39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.goal: Benchmark AI weather models for atmospheric river forecasting globally and regionally to guide their use and development.
39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.architecture: Benchmark evaluation of five AI weather models including FuXi and hybrid NeuralGCM; not a new ML model.
39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.data: Forecasts from five AI models verified against reanalysis (likely ERA5); case studies on North and South American coasts.
39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.result: FuXi performs best globally at 10-day lead for meteorological fields and AR metrics; NeuralGCM better predicts AR intensity and shape regionally. Landfall location beyond one week remains difficult.
39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.open_work: Refining AI models for region-specific AR forecasts and landfall prediction.
39f3784346dfe02158997b62f0973c6d4ebcc74d.issues: Limited to deterministic forecasts and a few case studies; the other three models are not named in the abstract.

dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.goal: Rapidly simulate daily PM2.5 and its chemical composition in response to emission reductions, replacing costly chemical transport model runs for policy evaluation.
dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.architecture: CleanAir, a residual symmetric three-dimensional U-Net emulating a chemical transport model.
dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.data: 2416 emission scenarios simulated by the CMAQ model over China at 36 km resolution.
dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.result: Agrees well with CMAQ for PM2.5 and emission-induced changes, generalizes to unseen meteorology and emissions, and simulates a year in 10 s on GPU, three to four orders of magnitude faster than CTMs.
dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.open_work: Extending to other regions, pollutants and higher resolution for emission-control and mitigation planning.
dc1ccb8fc2499adb2bd7bccac560d7a03da9820d.issues: Emulates CMAQ and inherits its biases; 36 km resolution limits urban-scale applications.

119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.goal: Assess statistically whether huge ML emulator ensembles can estimate very extreme precipitation and temperature quantiles, e.g. for Probable Maximum Precipitation.
119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.architecture: Extreme value statistical analysis (threshold-exceedance methods) applied to a huge ensemble from the ACE2 ML climate emulator; not a new ML model.
119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.data: 10,560-year ACE2 ensemble trained on ERA5, over the contiguous United States.
119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.result: Very extreme quantiles can be estimated practically with threshold-exceedance methods at high thresholds; results are robust across seasons and storm types, and statistical uncertainty is well constrained. The emulator produces extremes beyond the ERA5 range.
119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.open_work: Determining whether emulators are physically fit for quantifying extreme climatology, and applying the methods to improved emulators.
119cf58607b771f47c2b497ffa4829ad410a911a.issues: Emulator fidelity for extremes is not established; coarse ACE2 resolution limits local precipitation extremes.

344d6842b75472657961c5c00916345ba2d384ff.goal: Define a roadmap for integrating emerging deep learning weather prediction tools into NOAA's research-to-operations pipeline.
344d6842b75472657961c5c00916345ba2d384ff.architecture: Meeting report (AI4NWP workshop) on priorities for integrating data-driven models into NOAA production; not an ML model.
344d6842b75472657961c5c00916345ba2d384ff.result: Identifies a research and development roadmap and priorities; specifics not given in the abstract.
344d6842b75472657961c5c00916345ba2d384ff.open_work: Implementing the roadmap in NOAA operational systems.
344d6842b75472657961c5c00916345ba2d384ff.issues: Meeting summary with little technical detail in the abstract.

561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.goal: Evaluate whether a regional stretched-grid deep learning weather model produces physically consistent forecasts during an extreme event.
561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.architecture: Analysis of Bris, Met Norway's stretched-grid deep learning weather prediction model (graph neural network-based), versus the MEPS control run; diagnostic study of atmospheric balances.
561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.data: Forecasts of severe extratropical cyclone Poly (Netherlands, 5 July 2023) from deterministic Bris and the MetCoOp Ensemble Prediction System control.
561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.result: Despite good RMSE, Bris misses important mesoscale features and significantly disrupts atmospheric balances, mainly due to fine-scale noise causing unrealistic gradients.
561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.open_work: Improving AI models for extreme events and enforcing physical consistency.
561637ac42601c915c58ced6f5a4b5330714e141.issues: Single case study; conclusions may not generalize to other events or model versions.

8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.goal: Evaluate extratropical teleconnection responses to ENSO in a coupled deep learning climate emulator that has weak intrinsic ENSO variability.
8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.architecture: Pacific pacemaker experiments with the coupled atmosphere-ocean deep learning emulator DLESyM.
8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.data: Observed tropical Pacific SST forcing imposed in DLESyM; emulator trained on reanalysis (likely ERA5); comparison to observations.
8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.result: Internal atmospheric variability is realistic, but the forced ENSO teleconnection is significantly amplified, causing overestimated blocking frequency and duration and underestimated peak intensity.
8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.open_work: Process-based evaluation of coupled DL climate models analogous to traditional numerical models.
8b49c089c1be37c67cce0fa08e50d685c2668611.issues: Single emulator evaluated; amplified response may reflect training data limitations.

a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.goal: Generate severe weather guidance at 1–8 day leads, mimicking SPC convective outlooks, from AI weather prediction model environments.
a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.architecture: Random forest models using environments from PanguWeather, FourCastNet v2-small and GraphCast, including median-combined inputs and RF ensembles.
a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.data: Severe weather reports as targets; AIWP model forecasts as inputs; evaluation over 2024 against GEFS Machine Learning Probabilities guidance.
a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.result: Skillful individual hazard forecasts out to day 7, though operational GEFS ML guidance is often better at some leads; median-combined inputs and ensembles improve skill, with Pangu-based RF competitive.
a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.open_work: Exploiting ensembles of AIWP-based guidance and longer evaluation periods.
a68b9117c0aae1af8884585a844dd7303c88fd89.issues: Evaluated on one year; AIWP smoothing of convective environments may limit skill.

87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.goal: Test whether an existing NWP statistical post-processing system can correct biases and produce probabilistic forecasts from AI weather models.
87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.architecture: Bureau of Meteorology's IMPROVER statistical post-processing and blending system applied unmodified to deterministic AIFS; non-ML post-processing.
87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.data: ECMWF AIFS deterministic forecasts compared with post-processed ECMWF HRES and ENS; verification region and period not detailed in the abstract (Bureau of Meteorology domain).
87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.result: Post-processing yields accuracy improvements for AIFS comparable to NWP; blending AIFS with NWP improves overall skill even when AIFS alone is not best.
87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.open_work: Incremental incorporation of AI forecasts into operational workflows and testing additional AI models.
87f747dc7d9ffd190224bc759a5e13d9627d9242.issues: Single AI model and region; quantitative scores not given in the abstract.

a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.goal: Tests whether a hybrid physics–machine learning atmosphere-ocean model can deliver useful weather and climate-variability prediction beyond the medium range, extending earlier hybrid SPEEDY work.
a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.architecture: Hybrid model coupling the low-resolution SPEEDY atmospheric general circulation model with reservoir computing (a recurrent neural network variant), plus purely ML prognostic variables for 6 h precipitation, SST and upper-300 m ocean heat content.
a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.data: Trained on reanalysis (ERA5) and ocean data; evaluated on hindcasts of ENSO, equatorial waves, MJO and tropical precipitation.
a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.result: Predicts the El Niño cycle and its precipitation teleconnections for 3–7 months depending on season; equatorial precipitation skill reaches 15 days in the East Pacific and 11.5 days in the West Pacific, comparable to high-resolution operational models.
a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.open_work: Increasing resolution, adding further ML-based Earth system components and extending toward seasonal-to-subseasonal operational use are natural next steps.
a67f7067a699f37758ad9d83afce93f40ea95144.issues: Low spatial resolution and simplified physics of SPEEDY; ocean is represented only by ML-predicted SST and heat content rather than full ocean dynamics; comparison with operational models relies on published scores.

05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.goal: Proposes unifying short- and medium-range forecasting at NOAA in a single AI system instead of independent prediction systems for different products.
05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.architecture: Nested-EAGLE: a deterministic data-driven global weather model at 0.25° with a nested 6 km limited-area refinement over CONUS; network family is not specified in the abstract.
05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.data: Global training data at 0.25° (reanalysis/analysis) combined with high-resolution regional analysis data over CONUS; compared against NOAA GFS and HRRR forecasts.
05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.result: Achieves significantly lower mean-squared error than GFS and HRRR for near-surface and low-level fields over CONUS while staying competitive globally; gains stem from nesting in regional analyses; best storm-location forecasts at longer leads.
05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.open_work: Authors plan to extend the skill gains beyond CONUS and improve precipitation representation, for instance through probabilistic or ensemble training.
05ed6eba1837692b8dd42951e0f1ee5c59b02d15.issues: Deterministic training blurs extremes and makes precipitation amounts less skillful than HRRR; gains are confined to the high-resolution CONUS region; arXiv preprint not yet peer reviewed.

2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.goal: Develops hybrid physics–data-driven sea-ice column models in which machine learning corrects state-dependent forecast errors, and examines how to handle physical model updates via transfer learning.
2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.architecture: Neural networks (NNs) trained as state-dependent parametrizations of forecast error added to a sea-ice column thermodynamics model; transfer learning between model configurations and feature-importance analysis.
2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.data: Model-generated forecast errors from sea-ice column physics configurations with perturbed snow thermodynamics and radiative properties; specific products not reported in the abstract.
2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.result: NN hybrids are stable, robust to initial condition and forcing errors and consistently outperform a climatological error-correction benchmark at long leads; ice-layer enthalpies matter most, atmospheric forcing inputs have negligible influence.
2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.open_work: Extending to full three-dimensional sea-ice models and real observations, and refining guidelines for when pretrained networks should be transferred after model updates.
2392a7f01328a5338573bf2a04e74972a787976f.issues: Single-column, largely idealized setting with synthetic truth; generalization to coupled sea-ice-ocean models and observed errors is untested.

19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.goal: Learns gravity wave flux parameterizations that include nonlocal (horizontal) effects missing from current climate-model gravity wave schemes, to reduce middle-atmosphere circulation biases.
19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.architecture: Three neural networks with increasing horizontal nonlocality: a 1×1 MLP (ANN), a 3×3 ANN-CNN and an Attention U-Net; transfer learning to high-resolution model output.
19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.data: Multiple years of high-resolution ERA5 reanalysis for training; transfer learning on gravity wave fluxes from a 1.4 km global climate model simulation.
19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.result: All networks recreate the global flux distribution in troposphere and stratosphere; the Attention U-Net best predicts transient flux evolution over orographic and nonorographic hotspots; transfer learning preserves ERA5 learning while rescaling fluxes.
19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.open_work: Coupling the parameterizations online in a climate model and testing their effect on circulation biases are the logical next steps.
19ed82744b6781c3b4baf9d8e541d2f8ba1f2c54.issues: Offline-only evaluation; ERA5 resolves only part of gravity wave fluxes, and the high-resolution data used for transfer learning are limited in length.

bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.goal: Improves subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) probabilistic forecasts of global 2 m temperature and precipitation beyond two weeks, where NWP skill is poor.
bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.architecture: ResUnet (residual U-Net convolutional neural network) post-processing deterministic predictors into tercile probability forecasts.
bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.data: ECMWF weekly S2S reforecasts: five upper-air variables at 250, 500 and 850 hPa plus six surface variables; forecasts for weeks 1–6 and biweekly weeks 3–4 and 5–6.
bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.result: ResUnet tercile forecasts outperform ECMWF S2S probabilistic forecasts up to six weeks; MSL, Z850, T850 and T2M dominate early T2M leads, while SST, Z200 and T200 dominate weeks 4–6.
bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.open_work: Incorporating more ocean and teleconnection predictors and testing in real-time operational settings.
bffe9e2e984b587555ad1278133c18fc94c8c7f0.issues: Uses only deterministic ECMWF inputs, so ensemble information is not exploited; skill scores are not quantified in the abstract; tercile categories give limited information on extremes.

57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.goal: Addresses the systematic underestimation of typhoon intensity by AI weather models trained on coarse ERA5 by downscaling their forecasts to kilometre scale.
57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.architecture: Intelligent Shanghai Typhoon Model (ISTM): regression–residual emulator in which a deterministic network predicts the conditional mean and a conditional diffusion model stochastically generates residuals; compared with U-Net baselines.
57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.data: Bespoke 9 km typhoon reanalysis (HiRes) built by dynamically downscaling ERA5 with the Shanghai Typhoon Model (SHTM); fine-tuned to downscale ECMWF AIFS forecasts.
57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.result: ISTM improves wind and precipitation intensity and organization over ERA5 and deterministic U-Net; downscaling AIFS keeps track errors comparable while reducing 72 h mean intensity error by about 39.5% relative to AIFS.
57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.open_work: Extending to longer lead times, other basins and ensemble downscaling of AI forecasts.
57bba39360a329ec1dae434c060ed67e3c619c40.issues: Inherits the biases of the SHTM-based HiRes reanalysis used as truth; track errors are bounded by the driving AIFS forecasts; regional focus on typhoons affecting Shanghai's domain.

b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.goal: Counters the sharp drop of forecast skill at subseasonal (2–6 week) leads caused by compounding errors and systematic model biases.
b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.architecture: Probabilistic bias correction: a machine learning framework that learns to correct historical probabilistic forecasts of dynamical and AI models; specific network family not stated in the abstract.
b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.data: Historical probabilistic forecasts from ECMWF's dynamical ensemble and AI Forecasting System (AIFS); evaluated on pressure, temperature and precipitation targets and in ECMWF's 2025 real-time subseasonal forecasting competition.
b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.result: Doubles AIFS subseasonal skill and improves the operationally debiased dynamical model for 91% of pressure, 92% of temperature and 98% of precipitation targets; best global forecasts for all variables and leads in the 2025 ECMWF competition.
b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.open_work: Applying the framework to other centres' models and translating gains into extreme-event and sector-specific decision support.
b6bdc798bfbad91bc98a1a7b11bfcf5a85e9b923.issues: Skill remains modest in absolute terms at subseasonal leads; correction depends on long, consistent hindcast archives; methodological details are not given in the abstract.

c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.goal: Investigates how ENSO predictability changes under historical anthropogenic forcing, relevant for future climate projections.
c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) forecast model with a leave-one-model-out strategy, used as a predictability diagnostic.
c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.data: CMIP6 historical and preindustrial control simulations.
c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.result: ENSO predictability is enhanced by 14.0 ± 1.8% under historical forcing, linked to a shoaling equatorial Pacific thermocline that strengthens advective and thermocline feedbacks.
c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.open_work: Extending the analysis to future scenarios and observations, and checking robustness to model choice.
c9f4b0f9a61c9d97004eae6d58fae8e61ec36ef0.issues: Relies on CMIP6 models with known ENSO biases; CNN-derived predictability may reflect model-specific dynamics rather than the real climate system.

47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.goal: Evaluates for the first time how well machine learning weather prediction models forecast Northern Hemisphere winter atmospheric blocking, a driver of weather extremes.
47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.architecture: Benchmark evaluation of four ML weather models (Pangu-Weather transformer, FuXi transformer, GraphCast graph neural network, NeuralGCM hybrid physics–ML) against ECMWF HRES.
47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.data: Winter forecasts 2018–2022 over the Northern Hemisphere, verified against ERA5 reanalysis.
47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.result: FuXi has lowest Z500 RMSE but underestimates blocking frequency, especially in the Pacific; NeuralGCM has the best blocking skill (73.68% at day 5, 39.59% at day 9); HRES remains competitive in the Pacific; skill degrades rapidly beyond day 5.
47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.open_work: Incorporating key boundary conditions and improving interpretability of ML models for blocking prediction.
47f20ebb43658ab6d2d9cb07012953c76cbff21c.issues: Deterministic forecasts only; limited five-winter sample; verification against ERA5 which some ML models were trained on.

cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.goal: Provides a standardised benchmarking framework to evaluate AI-based precipitation downscaling against regional climate models, which was previously lacking.
cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.architecture: Benchmark evaluation of three ML downscaling models (generative diffusion model, vision transformer, recurrent neural network) against 24 regional climate model (RCM) simulations using minimum-standard metrics.
cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.data: Observational precipitation data over Australia and 24 RCM simulations; specific observational products and periods not reported in the abstract. The study releases a benchmark dataset of ML and RCM outputs.
cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.result: All three ML models and ten RCMs meet minimum benchmarks for total precipitation, spatial distribution, seasonal cycle and trends; ML models perform comparably to RCMs at much lower computational cost.
cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.open_work: Using ML downscaling to enlarge projection ensembles and improve uncertainty quantification; applying the framework to new AI downscaling methods.
cd4383a825943a79487c51b30b8146db6f551cda.issues: Minimum-standard metrics focus on mean rainfall characteristics and may not capture extremes or physical consistency; Australia-only evaluation.

fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.goal: Assesses how machine learning weather prediction models represent atmospheric rivers, filamentary high-impact features that may be smoothed by ML loss functions.
fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.architecture: Evaluation study comparing GraphCast (graph neural network) and Pangu-Weather (transformer) with operational NWP models GFS and IFS, using grid-point, object-based and storm-relative composite verification.
fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.data: Wintertime North Pacific atmospheric river forecasts at 1–10 day leads, verified against reanalysis.
fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.result: ML models represent ARs well by aggregate metrics but ARs are slightly too weak and too small relative to reanalysis and NWP, with systematic differences in dynamic and thermodynamic biases within strong ARs.
fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.open_work: Using phenomenon-specific diagnostics to guide forecaster interpretation and improvements to both MLWP and NWP models.
fd2e30ea8701570e66e2ec2cd2752f3ab8b03516.issues: Only two deterministic ML models and one region and season; reanalysis used for verification may be close to ML training targets.

bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.goal: Builds a fast AI-based data assimilation framework to produce kilometre-scale near-surface analyses from real multi-source observations at low computational cost.
bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.architecture: ADAF: a deep learning data assimilation framework that maps a background field plus sparse observations to an analysis; network family not specified in the abstract.
bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.data: Real-world sparse surface weather observations and satellite imagery over CONUS for four near-surface variables; compared with HRRRDAS-initialized forecasts.
bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.result: Analyses align closely with observations, reconstruct extremes such as tropical cyclone wind fields, remain good with poor backgrounds and very sparse observations, run in about 2 s on an AMD MI200 GPU, and improve 0–6 h AI forecasts over HRRRDAS initialization.
bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.open_work: Extending to more variables, upper-air fields and operational cycling with forecast models.
bdaeb21f95190479f08262292ef63372207e13a9.issues: Limited to four near-surface variables over CONUS; verification partly against the same observation types assimilated; no explicit uncertainty estimate.

db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.goal: Emulates ensembles of NASA's GEOS Composition Forecast to extend air-quality forecasts beyond five days and provide probabilistic estimates at low cost.
db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.architecture: Air quality conditional generative adversarial network (AQcGAN) emulating ensemble mean and spread; FourCastNet-type models are shown to be inadequate and unstable for composition.
db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.data: GEOS-CF composition forecasts and ensembles for carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, nitrogen dioxide and ozone.
db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.result: AQcGAN forecasts ten days ahead, generating ensemble mean and spread in seconds with competitive low RMSE against true ensemble statistics; used as the ensemble in an operational data assimilation study.
db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.open_work: Authors plan integration with data assimilation methods and the operational GEOS-CF system.
db9c7290364004da0996cd184e5eff71fa6f8edd.issues: Trained and verified against GEOS-CF model output rather than observations; GAN training can be unstable; limited set of species.

2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.goal: Argues for comprehensive, standardized and independent evaluation of ML-based Earth system models to build trust, especially for unobserved future or paleoclimate states.
2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.architecture: Review and perspective putting forward five recommendations for evaluating ML-based Earth system models; no new model.
2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.data: Not applicable; draws on the literature on ML weather and climate models and physics-based model evaluation.
2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.result: Proposes five recommendations to build evidence of physical consistency and credibility of ML-based ESMs to promote their wider use.
2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.open_work: Community implementation of standardized evaluation protocols, benchmarks and independent evaluation infrastructure.
2bd8eca522ebcb1a9c456effce7c45a012ba6a66.issues: Recommendations are qualitative; adoption depends on community coordination and funding; does not itself test any model.

51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.goal: Investigates whether tropical basin interactions among the Indian, Atlantic and Pacific Oceans can reduce the ENSO spring predictability barrier in a deep learning model.
51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.architecture: GL-Geoformer: a transformer-based deep learning model for global tropical ocean-atmosphere prediction of wind and three-dimensional temperature anomalies, with pacemaker experiments.
51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.data: Tropical ocean-atmosphere wind and 3D temperature anomaly fields; specific training and evaluation products not reported in the abstract.
51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.result: Including tropical basin interactions substantially reduces the spring predictability barrier, giving skillful ENSO predictions up to 16 months ahead from spring initializations; quantifies IOD and Atlantic Niño contributions via subsurface heat transport and Walker circulation.
51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.open_work: Extending to other modes of variability and using the framework to further diagnose interbasin mechanisms.
51c8e52dded141624b9b7b7e7d9c7de75d55f4a1.issues: Attribution via pacemaker experiments within a data-driven model may not reflect true causality; training data source and length not stated in the abstract.

e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.goal: Improves radar nowcasting by exploiting 3D radar volumes and remaining robust when observations are occluded or missing.
e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.architecture: EchoCast-3D: generative ensemble probabilistic nowcasting model based on a mask diffusion transformer backbone.
e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.data: 3D radar echo (reflectivity) data; region and radar network not specified in the abstract; evaluated on real rainstorm cases.
e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.result: Compared with strong 2D nowcasting systems, improves CRPS by 34.5%, MAE by 14.5% and CSI at 40 dBZ by 17.6%; stays stable with 15% missing data.
e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.open_work: Authors see it as a foundation for future nowcasting research and operational deployment.
e9e21a8b850fd8ff75216816d6ad1d782b0f684e.issues: Evaluation details and region are limited in the abstract; diffusion sampling cost for ensembles may hinder real-time use; case studies focus on rainstorms.

acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.goal: Develops a deep learning global 3D ocean model able to simulate oceanic responses to atmospheric forcing, as a step toward coupled DL climate models.
acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.architecture: KIST-Ocean: a deep learning global three-dimensional ocean general circulation model forced by atmospheric fields; network family not specified in the abstract.
acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.data: Global ocean reanalysis and atmospheric forcing data; specific products not reported in the abstract.
acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.result: Shows robust, efficient ocean simulation and reproduces Kelvin and Rossby wave propagation and wind-stress-curl-driven vertical motions underlying ENSO.
acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.open_work: Coupling with DL atmosphere models toward integrated Earth system simulation and long-range climate prediction.
acca78f53896c029881c3db5b480d2251f038b86.issues: Quantitative skill metrics and data sources are not given in the abstract; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; uncoupled ocean-only setting.

13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.goal: Improves global subseasonal (1–5 week) precipitation forecasts by correcting systematic NWP biases with geographic and seasonal conditioning.
13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.architecture: ReST: U-Net backbone with spatio-temporal adaptive modulation combining SPADE and FiLM conditioning layers; compared with quantile mapping, random forest and Res34-Unet.
13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.data: GEFSv12 reforecasts 2000–2019 for training; evaluated against a global station precipitation dataset from 63,588 stations.
13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.result: Consistently improves skill over raw forecasts and conventional post-processing and yields more spatially coherent fields; gains largest in weeks 1–2, with predictability declining rapidly beyond week 2.
13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.open_work: Extending conditioning to probabilistic outputs and other variables or models.
13da56b533b1850ff9a224e74db233174c911151.issues: Limited gains beyond week 2; station-based verification is uneven globally; single forecast system (GEFSv12).

3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.goal: Evaluates AI-based tropical cyclone track and intensity forecasts for the 2024 western North Pacific season from models shared through the Typhoon Committee ET-AITC.
3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.architecture: Verification study of 19 forecast configurations from AI global weather forecasting models with vortex-tracking algorithms, assessed by model and initial conditions.
3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.data: 2024 western North Pacific typhoon forecasts verified against RSMC Tokyo best-track data; compared with NWP models and official forecasts.
3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.result: Top 25% of AI-TC forecasts have track errors comparable to or smaller than NWP and official forecasts, beating NWP mean position errors in about 71% of cases; intensity shows a substantial low bias, with about 76% worse than NWP.
3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.open_work: Bias correction of intensity, further model development and broader data sharing for operational use.
3e7fafa8614c1e4a1c5bb953cbee4fa7f7efd089.issues: Single season; AI models underestimate intensity throughout the forecast; configurations differ in initial conditions and trackers, complicating attribution.

1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.goal: Examines whether extended historical context and bias correction improve deep learning forecasts of the Madden-Julian Oscillation.
1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.architecture: Deep learning MJO prediction models with varying historical input context plus bias-correction methods; specific network family not stated in the abstract.
1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.data: Not reported in the abstract; MJO indices and atmospheric fields presumably from reanalysis.
1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.result: MJO predictability is governed by the current state rather than prior propagation; bias correction helps DL models only beyond 3 weeks, cutting errors by 11% in weeks 5–6 and extending skill from 37 to 40 days.
1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.open_work: Developing correction methods that target model deficiencies rather than dataset inconsistencies.
1898096ac0cc73a816a0c304885c28dc3bc6b13d.issues: Data sources and architecture are unclear from the abstract; conclusions may depend on the specific DL models tested.

1b20d261599247c628a94d0ece319a1c6f1f47af.goal: Summarizes the 2026 ECMWF-ESA workshop on machine learning for Earth system observation and prediction, as implied by the title.
1b20d261599247c628a94d0ece319a1c6f1f47af.architecture: Review and workshop report on the current status, progress and opportunities of machine learning for Earth system observation and prediction.
1b20d261599247c628a94d0ece319a1c6f1f47af.open_work: Likely highlights opportunities in ML for data assimilation, observation processing and Earth system prediction.
1b20d261599247c628a94d0ece319a1c6f1f47af.issues: Workshop report rather than original research; content not verifiable without the abstract.

d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.goal: Fills the gap in global stratospheric hydroxyl (OH) observations, absent from satellites since 2009, which is key for ozone chemistry.
d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.architecture: DRCAT: a chemistry-informed deep learning network predicting stratospheric OH profiles from coincident satellite observations of chemically related species.
d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.data: Satellite observations of OH and related species, trained on only 2 years of data, producing a reconstruction from late 2004 to present; specific instruments not named in the abstract.
d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.result: Outperforms a chemical transport model and an observation-constrained steady-state approximation, and captures anomalous OH enhancements after the 2022 Hunga eruption outside the training regime.
d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.open_work: Applying the framework to reconstruct other short-lived chemical species.
d6fb0c2ff561330fc0e0e00c873fbde6a00d177d.issues: Very short training period; reconstruction depends on continued availability of the input satellite species; uncertainty not described in the abstract.

ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.goal: Creates a curated, publicly accessible archive of historical Earth system observations to support reanalysis production and AI model development.
ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.architecture: Dataset paper describing NNJA (NOAA-NASA Joint Archive) and its ML-ready companion NNJA-AI in Apache Parquet format, with a three-tier verification process.
ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.data: Satellite radiances, conventional atmospheric observations, in-situ ocean profiles, sea ice concentration and freeboard and land observations from over 60 sensors, 1979 to near-real time, distributed on AWS.
ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.result: Atmospheric records grow from about 10^6 per day in 1979 to about 10^8 today; data are verified and come with channel-level quality lists compatible with data assimilation systems.
ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.open_work: Supporting next-generation U.S. reanalyses and end-to-end AI forecasting from observations.
ac9bfa7ee0e077067beb16d7594f9615742c83bb.issues: Authors document known limitations in coverage and quality; historical satellite records are inhomogeneous over time.

860ae6c44e244761893d9d3a98fe83eae237197c.goal: Reviews the use of artificial intelligence in atmospheric chemistry, from observations to process understanding, as implied by the title.
860ae6c44e244761893d9d3a98fe83eae237197c.architecture: Review of AI and machine learning methods applied to atmospheric chemistry observation, modeling and process understanding.
860ae6c44e244761893d9d3a98fe83eae237197c.open_work: Likely points to interpretable, physics-informed ML and better integration with chemical transport models.
860ae6c44e244761893d9d3a98fe83eae237197c.issues: Review; content not verifiable without the abstract.

4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.goal: Corrects biases in reanalysis surface energy fluxes over Arctic sea ice, where observations are sparse and errors affect estimates of ice growth.
4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.architecture: Neural network bias correction of hourly ERA5 surface fluxes trained on observational data; architecture details beyond neural network not given.
4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.data: Hourly ERA5 fluxes over ice-covered Arctic (≥70°N, sea-ice concentration >80%) for 1994–2024; training on observations spanning two seasonal cycles; validated with SMOS–CryoSat thickness.
4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.result: Reduces RMSE by about 40% for net shortwave, 16% for downward longwave and 55% for the total surface energy budget, removing ERA5's ~4 K winter warm bias; winter cooling halves, giving 80–120 cm ice growth consistent with SMOS–CryoSat.
4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.open_work: Using the corrected fluxes to study Arctic climatology, evaluate climate models and force sea-ice-ocean models.
4d57c3808aea7a62d55109ff947b2741e964f6f8.issues: Training observations are limited to a few campaigns and regimes, so generalization across the Arctic and decades is uncertain.

f15c793cd597d4f7629a65033118100bee8e40f0.goal: Aims at skillful and interpretable ENSO prediction by combining dynamical modeling with deep learning, as implied by the title.
f15c793cd597d4f7629a65033118100bee8e40f0.architecture: Glass-box hybrid dynamical–deep learning model for ENSO; exact network family not known without the abstract.
f15c793cd597d4f7629a65033118100bee8e40f0.open_work: Likely further interpretability analysis and extension of lead times.
f15c793cd597d4f7629a65033118100bee8e40f0.issues: Content not verifiable without the abstract.
